ko.title: 아무도 사용하지 않았던 1930년 관세법 — 캐나다산 하키 스틱이 목록에 오르기 전까지는

segments.src: For most of the last century, Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 was the kind of provision trade lawyers mentioned at conferences and then moved on from.
segments.tr: 지난 세기 대부분의 기간 동안, 1930년 관세법 제338조는 무역 변호사들이 컨퍼런스에서 언급하고는 그냥 넘어가는 식의 조항이었습니다.

segments.src: It is on the books.
segments.tr: 법전에는 명시되어 있었습니다.

segments.src: It has real teeth.
segments.tr: 실질적인 강제력도 갖추고 있었죠.

segments.src: And in roughly 96 years, no president had ever used it to actually put a duty on anything.
segments.tr: 하지만 약 96년 동안, 어떤 대통령도 실제로 무언가에 관세를 부과하기 위해 이 조항을 사용한 적이 없었습니다.

segments.src: That changes on **August 19**, when a **50% duty** invoked under Section 338 is scheduled to take effect on a specific list of Canadian goods: passenger vehicles, dairy products, wine, cement — and hockey sticks.
segments.tr: 그 상황이 **8월 19일**에 바뀝니다. 제338조에 따라 발동된 **50%의 관세**가 캐나다산 특정 상품 목록인 승용차, 유제품, 와인, 시멘트, 그리고 하키 스틱에 적용될 예정입니다.

segments.src: The product list is what gets the headlines.
segments.tr: 헤드라인을 장식하는 것은 상품 목록입니다.

segments.src: The legal mechanism is what matters.
segments.tr: 하지만 정작 중요한 것은 법적 메커니즘입니다.

segments.src: ## What Section 338 actually says
segments.tr: ## 제338조의 실제 내용

segments.src: Section 338 is codified at 19 U.S.C.
segments.tr: 제338조는 19 U.S.C. § 1338에 명문화되어 있으며,

segments.src: § 1338, part of the same 1930 statute better known by the names of its sponsors, Smoot and Hawley.
segments.tr: 그 제안자들의 이름인 스무트-홀리(Smoot and Hawley)라는 이름으로 더 잘 알려진 1930년 법령의 일부입니다.

segments.src: Its subject is not national security, not trade deficits, and not unfair subsidies.
segments.tr: 이 조항의 대상은 국가 안보도, 무역 적자도, 불공정 보조금도 아닙니다.

segments.src: It is *discrimination*.
segments.tr: 바로 *차별*입니다.

segments.src: In plain terms, the provision allows the president to respond when a foreign country is found to impose burdens or restrictions on US commerce that place American exporters at a disadvantage relative to other countries.
segments.tr: 쉽게 말해, 이 조항은 외국이 미국 상거래에 부담이나 제한을 가하여 미국 수출업자가 다른 국가에 비해 불리한 위치에 놓이게 되었다고 판단될 때 대통령이 대응할 수 있도록 허용합니다.

segments.src: The available responses are unusually blunt for US trade law:
segments.tr: 미국 무역법상 사용 가능한 대응 수단은 이례적으로 매우 강력합니다:

segments.src: - **New or additional duties of up to 50% ad valorem** on that country's products, and
segments.tr: - 해당 국가 제품에 대해 **종가세 기준 최대 50%의 신규 또는 추가 관세** 부과, 그리고

segments.src: - in the more extreme case, **exclusion of the goods from entry altogether**.
segments.tr: - 더 극단적인 경우, **해당 상품의 수입을 완전히 배제**하는 것입니다.

segments.src: The statute also contemplates a fact-finding role for the US International Trade Commission in identifying such discriminatory practices and reporting them.
segments.tr: 또한 이 법령은 미국 국제무역위원회(ITC)가 이러한 차별적 관행을 식별하고 보고하는 사실 조사 역할을 수행하는 것을 상정하고 있습니다.

segments.src: But compared with the tools Washington has leaned on for the past decade, the procedural runway is short.
segments.tr: 하지만 워싱턴이 지난 10년 동안 의존해 온 도구들과 비교하면, 절차적 준비 기간이 매우 짧습니다.

segments.src: That contrast is the reason this is a story at all.
segments.tr: 이러한 대조가 바로 이 사건이 뉴스거리가 되는 이유입니다.

segments.src: **Section 232** requires a Commerce Department national-security investigation.
segments.tr: **제232조**는 상무부의 국가 안보 조사를 필요로 합니다.

segments.src: **Section 301** requires a formal USTR proceeding, notice, comment, and a hearing.
segments.tr: **제301조**는 USTR(미국 무역대표부)의 공식 절차, 통지, 의견 수렴 및 청문회를 필요로 합니다.

segments.src: Emergency economic powers require a declared emergency — and have drawn sustained litigation over whether the tariff power was ever in that statute to begin with.
segments.tr: 비상 경제 권한은 선포된 비상사태를 필요로 하며, 관세 부과 권한이 애초에 해당 법령에 포함되어 있었는지에 대해 지속적인 소송이 제기되어 왔습니다.

segments.src: Section 338 sits outside all of those frameworks, with its own findings requirement and its own ceiling.
segments.tr: 제338조는 이러한 모든 프레임워크 외부에 있으며, 자체적인 조사 요건과 자체적인 상한선을 가지고 있습니다.

segments.src: For years, the standard explanation for why nobody used it was that it wasn't needed.
segments.tr: 수년 동안 아무도 이 조항을 사용하지 않은 표준적인 설명은 그것이 필요하지 않았다는 것이었습니다.

segments.src: The modern toolkit was broader, better-tested in court, and easier to defend.
segments.tr: 현대적인 도구들이 더 광범위하고, 법원에서 더 잘 검증되었으며, 방어하기가 더 쉬웠기 때문입니다.

segments.src: The revival of a 1930 authority suggests the calculation has shifted toward statutes that haven't been narrowed by decades of case law — precisely because they haven't been tested.
segments.tr: 1930년의 권한을 다시 꺼내 든 것은, 수십 년의 판례법으로 인해 범위가 좁아지지 않은 법령—정확히 말하면 검증되지 않았기 때문에—으로 계산법이 바뀌었음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: ## Why this round is different: the USMCA carve-out is gone
segments.tr: ## 이번 라운드가 다른 이유: USMCA 예외 조항의 소멸

segments.src: Every significant US tariff action against Canada in recent years came with the same escape hatch.
segments.tr: 최근 몇 년간 캐나다에 대한 미국의 모든 중요한 관세 조치는 동일한 탈출구가 있었습니다.

segments.src: If a shipment qualified as originating under the United States–Mexico–Canada Agreement — if it met the rules of origin and the exporter or importer could certify it — the goods came in outside the new duty.
segments.tr: 만약 선적물이 미국-멕시코-캐나다 협정(USMCA)에 따른 원산지 자격을 갖추었다면—즉, 원산지 규정을 충족하고 수출입자가 이를 증명할 수 있다면—해당 상품은 새로운 관세 적용 대상에서 제외되었습니다.

segments.src: That carve-out did enormous work.
segments.tr: 이 예외 조항은 엄청난 역할을 했습니다.

segments.src: It is why a Canadian-assembled vehicle with a qualifying regional value content was treated differently from an identical-looking vehicle sourced elsewhere.
segments.tr: 그 덕분에 적격한 지역 가치 콘텐츠를 갖춘 캐나다 조립 차량은 다른 곳에서 조달된 동일한 외형의 차량과 다르게 취급되었습니다.

segments.src: It is why compliance departments across the continent spent 2025 and early 2026 rebuilding bills of materials rather than rerouting supply chains.
segments.tr: 그 덕분에 대륙 전역의 컴플라이언스 부서들이 2025년과 2026년 초에 공급망을 변경하는 대신 자재 명세서(BOM)를 재구축하는 데 시간을 보냈습니다.

segments.src: **The Section 338 action, as announced, contains no such exemption.** A good that satisfies every USMCA rule of origin — a car meeting the regional value content and labor value content thresholds, a cheese produced entirely in Quebec, a stick laid up in an Ontario plant — is covered on the same terms as a good that doesn't.
segments.tr: **발표된 제338조 조치는 이러한 예외를 포함하지 않습니다.** USMCA 원산지 규정을 모두 충족하는 상품—지역 가치 콘텐츠 및 노동 가치 콘텐츠 임계값을 충족하는 자동차, 퀘벡에서 전량 생산된 치즈, 온타리오 공장에서 제작된 하키 스틱—이라도 충족하지 않는 상품과 동일한 조건으로 적용됩니다.

segments.src: That is the substantive change.
segments.tr: 이것이 실질적인 변화입니다.

segments.src: Not the rate.
segments.tr: 세율이 아닙니다.

segments.src: The rate is high, but rates move.
segments.tr: 세율은 높지만, 세율은 변합니다.

segments.src: What moved here is the *status* of a document.
segments.tr: 여기서 변한 것은 문서의 *지위*입니다.

segments.src: ## The certificate of origin stops being a shield
segments.tr: ## 원산지 증명서가 더 이상 방패가 되지 못함

segments.src: Since NAFTA took effect in 1994, and continuing under USMCA from July 2020, North American trade has run on a shared assumption: prove where a good comes from, and the tariff schedule follows automatically.
segments.tr: 1994년 NAFTA가 발효된 이후, 그리고 2020년 7월부터 USMCA 하에서 북미 무역은 하나의 공유된 가정을 바탕으로 운영되었습니다. 즉, 상품의 출처를 증명하면 관세 일정이 자동으로 따라온다는 것입니다.

segments.src: USMCA even simplified the mechanics, replacing NAFTA's standardized form with a certification of origin that an importer, exporter, or producer can issue based on a set of required data elements.
segments.tr: USMCA는 심지어 메커니즘을 단순화하여, NAFTA의 표준 양식을 수입자, 수출자 또는 생산자가 필수 데이터 요소 세트를 기반으로 발행할 수 있는 원산지 증명으로 대체했습니다.

segments.src: That certification became the load-bearing beam of continental manufacturing.
segments.tr: 이 증명서는 대륙 제조의 핵심 지지대(load-bearing beam)가 되었습니다.

segments.src: Auto programs were sourced around it.
segments.tr: 자동차 프로그램은 이를 중심으로 조달되었습니다.

segments.src: Food processors structured contracts around it.
segments.tr: 식품 가공업체들은 이를 중심으로 계약을 구조화했습니다.

segments.src: Customs brokers built practices around it.
segments.tr: 통관사들은 이를 중심으로 관행을 구축했습니다.

segments.src: A duty that applies regardless of origin certification doesn't repeal any of that.
segments.tr: 원산지 증명과 관계없이 적용되는 관세는 이러한 것들을 폐지하지는 않습니다.

segments.src: But it does demote it.
segments.tr: 하지만 그 가치를 떨어뜨립니다.

segments.src: The paperwork still governs preferential *duty-free* treatment under the agreement.
segments.tr: 서류 작업은 여전히 협정에 따른 특혜 *무관세* 대우를 결정합니다.

segments.src: It no longer guarantees that a shipment escapes whatever else has been layered on top.
segments.tr: 하지만 더 이상 그 위에 겹쳐진 다른 조치들로부터 선적물이 벗어날 수 있음을 보장하지 않습니다.

segments.src: If you want one sentence for why trade counsel are re-reading old statutes this month, it is this: **origin compliance has stopped being a complete answer to the question "what will this cost at the border?"**
segments.tr: 이번 달 무역 법무팀들이 왜 오래된 법령을 다시 읽고 있는지 한 문장으로 설명하자면 이것입니다: **원산지 준수가 더 이상 "국경에서 비용이 얼마나 들 것인가?"라는 질문에 대한 완전한 답이 되지 못한다는 것입니다.**

segments.src: ## The joint-review backdrop
segments.tr: ## 공동 검토의 배경

segments.src: None of this is happening in a vacuum.
segments.tr: 이 모든 일은 진공 상태에서 일어나는 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: USMCA was written with a clock in it.
segments.tr: USMCA는 내부에 시계가 설정되어 있었습니다.

segments.src: The agreement entered into force on July 1, 2020, with a 16-year term and a **joint review at the six-year mark** — July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: 협정은 2020년 7월 1일에 발효되었으며, 기간은 16년이고 **6년 차에 공동 검토**를 하도록 되어 있습니다—즉, 2026년 7월 1일입니다.

segments.src: If all three parties confirm they want to extend, the term rolls forward another 16 years.
segments.tr: 세 당사국이 모두 연장을 확인하면, 기간은 다시 16년 연장됩니다.

segments.src: If they don't, the agreement doesn't collapse; it shifts into a cycle of **annual reviews** running toward a 2036 endpoint, with the parties expected to keep trying to resolve their differences in the meantime.
segments.tr: 그렇지 않을 경우, 협정이 붕괴되는 것은 아니며, 2036년 종료 시점까지 **연례 검토** 주기로 전환되며, 그동안 당사국들은 차이점을 해결하기 위해 계속 노력해야 합니다.

segments.src: Washington's decision not to renew the pact in its current form puts the agreement into exactly that annual-review posture.
segments.tr: 현재 형태의 협정을 갱신하지 않기로 한 워싱턴의 결정은 협정을 정확히 그 연례 검토 태세로 몰아넣습니다.

segments.src: The treaty is still in force.
segments.tr: 조약은 여전히 유효합니다.

segments.src: Its obligations still exist.
segments.tr: 그 의무 사항들도 여전히 존재합니다.

segments.src: But its long horizon — the thing that made it worth designing a 10-year vehicle program around — is now provisional, reviewed one year at a time.
segments.tr: 하지만 10년 단위의 차량 프로그램을 설계할 가치가 있게 만들었던 그 긴 시계(long horizon)는 이제 잠정적이며, 1년 단위로 검토됩니다.

segments.src: Layer the Section 338 duty on top of that, and the message businesses are reading is less about a single 50% number and more about **planning horizon**.
segments.tr: 여기에 제338조 관세를 얹으면, 기업들이 읽어내는 메시지는 단일한 50%라는 숫자보다는 **계획 수립 기간(planning horizon)**에 관한 것입니다.

segments.src: A tariff can be reversed next quarter.
segments.tr: 관세는 다음 분기에 취소될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A twelve-month review cycle is a structural feature.
segments.tr: 하지만 12개월 검토 주기는 구조적인 특징입니다.

segments.src: ## Who feels it, and how unevenly
segments.tr: ## 누가 느끼며, 얼마나 불균등하게 느끼는가

segments.src: The five categories on the list are not equivalent, and the volumes tell you something about intent.
segments.tr: 목록에 있는 다섯 가지 범주는 동일하지 않으며, 물량은 의도를 말해줍니다.

segments.src: **Vehicles** are the heavyweight.
segments.tr: **차량**은 가장 비중이 큽니다.

segments.src: Canadian assembly plants ship a large share of their output south, and the integrated parts networks around Ontario and Michigan mean components can cross the border several times before a finished car does.
segments.tr: 캐나다 조립 공장들은 생산량의 상당 부분을 남쪽(미국)으로 보내며, 온타리오와 미시간 주변의 통합 부품 네트워크는 완제품 자동차가 국경을 넘기 전까지 부품이 여러 번 국경을 넘나들 수 있음을 의미합니다.

segments.src: A duty applied without an origin exemption interacts badly with a supply chain that was deliberately built to be continental.
segments.tr: 원산지 예외 없이 적용되는 관세는 의도적으로 대륙 단위로 구축된 공급망과 상충됩니다.

segments.src: **Dairy** is the outlier by volume.
segments.tr: **유제품**은 물량 면에서 예외적입니다.

segments.src: The United States generally runs a *surplus* in dairy trade with Canada — US processors sell more north than Canadian processors sell south.
segments.tr: 미국은 일반적으로 캐나다와의 유제품 무역에서 *흑자*를 기록합니다. 즉, 미국 가공업체가 캐나다 가공업체보다 더 많이 북쪽으로 판매합니다.

segments.src: A tariff on Canadian dairy therefore isn't primarily about the flow it taxes.
segments.tr: 따라서 캐나다산 유제품에 대한 관세는 주로 세금을 매기는 흐름 자체에 관한 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: It reads as pressure on a long-running dispute over how Canada allocates its tariff-rate quotas under its supply-management system, an issue that has already been through formal dispute settlement.
segments.tr: 이는 캐나다가 공급 관리 시스템 하에서 관세 할당 쿼터(TRQ)를 어떻게 배분하는지에 대한 오랜 분쟁에 대한 압박으로 읽히며, 이 문제는 이미 공식적인 분쟁 해결 절차를 거쳤습니다.

segments.src: **Wine** is small in dollar terms — Niagara and Okanagan producers ship modest volumes — but highly visible on retail shelves, and it sits inside a broader argument about provincial liquor-board practices that US exporters have complained about for years.
segments.tr: **와인**은 금액 면에서는 작습니다—나이아가라와 오카나간 생산자들이 적은 양을 보내지만—소매점 선반에서는 눈에 잘 띄며, 미국 수출업자들이 수년 동안 불평해 온 주 정부 주류 위원회 관행에 대한 더 넓은 논쟁의 일부입니다.

segments.src: **Cement** is the quiet one with the largest downstream footprint.
segments.tr: **시멘트**는 조용하지만 하류(downstream) 영향력이 가장 큽니다.

segments.src: Canada is among the biggest sources of imported cement in the US, and it moves into Great Lakes, Northeast, and Pacific Northwest markets where the freight economics of alternative suppliers are poor.
segments.tr: 캐나다는 미국의 주요 시멘트 수입원 중 하나이며, 대체 공급업체의 운송 경제성이 떨어지는 오대호, 북동부 및 태평양 북서부 시장으로 유입됩니다.

segments.src: Construction input costs don't make headlines the way car prices do, but they reach further.
segments.tr: 건설 투입 비용은 자동차 가격처럼 헤드라인을 장식하지는 않지만, 그 영향은 더 광범위합니다.

segments.src: **Hockey sticks** are the item everyone will remember, and the one with the most instructive complication.
segments.tr: **하키 스틱**은 모두가 기억할 품목이며, 가장 교훈적인 복잡성을 가진 품목입니다.

segments.src: Several of the best-known brands are Canadian in identity and headquarters, while a great deal of composite stick manufacturing happens in Asia.
segments.tr: 가장 잘 알려진 여러 브랜드가 정체성과 본사를 캐나다에 두고 있지만, 복합 소재 스틱 제조의 상당 부분은 아시아에서 이루어집니다.

segments.src: Whether a given stick is "Canadian" for customs purposes depends on where it was actually made and how the origin rules treat it — which is to say, the symbolic item on the list is also a small lesson in why origin analysis is harder than a logo.
segments.tr: 특정 스틱이 통관 목적으로 "캐나다산"인지 여부는 실제로 어디서 만들어졌는지와 원산지 규정이 이를 어떻게 처리하는지에 달려 있습니다. 즉, 목록에 오른 상징적인 품목은 원산지 분석이 로고보다 더 어렵다는 점을 보여주는 작은 교훈이기도 합니다.

segments.src: ## What is still genuinely unsettled
segments.tr: ## 여전히 진정으로 불확실한 것들

segments.src: A few things are worth holding loosely until they're confirmed in the operative documents:
segments.tr: 실행 문서에서 확인될 때까지 유보적으로 생각해야 할 몇 가지 사항이 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Stacking.** Whether the 50% applies on top of existing sector duties, or in place of them, changes the landed cost dramatically. Check the proclamation text and the customs guidance, not summaries.
segments.tr: - **중첩 적용(Stacking).** 50% 관세가 기존의 섹터 관세 위에 추가로 적용되는지, 아니면 이를 대체하는지에 따라 도착 비용이 크게 달라집니다. 요약본이 아니라 선포문 텍스트와 통관 지침을 확인하십시오.

segments.src: - **Scope by tariff line.** "Cars" and "dairy" are categories in a press summary; what binds is the list of HTS subheadings. Adjacent products often turn out to be in or out in ways the category label doesn't predict.
segments.tr: - **관세 품목 번호(Tariff line)별 범위.** "자동차"와 "유제품"은 보도 자료 요약의 범주입니다. 실제로 구속력이 있는 것은 HTS 소분류 목록입니다. 인접 제품들은 범주 라벨이 예측하지 못하는 방식으로 포함되거나 제외될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **In-transit treatment.** Actions like this usually specify how goods already on the water or on a rail car are handled. That detail decides who eats the cost on shipments already booked.
segments.tr: - **운송 중 처리.** 이러한 조치는 보통 이미 해상이나 철도 차량에 실려 운송 중인 상품이 어떻게 처리되는지 명시합니다. 이 세부 사항이 이미 예약된 선적물에 대해 누가 비용을 부담할지를 결정합니다.

segments.src: - **Legal challenge.** A statute unused for 96 years has correspondingly little case law defining its limits — the findings required, how specific they must be, and how far judicial review reaches. Litigation is a reasonable expectation, and its outcome is not predictable from the text alone.
segments.tr: - **법적 도전.** 96년 동안 사용되지 않은 법령은 그 한계를 정의하는 판례법이 그만큼 적습니다. 필요한 조사 결과, 그 구체성 정도, 그리고 사법 심사가 어디까지 미치는지 등이 포함됩니다. 소송은 합리적인 예상이며, 그 결과는 텍스트만으로는 예측할 수 없습니다.

segments.src: - **Response.** Canada has its own retaliation authorities and a domestic political timetable of its own. The list above may not be the last list.
segments.tr: - **대응.** 캐나다는 자체적인 보복 권한과 자체적인 국내 정치적 일정을 가지고 있습니다. 위의 목록이 마지막 목록이 아닐 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What to watch over the next two weeks
segments.tr: ## 향후 2주 동안 지켜봐야 할 것

segments.src: Between now and August 19, the useful signals are administrative rather than rhetorical: the published proclamation and its annexes, US Customs and Border Protection guidance messages to the trade community, any exclusion or drawback process, and the tariff-line detail.
segments.tr: 지금부터 8월 19일 사이의 유용한 신호는 수사적 표현보다는 행정적인 것입니다. 게시된 선포문과 그 부속서, 미국 세관국경보호청(CBP)의 무역 커뮤니티 대상 지침 메시지, 모든 제외 또는 환급 절차, 그리고 관세 품목 번호의 세부 사항입니다.

segments.src: Statements from either capital will move sentiment; the annexes will move invoices.
segments.tr: 양국 수도의 성명은 심리를 움직이겠지만, 부속서는 송장을 움직일 것입니다.

segments.src: The longer-term signal is the annual review cycle.
segments.tr: 더 장기적인 신호는 연례 검토 주기입니다.

segments.src: A single duty on five product categories is a discrete event.
segments.tr: 다섯 가지 제품 범주에 대한 단일 관세는 개별적인 사건입니다.

segments.src: A framework in which the continent's trade rulebook is reconfirmed twelve months at a time is a different operating environment — and it is the part that will still be true after this particular tariff is resolved, whichever way it goes.
segments.tr: 대륙의 무역 규칙서가 12개월마다 재확인되는 프레임워크는 다른 운영 환경입니다. 그리고 이것은 이 특정 관세가 어떤 방향으로 해결되든 상관없이 여전히 사실로 남을 부분입니다.

segments.src: The hockey sticks will get the jokes.
segments.tr: 하키 스틱은 농담의 소재가 되겠지만,

segments.src: The certificate of origin is the story.
segments.tr: 원산지 증명서는 그 본질적인 이야기입니다.

segments.src: *This article is general information about a public policy development, not legal, tax, customs, or investment advice.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 공공 정책 발전에 관한 일반적인 정보이며, 법률, 세무, 통관 또는 투자 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Tariff actions change quickly and the operative details are set by the published proclamation and official customs guidance.
segments.tr: 관세 조치는 빠르게 변하며, 실행 세부 사항은 게시된 선포문과 공식 통관 지침에 의해 설정됩니다.

segments.src: Importers and exporters should confirm current requirements with the Federal Register, US Customs and Border Protection, and qualified trade counsel before making decisions.*
segments.tr: 수입업자와 수출업자는 결정을 내리기 전 연방 관보(Federal Register), 미국 세관국경보호청(CBP) 및 자격을 갖춘 무역 법무팀과 현재 요건을 확인해야 합니다.*

zh.title: 没人用过的 1930 年关税法 —— 直到加拿大曲棍球棒进入名单

segments.src: For most of the last century, Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 was the kind of provision trade lawyers mentioned at conferences and then moved on from.
segments.tr: 在过去一个世纪的大部分时间里，1930 年《关税法》第 338 条是贸易律师在会议上提及后便不再深究的那类条款。

segments.src: It is on the books.
segments.tr: 它被记录在案。

segments.src: It has real teeth.
segments.tr: 它具有真正的威慑力。

segments.src: And in roughly 96 years, no president had ever used it to actually put a duty on anything.
segments.tr: 但在大约 96 年的时间里，没有一位总统曾真正使用它来对任何东西征收关税。

segments.src: That changes on **August 19**, when a **50% duty** invoked under Section 338 is scheduled to take effect on a specific list of Canadian goods: passenger vehicles, dairy products, wine, cement — and hockey sticks.
segments.tr: 这种情况在 **8 月 19 日**发生了变化，届时根据第 338 条启动的 **50% 关税**计划对一份特定的加拿大商品清单生效：客车、乳制品、葡萄酒、水泥 —— 以及曲棍球棒。

segments.src: The product list is what gets the headlines.
segments.tr: 产品清单是吸引头条新闻的部分。

segments.src: The legal mechanism is what matters.
segments.tr: 而法律机制才是关键。

segments.src: ## What Section 338 actually says
segments.tr: ## 第 338 条实际上说了什么

segments.src: Section 338 is codified at 19 U.S.C.
segments.tr: 第 338 条被编入 19 U.S.C.

segments.src: § 1338, part of the same 1930 statute better known by the names of its sponsors, Smoot and Hawley.
segments.tr: § 1338，它是 1930 年同一部法令的一部分，该法令以其发起人 Smoot 和 Hawley 的名字而闻名。

segments.src: Its subject is not national security, not trade deficits, and not unfair subsidies.
segments.tr: 它的主题不是国家安全，不是贸易逆差，也不是不公平补贴。

segments.src: It is *discrimination*.
segments.tr: 它是关于 *歧视* 的。

segments.src: In plain terms, the provision allows the president to respond when a foreign country is found to impose burdens or restrictions on US commerce that place American exporters at a disadvantage relative to other countries.
segments.tr: 简单来说，该条款允许总统在发现外国政府对美国商业施加负担或限制，导致美国出口商相对于其他国家处于不利地位时做出回应。

segments.src: The available responses are unusually blunt for US trade law:
segments.tr: 美国贸易法中可采取的回应措施异常强硬：

segments.src: - **New or additional duties of up to 50% ad valorem** on that country's products, and
segments.tr: - 对该国产品征收 **最高 50% 的从价新关税或附加关税**，以及

segments.src: - in the more extreme case, **exclusion of the goods from entry altogether**.
segments.tr: - 在更极端的情况下，**完全禁止该商品入境**。

segments.src: The statute also contemplates a fact-finding role for the US International Trade Commission in identifying such discriminatory practices and reporting them.
segments.tr: 该法令还设想了美国国际贸易委员会在识别此类歧视性做法并报告它们方面的实证调查角色。

segments.src: But compared with the tools Washington has leaned on for the past decade, the procedural runway is short.
segments.tr: 但与华盛顿在过去十年中依赖的工具相比，其程序路径非常短。

segments.src: That contrast is the reason this is a story at all.
segments.tr: 这种对比正是这个故事之所以成为新闻的原因。

segments.src: **Section 232** requires a Commerce Department national-security investigation.
segments.tr: **第 232 条**要求商务部进行国家安全调查。

segments.src: **Section 301** requires a formal USTR proceeding, notice, comment, and a hearing.
segments.tr: **第 301 条**要求正式的 USTR 程序、通知、评论和听证会。

segments.src: Emergency economic powers require a declared emergency — and have drawn sustained litigation over whether the tariff power was ever in that statute to begin with.
segments.tr: 紧急经济权力要求宣布进入紧急状态 —— 并且关于关税权力最初是否包含在该法令中，一直存在持续的诉讼。

segments.src: Section 338 sits outside all of those frameworks, with its own findings requirement and its own ceiling.
segments.tr: 第 338 条处于所有这些框架之外，它有自己的认定要求和上限。

segments.src: For years, the standard explanation for why nobody used it was that it wasn't needed.
segments.tr: 多年来，关于为什么没人使用它的标准解释是它不需要。

segments.src: The modern toolkit was broader, better-tested in court, and easier to defend.
segments.tr: 现代工具箱更广泛，在法院中经过了更好的测试，且更容易辩护。

segments.src: The revival of a 1930 authority suggests the calculation has shifted toward statutes that haven't been narrowed by decades of case law — precisely because they haven't been tested.
segments.tr: 重启 1930 年的权限表明，计算方式已转向那些未被数十年判例法限缩的法令 —— 正因为它们尚未经过测试。

segments.src: ## Why this round is different: the USMCA carve-out is gone
segments.tr: ## 为什么这一轮不同：USMCA 豁免已消失

segments.src: Every significant US tariff action against Canada in recent years came with the same escape hatch.
segments.tr: 近年来美国针对加拿大的每一次重大关税行动都带有同样的逃生舱。

segments.src: If a shipment qualified as originating under the United States–Mexico–Canada Agreement — if it met the rules of origin and the exporter or importer could certify it — the goods came in outside the new duty.
segments.tr: 如果一批货物被认定为原产于《美国-墨西哥-加拿大协定》（USMCA）—— 如果它符合原产地规则且出口商或进口商能够证明 —— 则该商品在入境时无需缴纳新关税。

segments.src: That carve-out did enormous work.
segments.tr: 这一豁免起到了巨大的作用。

segments.src: It is why a Canadian-assembled vehicle with a qualifying regional value content was treated differently from an identical-looking vehicle sourced elsewhere.
segments.tr: 这就是为什么在加拿大组装且具有合格区域价值含量的车辆，与在其他地方采购的相同外观车辆被区别对待的原因。

segments.src: It is why compliance departments across the continent spent 2025 and early 2026 rebuilding bills of materials rather than rerouting supply chains.
segments.tr: 这就是为什么整个大陆的合规部门在 2025 年和 2026 年初花费大量时间重建物料清单，而不是重新规划供应链的原因。

segments.src: **The Section 338 action, as announced, contains no such exemption.** A good that satisfies every USMCA rule of origin — a car meeting the regional value content and labor value content thresholds, a cheese produced entirely in Quebec, a stick laid up in an Ontario plant — is covered on the same terms as a good that doesn't.
segments.tr: **据宣布，第 338 条的行动不包含此类豁免。** 一件满足所有 USMCA 原产地规则的商品 —— 一辆满足区域价值含量和劳动力价值含量阈值的汽车，一种完全在魁北克生产的奶酪，一根在安大略省工厂制造的球棒 —— 将与不满足条件的商品在相同的条款下被对待。

segments.src: That is the substantive change.
segments.tr: 这就是实质性的变化。

segments.src: Not the rate.
segments.tr: 而不是税率。

segments.src: The rate is high, but rates move.
segments.tr: 税率很高，但税率是会变动的。

segments.src: What moved here is the *status* of a document.
segments.tr: 这里变动的是文件的 *地位*。

segments.src: ## The certificate of origin stops being a shield
segments.tr: ## 原产地证明不再是盾牌

segments.src: Since NAFTA took effect in 1994, and continuing under USMCA from July 2020, North American trade has run on a shared assumption: prove where a good comes from, and the tariff schedule follows automatically.
segments.tr: 自 1994 年 NAFTA 生效以来，以及 2020 年 7 月起在 USMCA 下继续执行，北美贸易一直基于一个共同的假设：证明商品的来源，关税表就会自动适用。

segments.src: USMCA even simplified the mechanics, replacing NAFTA's standardized form with a certification of origin that an importer, exporter, or producer can issue based on a set of required data elements.
segments.tr: USMCA 甚至简化了机制，用一种进口商、出口商或生产者可以基于一组必需的数据元素签发的原产地证明，取代了 NAFTA 的标准化表格。

segments.src: That certification became the load-bearing beam of continental manufacturing.
segments.tr: 该证明成为了大陆制造业的承重梁。

segments.src: Auto programs were sourced around it.
segments.tr: 汽车计划围绕它进行采购。

segments.src: Food processors structured contracts around it.
segments.tr: 食品加工商围绕它构建合同。

segments.src: Customs brokers built practices around it.
segments.tr: 海关经纪人围绕它建立实践。

segments.src: A duty that applies regardless of origin certification doesn't repeal any of that.
segments.tr: 一项无论原产地证明如何都适用的关税并不会废除上述任何一项。

segments.src: But it does demote it.
segments.tr: 但它确实降低了其重要性。

segments.src: The paperwork still governs preferential *duty-free* treatment under the agreement.
segments.tr: 文书工作仍然决定协定下的优惠 *免税*待遇。

segments.src: It no longer guarantees that a shipment escapes whatever else has been layered on top.
segments.tr: 但它不再保证一批货物能够逃避叠加在上面的其他任何费用。

segments.src: If you want one sentence for why trade counsel are re-reading old statutes this month, it is this: **origin compliance has stopped being a complete answer to the question "what will this cost at the border?"**
segments.tr: 如果你想用一句话来解释为什么贸易顾问本月在重新阅读旧法令，那就是：**原产地合规已不再是回答“在边境需要支付多少费用？”这个问题的完整答案。**

segments.src: ## The joint-review backdrop
segments.tr: ## 联合审查的背景

segments.src: None of this is happening in a vacuum.
segments.tr: 这一切并非发生在真空之中。

segments.src: USMCA was written with a clock in it.
segments.tr: USMCA 在编写时就内置了时钟。

segments.src: The agreement entered into force on July 1, 2020, with a 16-year term and a **joint review at the six-year mark** — July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: 该协定于 2020 年 7 月 1 日生效，期限为 16 年，并在 **第六年（2026 年 7 月 1 日）进行联合审查**。

segments.src: If all three parties confirm they want to extend, the term rolls forward another 16 years.
segments.tr: 如果三方都确认希望延长，期限将再延长 16 年。

segments.src: If they don't, the agreement doesn't collapse; it shifts into a cycle of **annual reviews** running toward a 2036 endpoint, with the parties expected to keep trying to resolve their differences in the meantime.
segments.tr: 如果他们不这样做，协定不会崩溃；它将转入一个运行至 2036 年终点的 **年度审查** 周期，期间各方预计将继续尝试解决分歧。

segments.src: Washington's decision not to renew the pact in its current form puts the agreement into exactly that annual-review posture.
segments.tr: 华盛顿决定不以当前形式续签该协议，使该协议恰好进入了这种年度审查姿态。

segments.src: The treaty is still in force.
segments.tr: 条约仍然有效。

segments.src: Its obligations still exist.
segments.tr: 其义务仍然存在。

segments.src: But its long horizon — the thing that made it worth designing a 10-year vehicle program around — is now provisional, reviewed one year at a time.
segments.tr: 但其长远前景 —— 也就是让人们觉得值得围绕它设计 10 年期车辆计划的东西 —— 现在变成了临时性的，一次审查一年。

segments.src: Layer the Section 338 duty on top of that, and the message businesses are reading is less about a single 50% number and more about **planning horizon**.
segments.tr: 将第 338 条的关税叠加在上面，企业读出的信息不再仅仅是一个 50% 的数字，而更多是关于 **规划期限** 的。

segments.src: A tariff can be reversed next quarter.
segments.tr: 关税可以在下个季度被撤销。

segments.src: A twelve-month review cycle is a structural feature.
segments.tr: 而十二个月的审查周期是一个结构性特征。

segments.src: ## Who feels it, and how unevenly
segments.tr: ## 谁会感受到影响，以及影响如何不均衡

segments.src: The five categories on the list are not equivalent, and the volumes tell you something about intent.
segments.tr: 清单上的五个类别并不等同，其贸易量揭示了某种意图。

segments.src: **Vehicles** are the heavyweight.
segments.tr: **车辆** 是重量级产品。

segments.src: Canadian assembly plants ship a large share of their output south, and the integrated parts networks around Ontario and Michigan mean components can cross the border several times before a finished car does.
segments.tr: 加拿大的组装厂将其产出的大部分运往南方，而安大略省和密歇根州周围的集成零部件网络意味着组件在成品车跨境之前可能已经跨境多次。

segments.src: A duty applied without an origin exemption interacts badly with a supply chain that was deliberately built to be continental.
segments.tr: 一项在没有原产地豁免的情况下适用的关税，与一个刻意构建为大陆性的供应链会产生糟糕的相互作用。

segments.src: **Dairy** is the outlier by volume.
segments.tr: **乳制品** 在贸易量上是个特例。

segments.src: The United States generally runs a *surplus* in dairy trade with Canada — US processors sell more north than Canadian processors sell south.
segments.tr: 美国在与加拿大的乳制品贸易中通常处于 *盈余* 状态 —— 美国加工商向北销售的数量多于加拿大加工商向南销售的数量。

segments.src: A tariff on Canadian dairy therefore isn't primarily about the flow it taxes.
segments.tr: 因此，对加拿大乳制品的关税主要不是为了限制其税收流。

segments.src: It reads as pressure on a long-running dispute over how Canada allocates its tariff-rate quotas under its supply-management system, an issue that has already been through formal dispute settlement.
segments.tr: 它被解读为对加拿大在其供应管理制度下如何分配关税配额这一长期争端的压力，该问题已经过正式的争端解决程序。

segments.src: **Wine** is small in dollar terms — Niagara and Okanagan producers ship modest volumes — but highly visible on retail shelves, and it sits inside a broader argument about provincial liquor-board practices that US exporters have complained about for years.
segments.tr: **葡萄酒** 的金额较小 —— 尼亚加拉和奥肯那根的生产商出货量适中 —— 但在零售货架上非常显眼，并且处于关于省级酒类管理局做法的更广泛争论之中，美国出口商多年来一直对此抱怨。

segments.src: **Cement** is the quiet one with the largest downstream footprint.
segments.tr: **水泥** 是一个低调但下游影响最大的产品。

segments.src: Canada is among the biggest sources of imported cement in the US, and it moves into Great Lakes, Northeast, and Pacific Northwest markets where the freight economics of alternative suppliers are poor.
segments.tr: 加拿大是美国进口水泥的最大来源地之一，且水泥进入五大湖、东北部和太平洋西北部市场，在这些市场中，替代供应商的货运经济效益较差。

segments.src: Construction input costs don't make headlines the way car prices do, but they reach further.
segments.tr: 建筑投入成本不像汽车价格那样能上头条，但其影响范围更广。

segments.src: **Hockey sticks** are the item everyone will remember, and the one with the most instructive complication.
segments.tr: **曲棍球棒** 是每个人都会记住的项目，也是最具启发性的复杂项。

segments.src: Several of the best-known brands are Canadian in identity and headquarters, while a great deal of composite stick manufacturing happens in Asia.
segments.tr: 几个最著名的品牌在身份和总部上是加拿大的，而大量的复合材料球棒制造发生在亚洲。

segments.src: Whether a given stick is "Canadian" for customs purposes depends on where it was actually made and how the origin rules treat it — which is to say, the symbolic item on the list is also a small lesson in why origin analysis is harder than a logo.
segments.tr: 一根球棒在海关用途上是否被视为“加拿大产”，取决于它实际在何处制造以及原产地规则如何对待它 —— 也就是说，清单上的象征性项目也提供了一个小教训：原产地分析比看 Logo 要困难得多。

segments.src: ## What is still genuinely unsettled
segments.tr: ## 仍未真正确定之事

segments.src: A few things are worth holding loosely until they're confirmed in the operative documents:
segments.tr: 在正式执行文件中确认之前，有几件事值得谨慎对待：

segments.src: - **Stacking.** Whether the 50% applies on top of existing sector duties, or in place of them, changes the landed cost dramatically. Check the proclamation text and the customs guidance, not summaries.
segments.tr: - **叠加。** 50% 是叠加在现有行业关税之上，还是取代它们，这将极大地改变到岸成本。请查看公告文本和海关指南，而非摘要。

segments.src: - **Scope by tariff line.** "Cars" and "dairy" are categories in a press summary; what binds is the list of HTS subheadings. Adjacent products often turn out to be in or out in ways the category label doesn't predict.
segments.tr: - **按关税行划分的范围。** “汽车”和“乳制品”是新闻摘要中的类别；具有约束力的是 HTS 子目清单。相邻产品往往会以类别标签无法预测的方式被包含或排除。

segments.src: - **In-transit treatment.** Actions like this usually specify how goods already on the water or on a rail car are handled. That detail decides who eats the cost on shipments already booked.
segments.tr: - **在途处理。** 此类行动通常会规定如何处理已经在水上或在铁路货车上的货物。该细节决定了谁来承担已预订货物的成本。

segments.src: - **Legal challenge.** A statute unused for 96 years has correspondingly little case law defining its limits — the findings required, how specific they must be, and how far judicial review reaches. Litigation is a reasonable expectation, and its outcome is not predictable from the text alone.
segments.tr: - **法律挑战。** 一部未使用 96 年的法令在定义其限制方面相应的判例法极少 —— 包括所需的认定、认定的具体程度以及司法审查的范围。诉讼是一个合理的预期，其结果无法仅凭文本预测。

segments.src: - **Response.** Canada has its own retaliation authorities and a domestic political timetable of its own. The list above may not be the last list.
segments.tr: - **回应。** 加拿大拥有自己的报复权限和国内政治时间表。上述清单可能不是最后一份清单。

segments.src: ## What to watch over the next two weeks
segments.tr: ## 未来两周需要关注什么

segments.src: Between now and August 19, the useful signals are administrative rather than rhetorical: the published proclamation and its annexes, US Customs and Border Protection guidance messages to the trade community, any exclusion or drawback process, and the tariff-line detail.
segments.tr: 从现在到 8 月 19 日，有用的信号是行政性的而非修辞性的：发布的公告及其附件、美国海关和边境保护局向贸易界的指导消息、任何豁免或退税流程以及关税行细节。

segments.src: Statements from either capital will move sentiment; the annexes will move invoices.
segments.tr: 来自两个首都的声明会影响情绪；而附件则会影响发票。

segments.src: The longer-term signal is the annual review cycle.
segments.tr: 更长期的信号是年度审查周期。

segments.src: A single duty on five product categories is a discrete event.
segments.tr: 对五个产品类别征收单一关税是一个独立事件。

segments.src: A framework in which the continent's trade rulebook is reconfirmed twelve months at a time is a different operating environment — and it is the part that will still be true after this particular tariff is resolved, whichever way it goes.
segments.tr: 一个大陆贸易规则书每十二个月重新确认一次的框架，是一个不同的运营环境 —— 并且无论这次特定关税如何解决，这部分在未来依然会是事实。

segments.src: The hockey sticks will get the jokes.
segments.tr: 曲棍球棒会成为笑话。

segments.src: The certificate of origin is the story.
segments.tr: 而原产地证明才是故事的核心。

segments.src: *This article is general information about a public policy development, not legal, tax, customs, or investment advice.
segments.tr: *本文是关于公共政策发展的通用信息，不构成法律、税务、海关或投资建议。

segments.src: Tariff actions change quickly and the operative details are set by the published proclamation and official customs guidance.
segments.tr: 关税行动变化迅速，执行细节由发布的公告和官方海关指南决定。

segments.src: Importers and exporters should confirm current requirements with the Federal Register, US Customs and Border Protection, and qualified trade counsel before making decisions.*
segments.tr: 进口商和出口商在做出决定前，应通过联邦登记簿、美国海关和边境保护局以及合格的贸易顾问确认当前要求。*

hi.title: 1930 का वह टैरिफ कानून जिसका किसी ने उपयोग नहीं किया था — जब तक कि कनाडाई हॉकी स्टिक्स सूची में नहीं आ गईं

segments.src: For most of the last century, Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 was the kind of provision trade lawyers mentioned at conferences and then moved on from.
segments.tr: पिछली शताब्दी के अधिकांश समय के लिए, 1930 के टैरिफ अधिनियम की धारा 338 एक ऐसा प्रावधान था जिसका उल्लेख व्यापार वकील सम्मेलनों में करते थे और फिर आगे बढ़ जाते थे।

segments.src: It is on the books.
segments.tr: यह किताबों में दर्ज है।

segments.src: It has real teeth.
segments.tr: इसमें वास्तविक शक्ति है।

segments.src: And in roughly 96 years, no president had ever used it to actually put a duty on anything.
segments.tr: और लगभग 96 वर्षों में, किसी भी राष्ट्रपति ने वास्तव में किसी भी चीज़ पर शुल्क लगाने के लिए इसका उपयोग नहीं किया था।

segments.src: That changes on **August 19**, when a **50% duty** invoked under Section 338 is scheduled to take effect on a specific list of Canadian goods: passenger vehicles, dairy products, wine, cement — and hockey sticks.
segments.tr: यह **19 अगस्त** को बदल जाता है, जब धारा 338 के तहत लागू एक **50% शुल्क** कनाडाई वस्तुओं की एक विशिष्ट सूची पर प्रभावी होने वाला है: यात्री वाहन, डेयरी उत्पाद, वाइन, सीमेंट — और हॉकी स्टिक्स।

segments.src: The product list is what gets the headlines.
segments.tr: उत्पादों की सूची वह है जो सुर्खियों में आती है।

segments.src: The legal mechanism is what matters.
segments.tr: कानूनी तंत्र वह है जो मायने रखता है।

segments.src: ## What Section 338 actually says
segments.tr: ## धारा 338 वास्तव में क्या कहती है

segments.src: Section 338 is codified at 19 U.S.C.
segments.tr: धारा 338 को 19 U.S.C. में संहिताबद्ध किया गया है।

segments.src: § 1338, part of the same 1930 statute better known by the names of its sponsors, Smoot and Hawley.
segments.tr: § 1338, उसी 1930 के कानून का हिस्सा, जिसे इसके प्रायोजकों, स्मूट और हॉली के नामों से बेहतर जाना जाता है।

segments.src: Its subject is not national security, not trade deficits, and not unfair subsidies.
segments.tr: इसका विषय राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा, व्यापार घाटा, या अनुचित सब्सिडी नहीं है।

segments.src: It is *discrimination*.
segments.tr: यह *भेदभाव* है।

segments.src: In plain terms, the provision allows the president to respond when a foreign country is found to impose burdens or restrictions on US commerce that place American exporters at a disadvantage relative to other countries.
segments.tr: सादे शब्दों में, यह प्रावधान राष्ट्रपति को तब प्रतिक्रिया देने की अनुमति देता है जब यह पाया जाता है कि कोई विदेशी देश अमेरिकी वाणिज्य पर ऐसे बोझ या प्रतिबंध लगाता है जो अन्य देशों की तुलना में अमेरिकी निर्यातकों को नुकसान पहुँचाते हैं।

segments.src: The available responses are unusually blunt for US trade law:
segments.tr: अमेरिकी व्यापार कानून के लिए उपलब्ध प्रतिक्रियाएं असामान्य रूप से कठोर हैं:

segments.src: - **New or additional duties of up to 50% ad valorem** on that country's products, and
segments.tr: - उस देश के उत्पादों पर **50% मूल्यवर्धन (ad valorem) तक के नए या अतिरिक्त शुल्क**, और

segments.src: - in the more extreme case, **exclusion of the goods from entry altogether**.
segments.tr: - अधिक चरम मामले में, **वस्तुओं के प्रवेश को पूरी तरह से प्रतिबंधित करना**।

segments.src: The statute also contemplates a fact-finding role for the US International Trade Commission in identifying such discriminatory practices and reporting them.
segments.tr: कानून में ऐसे भेदभावपूर्ण व्यवहारों की पहचान करने और उनकी रिपोर्ट करने में अमेरिकी अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार आयोग की तथ्य-खोज भूमिका की भी परिकल्पना है।

segments.src: But compared with the tools Washington has leaned on for the past decade, the procedural runway is short.
segments.tr: लेकिन पिछले दशक में वाशिंगटन ने जिन उपकरणों का सहारा लिया है, उनकी तुलना में प्रक्रियात्मक रास्ता छोटा है।

segments.src: That contrast is the reason this is a story at all.
segments.tr: यही विरोधाभास इस कहानी का कारण है।

segments.src: **Section 232** requires a Commerce Department national-security investigation.
segments.tr: **धारा 232** के लिए वाणिज्य विभाग की राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा जांच की आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: **Section 301** requires a formal USTR proceeding, notice, comment, and a hearing.
segments.tr: **धारा 301** के लिए एक औपचारिक USTR प्रक्रिया, नोटिस, टिप्पणी और सुनवाई की आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: Emergency economic powers require a declared emergency — and have drawn sustained litigation over whether the tariff power was ever in that statute to begin with.
segments.tr: आपातकालीन आर्थिक शक्तियों के लिए घोषित आपातकाल की आवश्यकता होती है — और इस बात पर निरंतर मुकदमेबाजी हुई है कि क्या टैरिफ शक्ति शुरू से ही उस कानून में थी।

segments.src: Section 338 sits outside all of those frameworks, with its own findings requirement and its own ceiling.
segments.tr: धारा 338 इन सभी ढांचों से बाहर है, जिसकी अपनी खोज आवश्यकताएं और अपनी सीमा है।

segments.src: For years, the standard explanation for why nobody used it was that it wasn't needed.
segments.tr: वर्षों तक, इस बात का मानक स्पष्टीकरण कि किसी ने इसका उपयोग क्यों नहीं किया, यह था कि इसकी आवश्यकता नहीं थी।

segments.src: The modern toolkit was broader, better-tested in court, and easier to defend.
segments.tr: आधुनिक टूलकिट व्यापक थी, अदालत में बेहतर तरीके से परीक्षित थी, और बचाव करना आसान था।

segments.src: The revival of a 1930 authority suggests the calculation has shifted toward statutes that haven't been narrowed by decades of case law — precisely because they haven't been tested.
segments.tr: 1930 के अधिकार का पुनरुद्धार यह सुझाव देता है कि गणना उन कानूनों की ओर स्थानांतरित हो गई है जिन्हें दशकों के केस कानून द्वारा संकुचित नहीं किया गया है — ठीक इसलिए क्योंकि उनका परीक्षण नहीं किया गया है।

segments.src: ## Why this round is different: the USMCA carve-out is gone
segments.tr: ## यह दौर अलग क्यों है: USMCA छूट अब खत्म हो गई है

segments.src: Every significant US tariff action against Canada in recent years came with the same escape hatch.
segments.tr: हाल के वर्षों में कनाडा के खिलाफ हर महत्वपूर्ण अमेरिकी टैरिफ कार्रवाई के साथ एक ही बचाव का रास्ता था।

segments.src: If a shipment qualified as originating under the United States–Mexico–Canada Agreement — if it met the rules of origin and the exporter or importer could certify it — the goods came in outside the new duty.
segments.tr: यदि कोई शिपमेंट यूनाइटेड स्टेट्स-मेक्सिको-कनाडा समझौते (USMCA) के तहत मूल होने के योग्य था — यदि यह मूल के नियमों को पूरा करता था और निर्यातक या आयातक इसे प्रमाणित कर सकता था — तो सामान नए शुल्क से बाहर रहता था।

segments.src: That carve-out did enormous work.
segments.tr: उस छूट ने बहुत बड़ा काम किया।

segments.src: It is why a Canadian-assembled vehicle with a qualifying regional value content was treated differently from an identical-looking vehicle sourced elsewhere.
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि क्षेत्रीय मूल्य सामग्री के साथ एक कनाडाई-असेंबल वाहन को कहीं और से प्राप्त एक समान दिखने वाले वाहन से अलग माना गया।

segments.src: It is why compliance departments across the continent spent 2025 and early 2026 rebuilding bills of materials rather than rerouting supply chains.
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि पूरे महाद्वीप के अनुपालन विभागों ने आपूर्ति श्रृंखलाओं को बदलने के बजाय बिल ऑफ मैटेरियल्स को फिर से बनाने में 2025 और 2026 की शुरुआत बिताई।

segments.src: **The Section 338 action, as announced, contains no such exemption.** A good that satisfies every USMCA rule of origin — a car meeting the regional value content and labor value content thresholds, a cheese produced entirely in Quebec, a stick laid up in an Ontario plant — is covered on the same terms as a good that doesn't.
segments.tr: **घोषित धारा 338 कार्रवाई में ऐसी कोई छूट नहीं है।** एक वस्तु जो USMCA के मूल के हर नियम को पूरा करती है — क्षेत्रीय मूल्य सामग्री और श्रम मूल्य सामग्री की सीमा को पूरा करने वाली एक कार, पूरी तरह से क्यूबेक में उत्पादित एक पनीर, ओंटारियो संयंत्र में तैयार एक स्टिक — वह उन्हीं शर्तों पर कवर की जाती है जैसे कि वह वस्तु जो नियमों को पूरा नहीं करती।

segments.src: That is the substantive change.
segments.tr: यही वास्तविक परिवर्तन है।

segments.src: Not the rate.
segments.tr: दर नहीं।

segments.src: The rate is high, but rates move.
segments.tr: दर ऊंची है, लेकिन दरें बदलती रहती हैं।

segments.src: What moved here is the *status* of a document.
segments.tr: यहाँ जो बदला है वह एक दस्तावेज़ की *स्थिति* है।

segments.src: ## The certificate of origin stops being a shield
segments.tr: ## मूल प्रमाण पत्र अब ढाल नहीं रहा

segments.src: Since NAFTA took effect in 1994, and continuing under USMCA from July 2020, North American trade has run on a shared assumption: prove where a good comes from, and the tariff schedule follows automatically.
segments.tr: 1994 में NAFTA के प्रभावी होने के बाद से, और जुलाई 2020 से USMCA के तहत जारी, उत्तरी अमेरिकी व्यापार एक साझा धारणा पर चला है: साबित करें कि सामान कहाँ से आता है, और टैरिफ अनुसूची स्वचालित रूप से लागू हो जाती है।

segments.src: USMCA even simplified the mechanics, replacing NAFTA's standardized form with a certification of origin that an importer, exporter, or producer can issue based on a set of required data elements.
segments.tr: USMCA ने तंत्र को और सरल बना दिया, NAFTA के मानकीकृत फॉर्म को मूल के प्रमाणन से बदल दिया जिसे एक आयातक, निर्यातक या उत्पादक आवश्यक डेटा तत्वों के एक सेट के आधार पर जारी कर सकता है।

segments.src: That certification became the load-bearing beam of continental manufacturing.
segments.tr: वह प्रमाणन महाद्वीपीय विनिर्माण का मुख्य आधार बन गया।

segments.src: Auto programs were sourced around it.
segments.tr: ऑटो प्रोग्राम इसके इर्द-गिर्द सोर्स किए गए थे।

segments.src: Food processors structured contracts around it.
segments.tr: खाद्य प्रोसेसरों ने इसके इर्द-गिर्द अनुबंध तैयार किए।

segments.src: Customs brokers built practices around it.
segments.tr: सीमा शुल्क दलालों ने इसके इर्द-गिर्द अपनी प्रथाएं बनाईं।

segments.src: A duty that applies regardless of origin certification doesn't repeal any of that.
segments.tr: एक शुल्क जो मूल प्रमाणन की परवाह किए बिना लागू होता है, इनमें से किसी को रद्द नहीं करता है।

segments.src: But it does demote it.
segments.tr: लेकिन यह इसे कमतर कर देता है।

segments.src: The paperwork still governs preferential *duty-free* treatment under the agreement.
segments.tr: कागजी कार्रवाई अभी भी समझौते के तहत अधिमान्य *शुल्क-मुक्त* उपचार को नियंत्रित करती है।

segments.src: It no longer guarantees that a shipment escapes whatever else has been layered on top.
segments.tr: यह अब इस बात की गारंटी नहीं देता कि एक शिपमेंट उस चीज़ से बचेगा जिसे ऊपर से जोड़ा गया है।

segments.src: If you want one sentence for why trade counsel are re-reading old statutes this month, it is this: **origin compliance has stopped being a complete answer to the question "what will this cost at the border?"**
segments.tr: यदि आप इस महीने व्यापार सलाहकारों के पुराने कानूनों को फिर से पढ़ने के कारण के लिए एक वाक्य चाहते हैं, तो वह यह है: **मूल अनुपालन अब इस प्रश्न का पूर्ण उत्तर नहीं रहा कि "सीमा पर इसकी लागत क्या होगी?"**

segments.src: ## The joint-review backdrop
segments.tr: ## संयुक्त समीक्षा की पृष्ठभूमि

segments.src: None of this is happening in a vacuum.
segments.tr: इनमें से कुछ भी शून्य में नहीं हो रहा है।

segments.src: USMCA was written with a clock in it.
segments.tr: USMCA को एक समय सीमा के साथ लिखा गया था।

segments.src: The agreement entered into force on July 1, 2020, with a 16-year term and a **joint review at the six-year mark** — July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: समझौता 1 जुलाई, 2020 को 16 साल की अवधि के लिए लागू हुआ, जिसमें **छह साल के निशान पर एक संयुक्त समीक्षा** — 1 जुलाई, 2026 — निर्धारित थी।

segments.src: If all three parties confirm they want to extend, the term rolls forward another 16 years.
segments.tr: यदि तीनों पक्ष पुष्टि करते हैं कि वे विस्तार करना चाहते हैं, तो अवधि अगले 16 वर्षों के लिए आगे बढ़ जाती है।

segments.src: If they don't, the agreement doesn't collapse; it shifts into a cycle of **annual reviews** running toward a 2036 endpoint, with the parties expected to keep trying to resolve their differences in the meantime.
segments.tr: यदि वे ऐसा नहीं करते हैं, तो समझौता समाप्त नहीं होता; यह **वार्षिक समीक्षाओं** के चक्र में चला जाता है जो 2036 के अंत बिंदु की ओर बढ़ता है, जिसमें उम्मीद की जाती है कि पक्ष इस बीच अपने मतभेदों को हल करने की कोशिश करते रहेंगे।

segments.src: Washington's decision not to renew the pact in its current form puts the agreement into exactly that annual-review posture.
segments.tr: वाशिंगटन का समझौते को उसके वर्तमान स्वरूप में नवीनीकृत न करने का निर्णय समझौते को ठीक उसी वार्षिक-समीक्षा मुद्रा में डाल देता है।

segments.src: The treaty is still in force.
segments.tr: संधि अभी भी लागू है।

segments.src: Its obligations still exist.
segments.tr: इसके दायित्व अभी भी मौजूद हैं।

segments.src: But its long horizon — the thing that made it worth designing a 10-year vehicle program around — is now provisional, reviewed one year at a time.
segments.tr: लेकिन इसका लंबा क्षितिज — वह चीज़ जिसने इसे 10 साल के वाहन कार्यक्रम को डिजाइन करने लायक बनाया — अब अनंतिम है, जिसकी एक बार में एक वर्ष की समीक्षा की जाती है।

segments.src: Layer the Section 338 duty on top of that, and the message businesses are reading is less about a single 50% number and more about **planning horizon**.
segments.tr: इसके ऊपर धारा 338 शुल्क को जोड़ें, और व्यवसायों द्वारा पढ़ा जा रहा संदेश एक एकल 50% संख्या के बारे में कम और **योजना क्षितिज (planning horizon)** के बारे में अधिक है।

segments.src: A tariff can be reversed next quarter.
segments.tr: एक टैरिफ को अगली तिमाही में वापस लिया जा सकता है।

segments.src: A twelve-month review cycle is a structural feature.
segments.tr: बारह महीने का समीक्षा चक्र एक संरचनात्मक विशेषता है।

segments.src: ## Who feels it, and how unevenly
segments.tr: ## किसे महसूस होता है, और कितनी असमानता से

segments.src: The five categories on the list are not equivalent, and the volumes tell you something about intent.
segments.tr: सूची में पांच श्रेणियां समान नहीं हैं, और मात्राएं आपको इरादे के बारे में कुछ बताती हैं।

segments.src: **Vehicles** are the heavyweight.
segments.tr: **वाहन** सबसे भारी हैं।

segments.src: Canadian assembly plants ship a large share of their output south, and the integrated parts networks around Ontario and Michigan mean components can cross the border several times before a finished car does.
segments.tr: कनाडाई असेंबली प्लांट अपने उत्पादन का एक बड़ा हिस्सा दक्षिण की ओर भेजते हैं, और ओंटारियो और मिशिगन के आसपास एकीकृत पुर्जों के नेटवर्क का मतलब है कि एक तैयार कार के सीमा पार करने से पहले घटक कई बार सीमा पार कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: A duty applied without an origin exemption interacts badly with a supply chain that was deliberately built to be continental.
segments.tr: बिना मूल छूट के लागू एक शुल्क उस आपूर्ति श्रृंखला के साथ खराब तरीके से मेल खाता है जिसे जानबूझकर महाद्वीपीय बनाने के लिए बनाया गया था।

segments.src: **Dairy** is the outlier by volume.
segments.tr: **डेयरी** मात्रा के हिसाब से अलग है।

segments.src: The United States generally runs a *surplus* in dairy trade with Canada — US processors sell more north than Canadian processors sell south.
segments.tr: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका आम तौर पर कनाडा के साथ डेयरी व्यापार में *अधिशेष* रखता है — अमेरिकी प्रोसेसर उत्तर की ओर अधिक बेचते हैं जितना कनाडाई प्रोसेसर दक्षिण की ओर बेचते हैं।

segments.src: A tariff on Canadian dairy therefore isn't primarily about the flow it taxes.
segments.tr: इसलिए कनाडाई डेयरी पर टैरिफ मुख्य रूप से उस प्रवाह के बारे में नहीं है जिस पर यह कर लगाता है।

segments.src: It reads as pressure on a long-running dispute over how Canada allocates its tariff-rate quotas under its supply-management system, an issue that has already been through formal dispute settlement.
segments.tr: यह इस बात पर दबाव के रूप में देखा जाता है कि कनाडा अपने आपूर्ति-प्रबंधन प्रणाली के तहत अपने टैरिफ-दर कोटा को कैसे आवंटित करता है, एक ऐसा मुद्दा जो पहले ही औपचारिक विवाद निपटान से गुजर चुका है।

segments.src: **Wine** is small in dollar terms — Niagara and Okanagan producers ship modest volumes — but highly visible on retail shelves, and it sits inside a broader argument about provincial liquor-board practices that US exporters have complained about for years.
segments.tr: **वाइन** डॉलर के शब्दों में छोटी है — नियाग्रा और ओकनागन उत्पादक मामूली मात्रा में भेजते हैं — लेकिन खुदरा अलमारियों पर अत्यधिक दृश्यमान है, और यह प्रांतीय शराब-बोर्ड प्रथाओं के बारे में एक व्यापक तर्क के भीतर है जिसके बारे में अमेरिकी निर्यातकों ने वर्षों से शिकायत की है।

segments.src: **Cement** is the quiet one with the largest downstream footprint.
segments.tr: **सीमेंट** वह शांत वाला है जिसका सबसे बड़ा डाउनस्ट्रीम प्रभाव है।

segments.src: Canada is among the biggest sources of imported cement in the US, and it moves into Great Lakes, Northeast, and Pacific Northwest markets where the freight economics of alternative suppliers are poor.
segments.tr: कनाडा अमेरिका में आयातित सीमेंट के सबसे बड़े स्रोतों में से एक है, और यह ग्रेट लेक्स, उत्तर-पूर्व और प्रशांत उत्तर-पश्चिम बाजारों में जाता है जहाँ वैकल्पिक आपूर्तिकर्ताओं के माल ढुलाई अर्थशास्त्र खराब हैं।

segments.src: Construction input costs don't make headlines the way car prices do, but they reach further.
segments.tr: निर्माण इनपुट लागतें उस तरह से सुर्खियों में नहीं आतीं जैसे कार की कीमतें आती हैं, लेकिन वे अधिक दूर तक पहुँचती हैं।

segments.src: **Hockey sticks** are the item everyone will remember, and the one with the most instructive complication.
segments.tr: **हॉकी स्टिक्स** वह आइटम है जिसे हर कोई याद रखेगा, और जिसमें सबसे अधिक शिक्षाप्रद जटिलता है।

segments.src: Several of the best-known brands are Canadian in identity and headquarters, while a great deal of composite stick manufacturing happens in Asia.
segments.tr: कई सबसे प्रसिद्ध ब्रांड पहचान और मुख्यालय में कनाडाई हैं, जबकि कंपोजिट स्टिक निर्माण का एक बड़ा हिस्सा एशिया में होता है।

segments.src: Whether a given stick is "Canadian" for customs purposes depends on where it was actually made and how the origin rules treat it — which is to say, the symbolic item on the list is also a small lesson in why origin analysis is harder than a logo.
segments.tr: सीमा शुल्क उद्देश्यों के लिए कोई विशेष स्टिक "कनाडाई" है या नहीं, यह इस बात पर निर्भर करता है कि इसे वास्तव में कहाँ बनाया गया था और मूल नियम इसे कैसे मानते हैं — जिसका अर्थ है कि सूची पर प्रतीकात्मक वस्तु भी यह छोटा सबक है कि मूल विश्लेषण लोगो से अधिक कठिन क्यों है।

segments.src: ## What is still genuinely unsettled
segments.tr: ## क्या अभी भी वास्तव में अनिश्चित है

segments.src: A few things are worth holding loosely until they're confirmed in the operative documents:
segments.tr: कुछ चीजें तब तक ढीली पकड़ने लायक हैं जब तक कि वे परिचालन दस्तावेजों में पुष्ट नहीं हो जातीं:

segments.src: - **Stacking.** Whether the 50% applies on top of existing sector duties, or in place of them, changes the landed cost dramatically. Check the proclamation text and the customs guidance, not summaries.
segments.tr: - **स्टैकिंग।** क्या 50% मौजूदा क्षेत्र शुल्कों के ऊपर लागू होता है, या उनके स्थान पर, इससे लैंडेड लागत नाटकीय रूप से बदल जाती है। सारांशों के बजाय उद्घोषणा पाठ और सीमा शुल्क मार्गदर्शन की जाँच करें।

segments.src: - **Scope by tariff line.** "Cars" and "dairy" are categories in a press summary; what binds is the list of HTS subheadings. Adjacent products often turn out to be in or out in ways the category label doesn't predict.
segments.tr: - **टैरिफ लाइन द्वारा दायरा।** "कारें" और "डेयरी" एक प्रेस सारांश में श्रेणियां हैं; जो बाध्यकारी है वह HTS उप-शीर्षकों की सूची है। आसन्न उत्पाद अक्सर उन तरीकों से अंदर या बाहर होते हैं जिनकी भविष्यवाणी श्रेणी लेबल नहीं करता।

segments.src: - **In-transit treatment.** Actions like this usually specify how goods already on the water or on a rail car are handled. That detail decides who eats the cost on shipments already booked.
segments.tr: - **इन-ट्रांजिट उपचार।** इस तरह की कार्रवाइयां आमतौर पर यह निर्दिष्ट करती हैं कि पानी पर या रेल कार पर पहले से मौजूद सामानों के साथ कैसा व्यवहार किया जाता है। वह विवरण यह तय करता है कि पहले से बुक किए गए शिपमेंट पर लागत कौन उठाएगा।

segments.src: - **Legal challenge.** A statute unused for 96 years has correspondingly little case law defining its limits — the findings required, how specific they must be, and how far judicial review reaches. Litigation is a reasonable expectation, and its outcome is not predictable from the text alone.
segments.tr: - **कानूनी चुनौती।** 96 वर्षों से अप्रयुक्त एक कानून के पास तदनुसार बहुत कम केस कानून है जो इसकी सीमाओं को परिभाषित करता है — आवश्यक खोजें, वे कितने विशिष्ट होने चाहिए, और न्यायिक समीक्षा कितनी दूर तक पहुँचती है। मुकदमेबाजी एक उचित उम्मीद है, और इसका परिणाम केवल पाठ से अनुमानित नहीं किया जा सकता।

segments.src: - **Response.** Canada has its own retaliation authorities and a domestic political timetable of its own. The list above may not be the last list.
segments.tr: - **प्रतिक्रिया।** कनाडा के पास अपने स्वयं के जवाबी अधिकार हैं और उसका अपना घरेलू राजनीतिक समय सारिणी है। ऊपर दी गई सूची अंतिम सूची नहीं हो सकती है।

segments.src: ## What to watch over the next two weeks
segments.tr: ## अगले दो हफ्तों में क्या देखें

segments.src: Between now and August 19, the useful signals are administrative rather than rhetorical: the published proclamation and its annexes, US Customs and Border Protection guidance messages to the trade community, any exclusion or drawback process, and the tariff-line detail.
segments.tr: अब से 19 अगस्त तक, उपयोगी संकेत प्रशासनिक के बजाय अलंकारिक होंगे: प्रकाशित उद्घोषणा और उसके अनुबंध, अमेरिकी सीमा शुल्क और सीमा सुरक्षा (CBP) के व्यापार समुदाय के लिए मार्गदर्शन संदेश, कोई भी बहिष्करण या ड्रॉबैक प्रक्रिया, और टैरिफ-लाइन विवरण।

segments.src: Statements from either capital will move sentiment; the annexes will move invoices.
segments.tr: किसी भी राजधानी से बयान भावनाओं को बदलेंगे; अनुबंध इनवॉइस को बदलेंगे।

segments.src: The longer-term signal is the annual review cycle.
segments.tr: दीर्घकालिक संकेत वार्षिक समीक्षा चक्र है।

segments.src: A single duty on five product categories is a discrete event.
segments.tr: पाँच उत्पाद श्रेणियों पर एक एकल शुल्क एक अलग घटना है।

segments.src: A framework in which the continent's trade rulebook is reconfirmed twelve months at a time is a different operating environment — and it is the part that will still be true after this particular tariff is resolved, whichever way it goes.
segments.tr: एक ढांचा जिसमें महाद्वीप के व्यापार नियमों की पुस्तक को एक बार में बारह महीने के लिए पुष्ट किया जाता है, एक अलग परिचालन वातावरण है — और यह वह हिस्सा है जो इस विशेष टैरिफ के हल होने के बाद भी सच रहेगा, चाहे वह किसी भी तरह से हो।

segments.src: The hockey sticks will get the jokes.
segments.tr: हॉकी स्टिक्स पर चुटकुले होंगे।

segments.src: The certificate of origin is the story.
segments.tr: मूल प्रमाण पत्र ही असली कहानी है।

segments.src: *This article is general information about a public policy development, not legal, tax, customs, or investment advice.
segments.tr: *यह लेख सार्वजनिक नीति विकास के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी है, न कि कानूनी, कर, सीमा शुल्क या निवेश सलाह।

segments.src: Tariff actions change quickly and the operative details are set by the published proclamation and official customs guidance.
segments.tr: टैरिफ कार्रवाइयां तेजी से बदलती हैं और परिचालन विवरण प्रकाशित उद्घोषणा और आधिकारिक सीमा शुल्क मार्गदर्शन द्वारा निर्धारित किए जाते हैं।

segments.src: Importers and exporters should confirm current requirements with the Federal Register, US Customs and Border Protection, and qualified trade counsel before making decisions.*
segments.tr: आयातकों और निर्यातकों को निर्णय लेने से पहले फेडरल रजिस्टर, अमेरिकी सीमा शुल्क और सीमा सुरक्षा, और योग्य व्यापार सलाहकारों के साथ वर्तमान आवश्यकताओं की पुष्टि करनी चाहिए।*

es.title: La ley arancelaria de 1930 que nadie había usado, hasta que los palos de hockey canadienses entraron en la lista

segments.src: For most of the last century, Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 was the kind of provision trade lawyers mentioned at conferences and then moved on from.
segments.tr: Durante la mayor parte del siglo pasado, la Sección 338 de la Ley Arancelaria de 1930 era el tipo de disposición que los abogados comerciales mencionaban en las conferencias y luego dejaban pasar.

segments.src: It is on the books.
segments.tr: Está en los libros.

segments.src: It has real teeth.
segments.tr: Tiene dientes reales.

segments.src: And in roughly 96 years, no president had ever used it to actually put a duty on anything.
segments.tr: Y en aproximadamente 96 años, ningún presidente la había utilizado para imponer realmente un arancel a nada.

segments.src: That changes on **August 19**, when a **50% duty** invoked under Section 338 is scheduled to take effect on a specific list of Canadian goods: passenger vehicles, dairy products, wine, cement — and hockey sticks.
segments.tr: Eso cambia el **19 de agosto**, cuando un **arancel del 50%** invocado bajo la Sección 338 está programado para entrar en vigor sobre una lista específica de bienes canadienses: vehículos de pasajeros, productos lácteos, vino, cemento y palos de hockey.

segments.src: The product list is what gets the headlines.
segments.tr: La lista de productos es lo que acapara los titulares.

segments.src: The legal mechanism is what matters.
segments.tr: El mecanismo legal es lo que importa.

segments.src: ## What Section 338 actually says
segments.tr: ## Lo que dice realmente la Sección 338

segments.src: Section 338 is codified at 19 U.S.C.
segments.tr: La Sección 338 está codificada en 19 U.S.C.

segments.src: § 1338, part of the same 1930 statute better known by the names of its sponsors, Smoot and Hawley.
segments.tr: § 1338, parte del mismo estatuto de 1930 mejor conocido por los nombres de sus patrocinadores, Smoot y Hawley.

segments.src: Its subject is not national security, not trade deficits, and not unfair subsidies.
segments.tr: Su tema no es la seguridad nacional, ni los déficits comerciales, ni los subsidios desleales.

segments.src: It is *discrimination*.
segments.tr: Es la *discriminación*.

segments.src: In plain terms, the provision allows the president to respond when a foreign country is found to impose burdens or restrictions on US commerce that place American exporters at a disadvantage relative to other countries.
segments.tr: En términos sencillos, la disposición permite al presidente responder cuando se descubre que un país extranjero impone cargas o restricciones al comercio de EE. UU. que colocan a los exportadores estadounidenses en desventaja con respecto a otros países.

segments.src: The available responses are unusually blunt for US trade law:
segments.tr: Las respuestas disponibles son inusualmente contundentes para la ley comercial de EE. UU.:

segments.src: - **New or additional duties of up to 50% ad valorem** on that country's products, and
segments.tr: - **Nuevos aranceles o aranceles adicionales de hasta el 50% ad valorem** sobre los productos de ese país, y

segments.src: - in the more extreme case, **exclusion of the goods from entry altogether**.
segments.tr: - en el caso más extremo, la **exclusión total de la entrada de los bienes**.

segments.src: The statute also contemplates a fact-finding role for the US International Trade Commission in identifying such discriminatory practices and reporting them.
segments.tr: El estatuto también contempla un papel de determinación de hechos para la Comisión de Comercio Internacional de EE. UU. al identificar tales prácticas discriminatorias y reportarlas.

segments.src: But compared with the tools Washington has leaned on for the past decade, the procedural runway is short.
segments.tr: Pero en comparación con las herramientas en las que Washington se ha apoyado durante la última década, la pista de despegue procesal es corta.

segments.src: That contrast is the reason this is a story at all.
segments.tr: Ese contraste es la razón por la cual esto es una noticia.

segments.src: **Section 232** requires a Commerce Department national-security investigation.
segments.tr: **La Sección 232** requiere una investigación de seguridad nacional del Departamento de Comercio.

segments.src: **Section 301** requires a formal USTR proceeding, notice, comment, and a hearing.
segments.tr: **La Sección 301** requiere un procedimiento formal de la USTR, notificación, comentarios y una audiencia.

segments.src: Emergency economic powers require a declared emergency — and have drawn sustained litigation over whether the tariff power was ever in that statute to begin with.
segments.tr: Los poderes económicos de emergencia requieren una emergencia declarada, y han generado litigios sostenidos sobre si el poder arancelario estaba alguna vez en ese estatuto para empezar.

segments.src: Section 338 sits outside all of those frameworks, with its own findings requirement and its own ceiling.
segments.tr: La Sección 338 se sitúa fuera de todos esos marcos, con sus propios requisitos de hallazgos y su propio techo.

segments.src: For years, the standard explanation for why nobody used it was that it wasn't needed.
segments.tr: Durante años, la explicación estándar de por qué nadie la usaba era que no era necesaria.

segments.src: The modern toolkit was broader, better-tested in court, and easier to defend.
segments.tr: El conjunto de herramientas moderno era más amplio, estaba mejor probado en los tribunales y era más fácil de defender.

segments.src: The revival of a 1930 authority suggests the calculation has shifted toward statutes that haven't been narrowed by decades of case law — precisely because they haven't been tested.
segments.tr: El renacimiento de una autoridad de 1930 sugiere que el cálculo se ha desplazado hacia estatutos que no han sido restringidos por décadas de jurisprudencia, precisamente porque no han sido probados.

segments.src: ## Why this round is different: the USMCA carve-out is gone
segments.tr: ## Por qué esta ronda es diferente: la excepción del T-MEC ha desaparecido

segments.src: Every significant US tariff action against Canada in recent years came with the same escape hatch.
segments.tr: Cada acción arancelaria significativa de EE. UU. contra Canadá en años recientes vino con la misma vía de escape.

segments.src: If a shipment qualified as originating under the United States–Mexico–Canada Agreement — if it met the rules of origin and the exporter or importer could certify it — the goods came in outside the new duty.
segments.tr: Si un envío calificaba como originario bajo el Acuerdo Estados Unidos-México-Canadá (T-MEC), si cumplía las reglas de origen y el exportador o importador podía certificarlo, los bienes entraban fuera del nuevo arancel.

segments.src: That carve-out did enormous work.
segments.tr: Esa excepción hizo un trabajo enorme.

segments.src: It is why a Canadian-assembled vehicle with a qualifying regional value content was treated differently from an identical-looking vehicle sourced elsewhere.
segments.tr: Es la razón por la cual un vehículo ensamblado en Canadá con un contenido de valor regional calificado era tratado de manera diferente a un vehículo de apariencia idéntica proveniente de otro lugar.

segments.src: It is why compliance departments across the continent spent 2025 and early 2026 rebuilding bills of materials rather than rerouting supply chains.
segments.tr: Es la razón por la cual los departamentos de cumplimiento en todo el continente pasaron 2025 y principios de 2026 reconstruyendo listas de materiales en lugar de redirigir las cadenas de suministro.

segments.src: **The Section 338 action, as announced, contains no such exemption.** A good that satisfies every USMCA rule of origin — a car meeting the regional value content and labor value content thresholds, a cheese produced entirely in Quebec, a stick laid up in an Ontario plant — is covered on the same terms as a good that doesn't.
segments.tr: **La acción de la Sección 338, tal como fue anunciada, no contiene tal exención.** Un bien que satisfaga cada regla de origen del T-MEC —un automóvil que cumpla los umbrales de contenido de valor regional y contenido de valor laboral, un queso producido enteramente en Quebec, un palo fabricado en una planta de Ontario— está cubierto en los mismos términos que un bien que no lo haga.

segments.src: That is the substantive change.
segments.tr: Ese es el cambio sustantivo.

segments.src: Not the rate.
segments.tr: No la tasa.

segments.src: The rate is high, but rates move.
segments.tr: La tasa es alta, pero las tasas se mueven.

segments.src: What moved here is the *status* of a document.
segments.tr: Lo que se movió aquí es el *estatus* de un documento.

segments.src: ## The certificate of origin stops being a shield
segments.tr: ## El certificado de origen deja de ser un escudo

segments.src: Since NAFTA took effect in 1994, and continuing under USMCA from July 2020, North American trade has run on a shared assumption: prove where a good comes from, and the tariff schedule follows automatically.
segments.tr: Desde que el TLCAN entró en vigor en 1994, y continuando bajo el T-MEC desde julio de 2020, el comercio norteamericano ha funcionado bajo un supuesto compartido: demuestra de dónde viene un bien, y el programa arancelario se aplica automáticamente.

segments.src: USMCA even simplified the mechanics, replacing NAFTA's standardized form with a certification of origin that an importer, exporter, or producer can issue based on a set of required data elements.
segments.tr: El T-MEC incluso simplificó la mecánica, reemplazando el formulario estandarizado del TLCAN con una certificación de origen que un importador, exportador o productor puede emitir basándose en un conjunto de elementos de datos requeridos.

segments.src: That certification became the load-bearing beam of continental manufacturing.
segments.tr: Esa certificación se convirtió en la viga de carga de la manufactura continental.

segments.src: Auto programs were sourced around it.
segments.tr: Los programas automotrices se abastecieron en torno a ella.

segments.src: Food processors structured contracts around it.
segments.tr: Los procesadores de alimentos estructuraron contratos en torno a ella.

segments.src: Customs brokers built practices around it.
segments.tr: Los agentes de aduanas construyeron prácticas en torno a ella.

segments.src: A duty that applies regardless of origin certification doesn't repeal any of that.
segments.tr: Un arancel que se aplica independientemente de la certificación de origen no deroga nada de eso.

segments.src: But it does demote it.
segments.tr: Pero sí lo degrada.

segments.src: The paperwork still governs preferential *duty-free* treatment under the agreement.
segments.tr: El papeleo sigue rigiendo el tratamiento preferencial *libre de aranceles* bajo el acuerdo.

segments.src: It no longer guarantees that a shipment escapes whatever else has been layered on top.
segments.tr: Ya no garantiza que un envío escape a cualquier otra cosa que se haya superpuesto.

segments.src: If you want one sentence for why trade counsel are re-reading old statutes this month, it is this: **origin compliance has stopped being a complete answer to the question "what will this cost at the border?"**
segments.tr: Si quieres una frase para saber por qué los asesores comerciales están releyendo viejos estatutos este mes, es esta: **el cumplimiento del origen ha dejado de ser una respuesta completa a la pregunta "¿cuánto costará esto en la frontera?"**

segments.src: ## The joint-review backdrop
segments.tr: ## El trasfondo de la revisión conjunta

segments.src: None of this is happening in a vacuum.
segments.tr: Nada de esto ocurre en el vacío.

segments.src: USMCA was written with a clock in it.
segments.tr: El T-MEC fue escrito con un reloj interno.

segments.src: The agreement entered into force on July 1, 2020, with a 16-year term and a **joint review at the six-year mark** — July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: El acuerdo entró en vigor el 1 de julio de 2020, con un término de 16 años y una **revisión conjunta a los seis años**, el 1 de julio de 2026.

segments.src: If all three parties confirm they want to extend, the term rolls forward another 16 years.
segments.tr: Si las tres partes confirman que quieren extenderlo, el término se prorroga otros 16 años.

segments.src: If they don't, the agreement doesn't collapse; it shifts into a cycle of **annual reviews** running toward a 2036 endpoint, with the parties expected to keep trying to resolve their differences in the meantime.
segments.tr: Si no lo hacen, el acuerdo no colapsa; pasa a un ciclo de **revisiones anuales** que se extienden hasta un punto final en 2036, y se espera que las partes sigan intentando resolver sus diferencias mientras tanto.

segments.src: Washington's decision not to renew the pact in its current form puts the agreement into exactly that annual-review posture.
segments.tr: La decisión de Washington de no renovar el pacto en su forma actual coloca al acuerdo exactamente en esa postura de revisión anual.

segments.src: The treaty is still in force.
segments.tr: El tratado sigue en vigor.

segments.src: Its obligations still exist.
segments.tr: Sus obligaciones siguen existiendo.

segments.src: But its long horizon — the thing that made it worth designing a 10-year vehicle program around — is now provisional, reviewed one year at a time.
segments.tr: Pero su horizonte largo —lo que hacía que valiera la pena diseñar un programa de vehículos de 10 años en torno a él— es ahora provisional, revisado año tras año.

segments.src: Layer the Section 338 duty on top of that, and the message businesses are reading is less about a single 50% number and more about **planning horizon**.
segments.tr: Si se superpone el arancel de la Sección 338 a eso, el mensaje que las empresas están leyendo es menos sobre un número único del 50% y más sobre el **horizonte de planificación**.

segments.src: A tariff can be reversed next quarter.
segments.tr: Un arancel puede revertirse el próximo trimestre.

segments.src: A twelve-month review cycle is a structural feature.
segments.tr: Un ciclo de revisión de doce meses es una característica estructural.

segments.src: ## Who feels it, and how unevenly
segments.tr: ## Quién lo siente y con qué desigualdad

segments.src: The five categories on the list are not equivalent, and the volumes tell you something about intent.
segments.tr: Las cinco categorías de la lista no son equivalentes, y los volúmenes dicen algo sobre la intención.

segments.src: **Vehicles** are the heavyweight.
segments.tr: **Los vehículos** son el peso pesado.

segments.src: Canadian assembly plants ship a large share of their output south, and the integrated parts networks around Ontario and Michigan mean components can cross the border several times before a finished car does.
segments.tr: Las plantas de ensamblaje canadienses envían una gran parte de su producción al sur, y las redes integradas de piezas alrededor de Ontario y Michigan significan que los componentes pueden cruzar la frontera varias veces antes de que un automóvil terminado lo haga.

segments.src: A duty applied without an origin exemption interacts badly with a supply chain that was deliberately built to be continental.
segments.tr: Un arancel aplicado sin una exención de origen interactúa mal con una cadena de suministro que fue deliberadamente construida para ser continental.

segments.src: **Dairy** is the outlier by volume.
segments.tr: **Los lácteos** son la excepción por volumen.

segments.src: The United States generally runs a *surplus* in dairy trade with Canada — US processors sell more north than Canadian processors sell south.
segments.tr: Estados Unidos generalmente tiene un *superávit* en el comercio de lácteos con Canadá: los procesadores estadounidenses venden más al norte que los procesadores canadienses venden al sur.

segments.src: A tariff on Canadian dairy therefore isn't primarily about the flow it taxes.
segments.tr: Por lo tanto, un arancel sobre los lácteos canadienses no se trata principalmente del flujo que grava.

segments.src: It reads as pressure on a long-running dispute over how Canada allocates its tariff-rate quotas under its supply-management system, an issue that has already been through formal dispute settlement.
segments.tr: Se lee como presión sobre una disputa prolongada sobre cómo Canadá asigna sus cuotas arancelarias bajo su sistema de gestión de suministros, un problema que ya ha pasado por una resolución de disputas formal.

segments.src: **Wine** is small in dollar terms — Niagara and Okanagan producers ship modest volumes — but highly visible on retail shelves, and it sits inside a broader argument about provincial liquor-board practices that US exporters have complained about for years.
segments.tr: **El vino** es pequeño en términos monetarios —los productores de Niagara y Okanagan envían volúmenes modestos— pero muy visible en los estantes minoristas, y se encuentra dentro de un argumento más amplio sobre las prácticas de las juntas de licores provinciales de las que los exportadores estadounidenses se han quejado durante años.

segments.src: **Cement** is the quiet one with the largest downstream footprint.
segments.tr: **El cemento** es el silencioso con la mayor huella downstream.

segments.src: Canada is among the biggest sources of imported cement in the US, and it moves into Great Lakes, Northeast, and Pacific Northwest markets where the freight economics of alternative suppliers are poor.
segments.tr: Canadá está entre las mayores fuentes de cemento importado en EE. UU., y se desplaza hacia los mercados de los Grandes Lagos, el Noreste y el Noroeste del Pacífico donde la economía del flete de proveedores alternativos es deficiente.

segments.src: Construction input costs don't make headlines the way car prices do, but they reach further.
segments.tr: Los costos de los insumos de construcción no acaparan los titulares como los precios de los autos, pero llegan más lejos.

segments.src: **Hockey sticks** are the item everyone will remember, and the one with the most instructive complication.
segments.tr: **Los palos de hockey** son el artículo que todos recordarán, y el que tiene la complicación más instructiva.

segments.src: Several of the best-known brands are Canadian in identity and headquarters, while a great deal of composite stick manufacturing happens in Asia.
segments.tr: Varias de las marcas más conocidas son canadienses en identidad y sede, mientras que una gran parte de la fabricación de palos compuestos ocurre en Asia.

segments.src: Whether a given stick is "Canadian" for customs purposes depends on where it was actually made and how the origin rules treat it — which is to say, the symbolic item on the list is also a small lesson in why origin analysis is harder than a logo.
segments.tr: Si un palo determinado es "canadiense" para fines aduaneros depende de dónde fue fabricado realmente y cómo las reglas de origen lo tratan, lo que es decir, el artículo simbólico de la lista es también una pequeña lección de por qué el análisis de origen es más difícil que un logotipo.

segments.src: ## What is still genuinely unsettled
segments.tr: ## Lo que todavía no está genuinamente resuelto

segments.src: A few things are worth holding loosely until they're confirmed in the operative documents:
segments.tr: Vale la pena mantener algunas cosas con cautela hasta que se confirmen en los documentos operativos:

segments.src: - **Stacking.** Whether the 50% applies on top of existing sector duties, or in place of them, changes the landed cost dramatically. Check the proclamation text and the customs guidance, not summaries.
segments.tr: - **Acumulación.** Si el 50% se aplica sobre los aranceles sectoriales existentes, o en lugar de ellos, cambia el costo puesto en destino drásticamente. Revise el texto de la proclama y la guía aduanera, no los resúmenes.

segments.src: - **Scope by tariff line.** "Cars" and "dairy" are categories in a press summary; what binds is the list of HTS subheadings. Adjacent products often turn out to be in or out in ways the category label doesn't predict.
segments.tr: - **Alcance por línea arancelaria.** "Autos" y "lácteos" son categorías en un resumen de prensa; lo que obliga es la lista de subencabezados HTS. Los productos adyacentes a menudo resultan estar dentro o fuera de maneras que la etiqueta de categoría no predice.

segments.src: - **In-transit treatment.** Actions like this usually specify how goods already on the water or on a rail car are handled. That detail decides who eats the cost on shipments already booked.
segments.tr: - **Tratamiento de bienes en tránsito.** Acciones como esta usualmente especifican cómo se manejan los bienes que ya están en el agua o en un vagón de tren. Ese detalle decide quién asume el costo en los envíos ya reservados.
