segments.src: - **Legal challenge.** A statute unused for 96 years has correspondingly little case law defining its limits — the findings required, how specific they must be, and how far judicial review reaches. Litigation is a reasonable expectation, and its outcome is not predictable from the text alone.
segments.tr: - **Desafío legal.** Un estatuto no utilizado durante 96 años tiene correspondientemente poca jurisprudencia que defina sus límites: los hallazgos requeridos, qué tan específicos deben ser y hasta dónde llega la revisión judicial. El litigio es una expectativa razonable, y su resultado no es predecible solo por el texto.

segments.src: - **Response.** Canada has its own retaliation authorities and a domestic political timetable of its own. The list above may not be the last list.
segments.tr: - **Respuesta.** Canadá tiene sus propias autoridades de represalia y un calendario político interno propio. La lista anterior puede no ser la última lista.

segments.src: ## What to watch over the next two weeks
segments.tr: ## Qué observar en las próximas dos semanas

segments.src: Between now and August 19, the useful signals are administrative rather than rhetorical: the published proclamation and its annexes, US Customs and Border Protection guidance messages to the trade community, any exclusion or drawback process, and the tariff-line detail.
segments.tr: Entre ahora y el 19 de agosto, las señales útiles son administrativas más que retóricas: la proclama publicada y sus anexos, los mensajes de guía de la Oficina de Aduanas y Protección Fronteriza de EE. UU. (CBP) a la comunidad comercial, cualquier proceso de exclusión o devolución, y el detalle de la línea arancelaria.

segments.src: Statements from either capital will move sentiment; the annexes will move invoices.
segments.tr: Las declaraciones de cualquiera de las capitales moverán el sentimiento; los anexos moverán las facturas.

segments.src: The longer-term signal is the annual review cycle.
segments.tr: La señal a largo plazo es el ciclo de revisión anual.

segments.src: A single duty on five product categories is a discrete event.
segments.tr: Un solo arancel sobre cinco categorías de productos es un evento discreto.

segments.src: A framework in which the continent's trade rulebook is reconfirmed twelve months at a time is a different operating environment — and it is the part that will still be true after this particular tariff is resolved, whichever way it goes.
segments.tr: Un marco en el que el libro de reglas comerciales del continente se reconfirma cada doce meses es un entorno operativo diferente, y es la parte que seguirá siendo cierta después de que este arancel particular se resuelva, sea cual sea el resultado.

segments.src: The hockey sticks will get the jokes.
segments.tr: Los palos de hockey darán lugar a los chistes.

segments.src: The certificate of origin is the story.
segments.tr: El certificado de origen es la historia.

segments.src: *This article is general information about a public policy development, not legal, tax, customs, or investment advice.
segments.tr: *Este artículo es información general sobre un desarrollo de política pública, no es asesoría legal, fiscal, aduanera o de inversión.

segments.src: Tariff actions change quickly and the operative details are set by the published proclamation and official customs guidance.
segments.tr: Las acciones arancelarias cambian rápidamente y los detalles operativos se establecen en la proclama publicada y la guía aduanera oficial.

segments.src: Importers and exporters should confirm current requirements with the Federal Register, US Customs and Border Protection, and qualified trade counsel before making decisions.*
segments.tr: Los importadores y exportadores deben confirmar los requisitos actuales con el Registro Federal, la Oficina de Aduanas y Protección Fronteriza de EE. UU. y asesores comerciales calificados antes de tomar decisiones.*

ar.title: قانون التعريفات الجمركية لعام 1930 الذي لم يستخدمه أحد — حتى أصبحت عصي الهوكي الكندية على القائمة

segments.src: For most of the last century, Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 was the kind of provision trade lawyers mentioned at conferences and then moved on from.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لمعظم القرن الماضي، كانت المادة 338 من قانون التعريفات الجمركية لعام 1930 من نوع الأحكام التي يذكرها محامو التجارة في المؤتمرات ثم يتجاوزونها.

segments.src: It is on the books.
segments.tr: إنها موجودة في السجلات.

segments.src: It has real teeth.
segments.tr: ولها تأثير حقيقي.

segments.src: And in roughly 96 years, no president had ever used it to actually put a duty on anything.
segments.tr: وفي غضون 96 عامًا تقريبًا، لم يسبق لأي رئيس أن استخدمها لفرض رسوم جمركية فعليًا على أي شيء.

segments.src: That changes on **August 19**, when a **50% duty** invoked under Section 338 is scheduled to take effect on a specific list of Canadian goods: passenger vehicles, dairy products, wine, cement — and hockey sticks.
segments.tr: يتغير ذلك في **19 أغسطس**، عندما من المقرر أن تدخل حيز التنفيذ **رسوم بنسبة 50%** بموجب المادة 338 على قائمة محددة من السلع الكندية: المركبات المخصصة للركاب، ومنتجات الألبان، والنبيذ، والأسمنت — وعصي الهوكي.

segments.src: The product list is what gets the headlines.
segments.tr: قائمة المنتجات هي ما يتصدر العناوين.

segments.src: The legal mechanism is what matters.
segments.tr: لكن الآلية القانونية هي ما يهم.

segments.src: ## What Section 338 actually says
segments.tr: ## ما تقوله المادة 338 فعليًا

segments.src: Section 338 is codified at 19 U.S.C.
segments.tr: المادة 338 مقننة في 19 U.S.C.

segments.src: § 1338, part of the same 1930 statute better known by the names of its sponsors, Smoot and Hawley.
segments.tr: § 1338، وهي جزء من نفس قانون 1930 المعروف بأسماء رعاته، سموت وهوولي.

segments.src: Its subject is not national security, not trade deficits, and not unfair subsidies.
segments.tr: موضوعها ليس الأمن القومي، ولا العجز التجاري، ولا الإعانات غير العادلة.

segments.src: It is *discrimination*.
segments.tr: بل هو *التمييز*.

segments.src: In plain terms, the provision allows the president to respond when a foreign country is found to impose burdens or restrictions on US commerce that place American exporters at a disadvantage relative to other countries.
segments.tr: بعبارات بسيطة، يسمح هذا الحكم للرئيس بالرد عندما يتبين أن دولة أجنبية تفرض أعباءً أو قيودًا على التجارة الأمريكية تضع المصدرين الأمريكيين في وضع غير مؤاتٍ مقارنة بالدول الأخرى.

segments.src: The available responses are unusually blunt for US trade law:
segments.tr: الردود المتاحة حادة بشكل غير عادي بالنسبة لقانون التجارة الأمريكي:

segments.src: - **New or additional duties of up to 50% ad valorem** on that country's products, and
segments.tr: - **رسوم جديدة أو إضافية تصل إلى 50% من القيمة (ad valorem)** على منتجات تلك الدولة، و

segments.src: - in the more extreme case, **exclusion of the goods from entry altogether**.
segments.tr: - في الحالات الأكثر تطرفًا، **منع دخول السلع تمامًا**.

segments.src: The statute also contemplates a fact-finding role for the US International Trade Commission in identifying such discriminatory practices and reporting them.
segments.tr: كما يتوقع القانون دورًا لتقصي الحقائق للجنة التجارة الدولية الأمريكية في تحديد مثل هذه الممارسات التمييزية والإبلاغ عنها.

segments.src: But compared with the tools Washington has leaned on for the past decade, the procedural runway is short.
segments.tr: ولكن مقارنة بالأدوات التي اعتمدت عليها واشنطن في العقد الماضي، فإن المسار الإجرائي قصير.

segments.src: That contrast is the reason this is a story at all.
segments.tr: هذا التباين هو السبب في أن هذه القصة موجودة من الأساس.

segments.src: **Section 232** requires a Commerce Department national-security investigation.
segments.tr: **المادة 232** تتطلب تحقيقًا في الأمن القومي من قبل وزارة التجارة.

segments.src: **Section 301** requires a formal USTR proceeding, notice, comment, and a hearing.
segments.tr: **المادة 301** تتطلب إجراءات رسمية من الممثل التجاري للولايات المتحدة (USTR)، وإخطارًا، وتعليقًا، وجلسة استماع.

segments.src: Emergency economic powers require a declared emergency — and have drawn sustained litigation over whether the tariff power was ever in that statute to begin with.
segments.tr: أما القوى الاقتصادية الطارئة فتتطلب إعلان حالة طوارئ — وقد أثارت تقاضيًا مستمرًا حول ما إذا كانت سلطة فرض التعريفات الجمركية موجودة في ذلك القانون من الأساس.

segments.src: Section 338 sits outside all of those frameworks, with its own findings requirement and its own ceiling.
segments.tr: تقع المادة 338 خارج كل هذه الأطر، ولها متطلبات تقصي حقائق خاصة بها وسقف خاص بها.

segments.src: For years, the standard explanation for why nobody used it was that it wasn't needed.
segments.tr: لسنوات، كان التفسير القياسي لعدم استخدامها هو أنها لم تكن ضرورية.

segments.src: The modern toolkit was broader, better-tested in court, and easier to defend.
segments.tr: كانت مجموعة الأدوات الحديثة أوسع، ومختبرة بشكل أفضل في المحاكم، وأسهل في الدفاع عنها.

segments.src: The revival of a 1930 authority suggests the calculation has shifted toward statutes that haven't been narrowed by decades of case law — precisely because they haven't been tested.
segments.tr: يشير إحياء سلطة من عام 1930 إلى أن الحسابات قد تحولت نحو القوانين التي لم يتم تضييقها بواسطة عقود من السوابق القضائية — تحديدًا لأنها لم تُختبر.

segments.src: ## Why this round is different: the USMCA carve-out is gone
segments.tr: ## لماذا هذه الجولة مختلفة: اختفاء الاستثناء الخاص باتفاقية USMCA

segments.src: Every significant US tariff action against Canada in recent years came with the same escape hatch.
segments.tr: كل إجراء تعريفي أمريكي كبير ضد كندا في السنوات الأخيرة جاء مع نفس مخرج الطوارئ.

segments.src: If a shipment qualified as originating under the United States–Mexico–Canada Agreement — if it met the rules of origin and the exporter or importer could certify it — the goods came in outside the new duty.
segments.tr: إذا كانت الشحنة مؤهلة كمنشأ بموجب اتفاقية الولايات المتحدة والمكسيك وكندا (USMCA) — إذا استوفت قواعد المنشأ وكان المصدر أو المستورد قادرًا على إثبات ذلك — فإن السلع تدخل خارج الرسوم الجديدة.

segments.src: That carve-out did enormous work.
segments.tr: لقد قام هذا الاستثناء بعمل هائل.

segments.src: It is why a Canadian-assembled vehicle with a qualifying regional value content was treated differently from an identical-looking vehicle sourced elsewhere.
segments.tr: ولهذا السبب عوملت المركبة المجمعة في كندا ذات محتوى القيمة الإقليمية المؤهل بشكل مختلف عن مركبة مماثلة المظهر مصدرها مكان آخر.

segments.src: It is why compliance departments across the continent spent 2025 and early 2026 rebuilding bills of materials rather than rerouting supply chains.
segments.tr: ولهذا السبب قضت أقسام الامتثال في جميع أنحاء القارة في عام 2025 وأوائل عام 2026 في إعادة بناء قوائم المواد بدلاً من إعادة توجيه سلاسل التوريد.

segments.src: **The Section 338 action, as announced, contains no such exemption.** A good that satisfies every USMCA rule of origin — a car meeting the regional value content and labor value content thresholds, a cheese produced entirely in Quebec, a stick laid up in an Ontario plant — is covered on the same terms as a good that doesn't.
segments.tr: **إجراء المادة 338، كما تم الإعلان عنه، لا يحتوي على مثل هذا الاستثناء.** السلعة التي تستوفي كل قاعدة منشأ في USMCA — سيارة تستوفي عتبات محتوى القيمة الإقليمية ومحتوى قيمة العمل — جبنة منتجة بالكامل في كيبيك، عصا هوكي مصنعة في مصنع في أونتاريو — يتم تغطيتها بنفس الشروط التي تغطى بها السلعة التي لا تستوفيها.

segments.src: That is the substantive change.
segments.tr: هذا هو التغيير الجوهري.

segments.src: Not the rate.
segments.tr: ليس السعر.

segments.src: The rate is high, but rates move.
segments.tr: السعر مرتفع، لكن الأسعار تتغير.

segments.src: What moved here is the *status* of a document.
segments.tr: ما تغير هنا هو *وضع* المستند.

segments.src: ## The certificate of origin stops being a shield
segments.tr: ## شهادة المنشأ تتوقف عن كونها درعًا

segments.src: Since NAFTA took effect in 1994, and continuing under USMCA from July 2020, North American trade has run on a shared assumption: prove where a good comes from, and the tariff schedule follows automatically.
segments.tr: منذ أن دخلت اتفاقية NAFTA حيز التنفيذ في عام 1994، واستمرارًا تحت اتفاقية USMCA من يوليو 2020، سارت التجارة في أمريكا الشمالية بناءً على افتراض مشترك: أثبت من أين تأتي السلعة، وسوف يتبع جدول التعريفات الجمركية تلقائيًا.

segments.src: USMCA even simplified the mechanics, replacing NAFTA's standardized form with a certification of origin that an importer, exporter, or producer can issue based on a set of required data elements.
segments.tr: بل إن USMCA بسطت الآليات، حيث استبدلت نموذج NAFTA الموحد بشهادة منشأ يمكن للمستورد أو المصدر أو المنتج إصدارها بناءً على مجموعة من عناصر البيانات المطلوبة.

segments.src: That certification became the load-bearing beam of continental manufacturing.
segments.tr: أصبحت هذه الشهادة هي الركيزة الأساسية للتصنيع القاري.

segments.src: Auto programs were sourced around it.
segments.tr: تم توجيه برامج السيارات بناءً عليها.

segments.src: Food processors structured contracts around it.
segments.tr: هيكل معالجو الأغذية عقودهم بناءً عليها.

segments.src: Customs brokers built practices around it.
segments.tr: بنى وسطاء الجمارك ممارساتهم بناءً عليها.

segments.src: A duty that applies regardless of origin certification doesn't repeal any of that.
segments.tr: الرسوم التي تطبق بغض النظر عن شهادة المنشأ لا تلغي أيًا من ذلك.

segments.src: But it does demote it.
segments.tr: لكنها تخفض من قيمتها.

segments.src: The paperwork still governs preferential *duty-free* treatment under the agreement.
segments.tr: لا تزال الأوراق تحكم المعاملة *المعفاة من الرسوم* التفضيلية بموجب الاتفاقية.

segments.src: It no longer guarantees that a shipment escapes whatever else has been layered on top.
segments.tr: لكنها لم تعد تضمن أن الشحنة ستنجو من أي شيء آخر تم فرضه فوقها.

segments.src: If you want one sentence for why trade counsel are re-reading old statutes this month, it is this: **origin compliance has stopped being a complete answer to the question "what will this cost at the border?"**
segments.tr: إذا كنت تريد جملة واحدة تشرح لماذا يعيد المستشارون التجاريون قراءة القوانين القديمة هذا الشهر، فهي هذه: **توقف الامتثال للمنشأ عن كونها إجابة كاملة على سؤال "ماذا ستكون تكلفة هذه السلعة عند الحدود؟"**

segments.src: ## The joint-review backdrop
segments.tr: ## خلفية المراجعة المشتركة

segments.src: None of this is happening in a vacuum.
segments.tr: لا يحدث أي من هذا في فراغ.

segments.src: USMCA was written with a clock in it.
segments.tr: لقد كتبت اتفاقية USMCA وبها ساعة موقوتة.

segments.src: The agreement entered into force on July 1, 2020, with a 16-year term and a **joint review at the six-year mark** — July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: دخلت الاتفاقية حيز التنفيذ في 1 يوليو 2020، بمدة 16 عامًا و**مراجعة مشتركة عند علامة الست سنوات** — 1 يوليو 2026.

segments.src: If all three parties confirm they want to extend, the term rolls forward another 16 years.
segments.tr: إذا أكد جميع الأطراف الثلاثة رغبتهم في التمديد، يتم تمديد المدة لـ 16 عامًا أخرى.

segments.src: If they don't, the agreement doesn't collapse; it shifts into a cycle of **annual reviews** running toward a 2036 endpoint, with the parties expected to keep trying to resolve their differences in the meantime.
segments.tr: إذا لم يفعلوا، فإن الاتفاقية لا تنهار؛ بل تنتقل إلى دورة من **المراجعات السنوية** التي تستمر حتى نقطة النهاية في عام 2036، مع توقع استمرار الأطراف في محاولة حل خلافاتهم في هذه الأثناء.

segments.src: Washington's decision not to renew the pact in its current form puts the agreement into exactly that annual-review posture.
segments.tr: قرار واشنطن بعدم تجديد الميثاق في شكله الحالي يضع الاتفاقية في وضع المراجعة السنوية هذا بالضبط.

segments.src: The treaty is still in force.
segments.tr: المعاهدة لا تزال سارية المفعول.

segments.src: Its obligations still exist.
segments.tr: والتزاماتها لا تزال قائمة.

segments.src: But its long horizon — the thing that made it worth designing a 10-year vehicle program around — is now provisional, reviewed one year at a time.
segments.tr: لكن أفقها الطويل — الشيء الذي جعل من الجدوى تصميم برنامج مركبات لمدة 10 سنوات بناءً عليه — أصبح الآن مؤقتًا، ويتم مراجعته سنة بسنة.

segments.src: Layer the Section 338 duty on top of that, and the message businesses are reading is less about a single 50% number and more about **planning horizon**.
segments.tr: عند إضافة رسوم المادة 338 فوق ذلك، فإن الرسالة التي تقرأها الشركات هي أقل تتعلق برقم 50% واحد وأكثر تتعلق بـ **أفق التخطيط**.

segments.src: A tariff can be reversed next quarter.
segments.tr: يمكن التراجع عن التعريفة الجمركية في الربع القادم.

segments.src: A twelve-month review cycle is a structural feature.
segments.tr: لكن دورة مراجعة مدتها اثنا عشر شهرًا هي ميزة هيكلية.

segments.src: ## Who feels it, and how unevenly
segments.tr: ## من الذي يشعر بالتأثير، وبأي قدر من عدم المساواة

segments.src: The five categories on the list are not equivalent, and the volumes tell you something about intent.
segments.tr: الفئات الخمس الموجودة على القائمة ليست متكافئة، والأحجام تخبرك بشيء عن النية.

segments.src: **Vehicles** are the heavyweight.
segments.tr: **المركبات** هي الوزن الثقيل.

segments.src: Canadian assembly plants ship a large share of their output south, and the integrated parts networks around Ontario and Michigan mean components can cross the border several times before a finished car does.
segments.tr: تشحن مصانع التجميع الكندية جزءًا كبيرًا من إنتاجها جنوبًا، وشبكات الأجزاء المتكاملة حول أونتاريو وميشيغان تعني أن المكونات يمكن أن تعبر الحدود عدة مرات قبل أن تعبر السيارة المكتملة.

segments.src: A duty applied without an origin exemption interacts badly with a supply chain that was deliberately built to be continental.
segments.tr: الرسوم المطبقة بدون استثناء للمنشأ تتفاعل بشكل سيئ مع سلسلة توريد تم بناؤها عمدًا لتكون قارية.

segments.src: **Dairy** is the outlier by volume.
segments.tr: **الألبان** هي الاستثناء من حيث الحجم.

segments.src: The United States generally runs a *surplus* in dairy trade with Canada — US processors sell more north than Canadian processors sell south.
segments.tr: تتمتع الولايات المتحدة عمومًا بـ *فائض* في تجارة الألبان مع كندا — حيث يبيع معالجو الألبان الأمريكيون شمالاً أكثر مما يبيع معالجو الألبان الكنديون جنوبًا.

segments.src: A tariff on Canadian dairy therefore isn't primarily about the flow it taxes.
segments.tr: لذلك، فإن التعريفة الجمركية على الألبان الكندية لا تتعلق في المقام الأول بالتدفق الذي تفرض عليه الضريبة.

segments.src: It reads as pressure on a long-running dispute over how Canada allocates its tariff-rate quotas under its supply-management system, an issue that has already been through formal dispute settlement.
segments.tr: بل تظهر كضغط على نزاع طويل الأمد حول كيفية تخصيص كندا لحصص التعريفة الجمركية بموجب نظام إدارة التوريد الخاص بها، وهي قضية مرت بالفعل عبر تسوية النزاعات الرسمية.

segments.src: **Wine** is small in dollar terms — Niagara and Okanagan producers ship modest volumes — but highly visible on retail shelves, and it sits inside a broader argument about provincial liquor-board practices that US exporters have complained about for years.
segments.tr: **النبيذ** صغير من حيث القيمة المالية — يشحن منتجو نياجرا وأوكاناغان كميات متواضعة — ولكنه مرئي للغاية على أرفف التجزئة، ويقع ضمن جدال أوسع حول ممارسات مجالس الخمور الإقليمية التي اشتكى منها المصدرون الأمريكيون لسنوات.

segments.src: **Cement** is the quiet one with the largest downstream footprint.
segments.tr: **الأسمنت** هو العنصر الهادئ ذو البصمة الأكبر في المراحل اللاحقة.

segments.src: Canada is among the biggest sources of imported cement in the US, and it moves into Great Lakes, Northeast, and Pacific Northwest markets where the freight economics of alternative suppliers are poor.
segments.tr: تعد كندا من بين أكبر مصادر الأسمنت المستورد في الولايات المتحدة، وينتقل إلى أسواق البحيرات العظمى، والشمال الشرقي، والشمال الغربي الهادئ حيث تكون اقتصاديات الشحن من موردين بدلاء ضعيفة.

segments.src: Construction input costs don't make headlines the way car prices do, but they reach further.
segments.tr: تكاليف مدخلات البناء لا تتصدر العناوين كما تفعل أسعار السيارات، لكنها تصل إلى مدى أبعد.

segments.src: **Hockey sticks** are the item everyone will remember, and the one with the most instructive complication.
segments.tr: **عصي الهوكي** هي السلعة التي سيتذكرها الجميع، وهي السلعة ذات التعقيد الأكثر إفادة.

segments.src: Several of the best-known brands are Canadian in identity and headquarters, while a great deal of composite stick manufacturing happens in Asia.
segments.tr: العديد من أشهر العلامات التجارية كندية الهوية والمقر، بينما يتم تصنيع جزء كبير من العصي المركبة في آسيا.

segments.src: Whether a given stick is "Canadian" for customs purposes depends on where it was actually made and how the origin rules treat it — which is to say, the symbolic item on the list is also a small lesson in why origin analysis is harder than a logo.
segments.tr: سواء كانت عصا معينة "كندية" لأغراض الجمارك يعتمد على مكان صنعها فعليًا وكيفية تعامل قواعد المنشأ معها — وهذا يعني أن السلعة الرمزية على القائمة هي أيضًا درس صغير في سبب كون تحليل المنشأ أصعب من مجرد شعار.

segments.src: ## What is still genuinely unsettled
segments.tr: ## ما الذي لا يزال غير محسوم حقًا

segments.src: A few things are worth holding loosely until they're confirmed in the operative documents:
segments.tr: هناك بعض الأشياء التي تستحق الانتظار حتى يتم تأكيدها في المستندات التشغيلية:

segments.src: - **Stacking.** Whether the 50% applies on top of existing sector duties, or in place of them, changes the landed cost dramatically. Check the proclamation text and the customs guidance, not summaries.
segments.tr: - **التراكم.** سواء كانت نسبة 50% تطبق فوق الرسوم القطاعية الحالية، أو بدلاً منها، يغير التكلفة النهائية بشكل كبير. تحقق من نص الإعلان والتعليمات الجمركية، وليس الملخصات.

segments.src: - **Scope by tariff line.** "Cars" and "dairy" are categories in a press summary; what binds is the list of HTS subheadings. Adjacent products often turn out to be in or out in ways the category label doesn't predict.
segments.tr: - **النطاق حسب خط التعريفة.** "السيارات" و"الألبان" هي فئات في ملخص صحفي؛ ما يلزم هو قائمة العناوين الفرعية لـ HTS. غالبًا ما يتبين أن المنتجات المجاورة إما داخل أو خارج القائمة بطرق لا يتوقعها تسمية الفئة.

segments.src: - **In-transit treatment.** Actions like this usually specify how goods already on the water or on a rail car are handled. That detail decides who eats the cost on shipments already booked.
segments.tr: - **معاملة السلع العابرة (In-transit).** عادة ما تحدد هذه الإجراءات كيفية التعامل مع السلع الموجودة بالفعل في البحر أو في عربة قطار. هذا التفصيل يحدد من سيتحمل التكلفة في الشحنات المحجوزة بالفعل.

segments.src: - **Legal challenge.** A statute unused for 96 years has correspondingly little case law defining its limits — the findings required, how specific they must be, and how far judicial review reaches. Litigation is a reasonable expectation, and its outcome is not predictable from the text alone.
segments.tr: - **التحدي القانوني.** قانون لم يستخدم لمدة 96 عامًا لديه سوابق قضائية قليلة جدًا في تحديد حدوده — النتائج المطلوبة، ومدى دقتها، ومدى وصول المراجعة القضائية. التقاضي هو توقع معقول، ونتيجته لا يمكن التنبؤ بها من النص وحده.

segments.src: - **Response.** Canada has its own retaliation authorities and a domestic political timetable of its own. The list above may not be the last list.
segments.tr: - **الرد.** تمتلك كندا سلطات رد انتقامية خاصة بها وجدول زمني سياسي محلي خاص بها. القائمة أعلاه قد لا تكون القائمة الأخيرة.

segments.src: ## What to watch over the next two weeks
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يجب مراقبته خلال الأسبوعين القادمين

segments.src: Between now and August 19, the useful signals are administrative rather than rhetorical: the published proclamation and its annexes, US Customs and Border Protection guidance messages to the trade community, any exclusion or drawback process, and the tariff-line detail.
segments.tr: بين الآن و19 أغسطس، تكون الإشارات المفيدة إدارية بدلاً من خطابية: الإعلان المنشور وملحقاته، رسائل توجيه مصلحة الجمارك وحماية الحدود الأمريكية إلى المجتمع التجاري، أي عملية استثناء أو استرداد، وتفاصيل خط التعريفة.

segments.src: Statements from either capital will move sentiment; the annexes will move invoices.
segments.tr: التصريحات الصادرة من أي من العاصمتين ستؤثر على التوجهات؛ لكن الملحقات هي التي ستؤثر على الفواتير.

segments.src: The longer-term signal is the annual review cycle.
segments.tr: الإشارة طويلة المدى هي دورة المراجعة السنوية.

segments.src: A single duty on five product categories is a discrete event.
segments.tr: فرض رسوم واحدة على خمس فئات من المنتجات هو حدث منفصل.

segments.src: A framework in which the continent's trade rulebook is reconfirmed twelve months at a time is a different operating environment — and it is the part that will still be true after this particular tariff is resolved, whichever way it goes.
segments.tr: أما الإطار الذي يتم فيه إعادة تأكيد كتاب قواعد التجارة القارية كل اثني عشر شهرًا فهو بيئة تشغيلية مختلفة — وهو الجزء الذي سيظل صحيحًا بعد حل هذه التعريفة الجمركية المحددة، بغض النظر عن الطريقة التي يتم بها الحل.

segments.src: The hockey sticks will get the jokes.
segments.tr: عصي الهوكي ستحظى بالنكات.

segments.src: The certificate of origin is the story.
segments.tr: لكن شهادة المنشأ هي القصة الحقيقية.

segments.src: *This article is general information about a public policy development, not legal, tax, customs, or investment advice.
segments.tr: *هذا المقال عبارة عن معلومات عامة حول تطور في السياسة العامة، وليس نصيحة قانونية أو ضريبية أو جمركية أو استثمارية.

segments.src: Tariff actions change quickly and the operative details are set by the published proclamation and official customs guidance.
segments.tr: تتغير الإجراءات التعريفية بسرعة، ويتم تحديد التفاصيل التشغيلية من خلال الإعلان المنشور والتوجيهات الجمركية الرسمية.

segments.src: Importers and exporters should confirm current requirements with the Federal Register, US Customs and Border Protection, and qualified trade counsel before making decisions.*
segments.tr: يجب على المستوردين والمصدرين تأكيد المتطلبات الحالية مع السجل الفيدرالي، ومصلحة الجمارك وحماية الحدود الأمريكية، ومستشار تجاري مؤهل قبل اتخاذ القرارات.*

fr.title: La loi tarifaire de 1930 que personne n'utilisait — jusqu'à ce que les bâtons de hockey canadiens figurent sur la liste

segments.src: For most of the last century, Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 was the kind of provision trade lawyers mentioned at conferences and then moved on from.
segments.tr: Pendant la majeure partie du siècle dernier, l'article 338 de la loi tarifaire de 1930 était le genre de disposition dont les avocats spécialisés en commerce mentionnaient lors de conférences avant de passer à autre chose.

segments.src: It is on the books.
segments.tr: Elle figure dans les textes.

segments.src: It has real teeth.
segments.tr: Elle a un réel pouvoir.

segments.src: And in roughly 96 years, no president had ever used it to actually put a duty on anything.
segments.tr: Et en environ 96 ans, aucun président ne l'a jamais utilisée pour imposer réellement un droit de douane sur quoi que ce soit.

segments.src: That changes on **August 19**, when a **50% duty** invoked under Section 338 is scheduled to take effect on a specific list of Canadian goods: passenger vehicles, dairy products, wine, cement — and hockey sticks.
segments.tr: Cela change le **19 août**, lorsqu'un **droit de 50 %** invoqué en vertu de l'article 338 doit entrer en vigueur sur une liste spécifique de marchandises canadiennes : véhicules de tourisme, produits laitiers, vin, ciment — et bâtons de hockey.

segments.src: The product list is what gets the headlines.
segments.tr: C'est la liste des produits qui fait les gros titres.

segments.src: The legal mechanism is what matters.
segments.tr: C'est le mécanisme juridique qui importe.

segments.src: ## What Section 338 actually says
segments.tr: ## Ce que dit réellement l'article 338

segments.src: Section 338 is codified at 19 U.S.C.
segments.tr: L'article 338 est codifié à 19 U.S.C.

segments.src: § 1338, part of the same 1930 statute better known by the names of its sponsors, Smoot and Hawley.
segments.tr: § 1338, faisant partie du même statut de 1930 mieux connu sous les noms de ses promoteurs, Smoot et Hawley.

segments.src: Its subject is not national security, not trade deficits, and not unfair subsidies.
segments.tr: Son sujet n'est pas la sécurité nationale, ni les déficits commerciaux, ni les subventions déloyales.

segments.src: It is *discrimination*.
segments.tr: Il s'agit de *discrimination*.

segments.src: In plain terms, the provision allows the president to respond when a foreign country is found to impose burdens or restrictions on US commerce that place American exporters at a disadvantage relative to other countries.
segments.tr: En termes simples, la disposition permet au président de réagir lorsqu'il est constaté qu'un pays étranger impose des charges ou des restrictions au commerce des États-Unis qui placent les exportateurs américains dans une position défavorable par rapport à d'autres pays.

segments.src: The available responses are unusually blunt for US trade law:
segments.tr: Les réponses disponibles sont inhabituellement brutales pour le droit commercial des États-Unis :

segments.src: - **New or additional duties of up to 50% ad valorem** on that country's products, and
segments.tr: - **De nouveaux droits ou des droits additionnels allant jusqu'à 50 % ad valorem** sur les produits de ce pays, et

segments.src: - in the more extreme case, **exclusion of the goods from entry altogether**.
segments.tr: - dans le cas le plus extrême, **l'exclusion totale de l'entrée des marchandises**.

segments.src: The statute also contemplates a fact-finding role for the US International Trade Commission in identifying such discriminatory practices and reporting them.
segments.tr: Le statut prévoit également un rôle de recherche de faits pour la Commission du commerce international des États-Unis afin d'identifier de telles pratiques discriminatoires et d'en rendre compte.

segments.src: But compared with the tools Washington has leaned on for the past decade, the procedural runway is short.
segments.tr: Mais comparé aux outils sur lesquels Washington s'est appuyé au cours de la dernière décennie, le délai procédural est court.

segments.src: That contrast is the reason this is a story at all.
segments.tr: Ce contraste est la raison pour laquelle c'est une histoire digne d'intérêt.

segments.src: **Section 232** requires a Commerce Department national-security investigation.
segments.tr: **L'article 232** nécessite une enquête du département du Commerce sur la sécurité nationale.

segments.src: **Section 301** requires a formal USTR proceeding, notice, comment, and a hearing.
segments.tr: **L'article 301** nécessite une procédure formelle de l'USTR, un avis, des commentaires et une audition.

segments.src: Emergency economic powers require a declared emergency — and have drawn sustained litigation over whether the tariff power was ever in that statute to begin with.
segments.tr: Les pouvoirs économiques d'urgence nécessitent l'état d'urgence déclaré — et ont fait l'objet de litiges prolongés sur la question de savoir si le pouvoir tarifaire figurait initialement dans ce statut.

segments.src: Section 338 sits outside all of those frameworks, with its own findings requirement and its own ceiling.
segments.tr: L'article 338 se situe en dehors de tous ces cadres, avec ses propres exigences de constatation et son propre plafond.

segments.src: For years, the standard explanation for why nobody used it was that it wasn't needed.
segments.tr: Pendant des années, l'explication standard pour laquelle personne ne l'utilisait était qu'il n'était pas nécessaire.

segments.src: The modern toolkit was broader, better-tested in court, and easier to defend.
segments.tr: La boîte à outils moderne était plus large, mieux testée devant les tribunaux et plus facile à défendre.

segments.src: The revival of a 1930 authority suggests the calculation has shifted toward statutes that haven't been narrowed by decades of case law — precisely because they haven't been tested.
segments.tr: Le regain d'intérêt pour une autorité de 1930 suggère que le calcul a basculé vers des statuts qui n'ont pas été restreints par des décennies de jurisprudence — précisément parce qu'ils n'ont pas été testés.

segments.src: ## Why this round is different: the USMCA carve-out is gone
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi ce tour est différent : l'exception de l'ACEUM a disparu

segments.src: Every significant US tariff action against Canada in recent years came with the same escape hatch.
segments.tr: Toute action tarifaire américaine significative contre le Canada ces dernières années s'accompagnait de la même issue de secours.

segments.src: If a shipment qualified as originating under the United States–Mexico–Canada Agreement — if it met the rules of origin and the exporter or importer could certify it — the goods came in outside the new duty.
segments.tr: Si une expédition était qualifiée comme originaire selon l'Accord Canada-États-Unis-Mexique (ACEUM) — si elle respectait les règles d'origine et que l'exportateur ou l'importateur pouvait le certifier — les marchandises entraient sans le nouveau droit de douane.

segments.src: That carve-out did enormous work.
segments.tr: Cette exception a joué un rôle énorme.

segments.src: It is why a Canadian-assembled vehicle with a qualifying regional value content was treated differently from an identical-looking vehicle sourced elsewhere.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi un véhicule assemblé au Canada avec un contenu de valeur régionale admissible était traité différemment d'un véhicule d'apparence identique provenant d'ailleurs.

segments.src: It is why compliance departments across the continent spent 2025 and early 2026 rebuilding bills of materials rather than rerouting supply chains.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi les départements de conformité à travers le continent ont passé 2025 et le début de 2026 à reconstruire des nomenclatures de matériaux plutôt qu'à réorienter les chaînes d'approvisionnement.

segments.src: **The Section 338 action, as announced, contains no such exemption.** A good that satisfies every USMCA rule of origin — a car meeting the regional value content and labor value content thresholds, a cheese produced entirely in Quebec, a stick laid up in an Ontario plant — is covered on the same terms as a good that doesn't.
segments.tr: **L'action en vertu de l'article 338, telle qu'annoncée, ne contient aucune exception de ce type.** Un produit qui satisfait à toutes les règles d'origine de l'ACEUM — une voiture respectant les seuils de contenu de valeur régionale et de contenu de valeur de main-d'œuvre, un fromage produit entièrement au Québec, un bâton fabriqué dans une usine de l'Ontario — est couvert aux mêmes conditions qu'un produit qui ne les respecte pas.

segments.src: That is the substantive change.
segments.tr: C'est là le changement substantiel.

segments.src: Not the rate.
segments.tr: Pas le taux.

segments.src: The rate is high, but rates move.
segments.tr: Le taux est élevé, mais les taux varient.

segments.src: What moved here is the *status* of a document.
segments.tr: Ce qui a changé ici, c'est le *statut* d'un document.

segments.src: ## The certificate of origin stops being a shield
segments.tr: ## Le certificat d'origine cesse d'être un bouclier

segments.src: Since NAFTA took effect in 1994, and continuing under USMCA from July 2020, North American trade has run on a shared assumption: prove where a good comes from, and the tariff schedule follows automatically.
segments.tr: Depuis l'entrée en vigueur de l'ALENA en 1994, et se poursuivant sous l'ACEUM à partir de juillet 2020, le commerce nord-américain a fonctionné sur une hypothèse partagée : prouvez d'où vient un produit, et le barème tarifaire s'applique automatiquement.

segments.src: USMCA even simplified the mechanics, replacing NAFTA's standardized form with a certification of origin that an importer, exporter, or producer can issue based on a set of required data elements.
segments.tr: L'ACEUM a même simplifié les mécanismes, remplaçant le formulaire standardisé de l'ALENA par une certification d'origine qu'un importateur, exportateur ou producteur peut délivrer sur la base d'un ensemble d'éléments de données requis.

segments.src: That certification became the load-bearing beam of continental manufacturing.
segments.tr: Cette certification est devenue la poutre porteuse de la fabrication continentale.

segments.src: Auto programs were sourced around it.
segments.tr: Les programmes automobiles ont été sourcés autour d'elle.

segments.src: Food processors structured contracts around it.
segments.tr: Les transformateurs alimentaires ont structuré des contrats autour d'elle.

segments.src: Customs brokers built practices around it.
segments.tr: Les courtiers en douane ont bâti des pratiques autour d'elle.

segments.src: A duty that applies regardless of origin certification doesn't repeal any of that.
segments.tr: Un droit qui s'applique indépendamment de la certification d'origine n'abroge rien de tout cela.

segments.src: But it does demote it.
segments.tr: Mais il le dégrade.

segments.src: The paperwork still governs preferential *duty-free* treatment under the agreement.
segments.tr: La paperasse régit toujours le traitement préférentiel *hors droits de douane* en vertu de l'accord.

segments.src: It no longer guarantees that a shipment escapes whatever else has been layered on top.
segments.tr: Elle ne garantit plus qu'une expédition échappe à tout ce qui a été ajouté par-dessus.

segments.src: If you want one sentence for why trade counsel are re-reading old statutes this month, it is this: **origin compliance has stopped being a complete answer to the question "what will this cost at the border?"**
segments.tr: Si vous voulez une phrase pour expliquer pourquoi les conseillers commerciaux relisent les anciens statuts ce mois-ci, c'est celle-ci : **la conformité à l'origine a cessé d'être une réponse complète à la question "combien cela coûtera-t-il à la frontière ?"**

segments.src: ## The joint-review backdrop
segments.tr: ## Le contexte de la revue conjointe

segments.src: None of this is happening in a vacuum.
segments.tr: Rien de tout cela ne se produit dans le vide.

segments.src: USMCA was written with a clock in it.
segments.tr: L'ACEUM a été écrit avec un chronomètre intégré.

segments.src: The agreement entered into force on July 1, 2020, with a 16-year term and a **joint review at the six-year mark** — July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: L'accord est entré en vigueur le 1er juillet 2020, pour un terme de 16 ans et une **revue conjointe au bout de six ans** — le 1er juillet 2026.

segments.src: If all three parties confirm they want to extend, the term rolls forward another 16 years.
segments.tr: Si les trois parties confirment qu'elles souhaitent prolonger, le terme est reconduit pour 16 ans supplémentaires.

segments.src: If they don't, the agreement doesn't collapse; it shifts into a cycle of **annual reviews** running toward a 2036 endpoint, with the parties expected to keep trying to resolve their differences in the meantime.
segments.tr: Si elles ne le font pas, l'accord ne s'effondre pas ; il passe dans un cycle de **revues annuelles** allant jusqu'à un point final en 2036, les parties devant continuer à essayer de résoudre leurs différends entre-temps.

segments.src: Washington's decision not to renew the pact in its current form puts the agreement into exactly that annual-review posture.
segments.tr: La décision de Washington de ne pas renouveler le pacte sous sa forme actuelle place l'accord exactement dans cette posture de revue annuelle.

segments.src: The treaty is still in force.
segments.tr: Le traité est toujours en vigueur.

segments.src: Its obligations still exist.
segments.tr: Ses obligations existent toujours.

segments.src: But its long horizon — the thing that made it worth designing a 10-year vehicle program around — is now provisional, reviewed one year at a time.
segments.tr: Mais son horizon lointain — la chose qui rendait valable la conception d'un programme de véhicules sur 10 ans — est désormais provisoire, revu un an après l'autre.

segments.src: Layer the Section 338 duty on top of that, and the message businesses are reading is less about a single 50% number and more about **planning horizon**.
segments.tr: Ajoutez le droit de l'article 338 par-dessus, et le message que les entreprises lisent est moins une question de chiffre unique de 50 % et plus une question d'**horizon de planification**.

segments.src: A tariff can be reversed next quarter.
segments.tr: Un tarif peut être annulé au prochain trimestre.

segments.src: A twelve-month review cycle is a structural feature.
segments.tr: Un cycle de revue de douze mois est une caractéristique structurelle.

segments.src: ## Who feels it, and how unevenly
segments.tr: ## Qui est touché, et avec quelle inégalité

segments.src: The five categories on the list are not equivalent, and the volumes tell you something about intent.
segments.tr: Les cinq catégories de la liste ne sont pas équivalentes, et les volumes en disent long sur l'intention.

segments.src: **Vehicles** are the heavyweight.
segments.tr: **Les véhicules** sont le poids lourd.

segments.src: Canadian assembly plants ship a large share of their output south, and the integrated parts networks around Ontario and Michigan mean components can cross the border several times before a finished car does.
segments.tr: Les usines d'assemblage canadiennes expédient une grande part de leur production vers le sud, et les réseaux de pièces intégrés autour de l'Ontario et du Michigan signifient que les composants peuvent traverser la frontière plusieurs fois avant qu'une voiture finie ne le fasse.

segments.src: A duty applied without an origin exemption interacts badly with a supply chain that was deliberately built to be continental.
segments.tr: Un droit appliqué sans exemption d'origine interagit mal avec une chaîne d'approvisionnement qui a été délibérément construite pour être continentale.

segments.src: **Dairy** is the outlier by volume.
segments.tr: **Les produits laitiers** sont l'exception par le volume.

segments.src: The United States generally runs a *surplus* in dairy trade with Canada — US processors sell more north than Canadian processors sell south.
segments.tr: Les États-Unis ont généralement un *excédent* commercial en produits laitiers avec le Canada — les transformateurs américains vendent plus vers le nord que les transformateurs canadiens ne vendent vers le sud.

segments.src: A tariff on Canadian dairy therefore isn't primarily about the flow it taxes.
segments.tr: Un tarif sur les produits laitiers canadiens n'est donc pas principalement lié au flux qu'il taxe.

segments.src: It reads as pressure on a long-running dispute over how Canada allocates its tariff-rate quotas under its supply-management system, an issue that has already been through formal dispute settlement.
segments.tr: Il est perçu comme une pression sur un litige de longue date concernant la manière dont le Canada alloue ses contingents tarifaires dans le cadre de son système de gestion de l'offre, un problème qui a déjà fait l'objet d'un règlement formel des différends.

segments.src: **Wine** is small in dollar terms — Niagara and Okanagan producers ship modest volumes — but highly visible on retail shelves, and it sits inside a broader argument about provincial liquor-board practices that US exporters have complained about for years.
segments.tr: **Le vin** est faible en termes de dollars — les producteurs de Niagara et d'Okanagan expédient des volumes modestes — mais très visible sur les rayons des magasins, et s'inscrit dans un argument plus large sur les pratiques des régies provinciales des alcools qui ont fait l'objet de plaintes d'exportateurs américains pendant des années.

segments.src: **Cement** is the quiet one with the largest downstream footprint.
segments.tr: **Le ciment** est l'élément discret avec la plus grande empreinte en aval.

segments.src: Canada is among the biggest sources of imported cement in the US, and it moves into Great Lakes, Northeast, and Pacific Northwest markets where the freight economics of alternative suppliers are poor.
segments.tr: Le Canada figure parmi les plus grandes sources de ciment importé aux États-Unis, et il s'écoule vers les marchés des Grands Lacs, du Nord-Est et du Nord-Ouest Pacifique où l'économie du fret des fournisseurs alternatifs est médiocre.

segments.src: Construction input costs don't make headlines the way car prices do, but they reach further.
segments.tr: Les coûts des intrants de construction ne font pas les gros titres comme les prix des voitures, mais ils ont une portée plus large.

segments.src: **Hockey sticks** are the item everyone will remember, and the one with the most instructive complication.
segments.tr: **Les bâtons de hockey** sont l'article dont tout le monde se souviendra, et celui qui présente la complication la plus instructive.

segments.src: Several of the best-known brands are Canadian in identity and headquarters, while a great deal of composite stick manufacturing happens in Asia.
segments.tr: Plusieurs des marques les plus connues sont canadiennes par identité et siège social, tandis qu'une grande partie de la fabrication de bâtons composites se fait en Asie.

segments.src: Whether a given stick is "Canadian" for customs purposes depends on where it was actually made and how the origin rules treat it — which is to say, the symbolic item on the list is also a small lesson in why origin analysis is harder than a logo.
segments.tr: Le fait qu'un bâton donné soit "canadien" aux fins douanières dépend de l'endroit où il a été réellement fabriqué et de la manière dont les règles d'origine le traitent — c'est-à-dire que l'article symbolique de la liste est également une petite leçon sur le fait que l'analyse de l'origine est plus difficile qu'un logo.

segments.src: ## What is still genuinely unsettled
segments.tr: ## Ce qui reste véritablement incertain

segments.src: A few things are worth holding loosely until they're confirmed in the operative documents:
segments.tr: Quelques points méritent d'être suivis avec prudence jusqu'à ce qu'ils soient confirmés dans les documents opérationnels :

segments.src: - **Stacking.** Whether the 50% applies on top of existing sector duties, or in place of them, changes the landed cost dramatically. Check the proclamation text and the customs guidance, not summaries.
segments.tr: - **Le cumul.** Si les 50 % s'appliquent en plus des droits sectoriels existants, ou à leur place, change radicalement le coût rendu. Vérifiez le texte de la proclamation et les directives douanières, pas les résumés.

segments.src: - **Scope by tariff line.** "Cars" and "dairy" are categories in a press summary; what binds is the list of HTS subheadings. Adjacent products often turn out to be in or out in ways the category label doesn't predict.
segments.tr: - **La portée par ligne tarifaire.** "Voitures" et "produits laitiers" sont des catégories dans un résumé de presse ; ce qui lie est la liste des sous-positions du HTS. Les produits adjacents s'avèrent souvent être inclus ou exclus de manières que l'étiquette de catégorie ne prédit pas.

segments.src: - **In-transit treatment.** Actions like this usually specify how goods already on the water or on a rail car are handled. That detail decides who eats the cost on shipments already booked.
segments.tr: - **Le traitement des marchandises en transit.** Des actions comme celle-ci précisent généralement comment les marchandises déjà sur l'eau ou dans un wagon de train sont traitées. Ce détail décide qui supporte le coût sur les expéditions déjà réservées.

segments.src: - **Legal challenge.** A statute unused for 96 years has correspondingly little case law defining its limits — the findings required, how specific they must be, and how far judicial review reaches. Litigation is a reasonable expectation, and its outcome is not predictable from the text alone.
segments.tr: - **Le défi juridique.** Un statut inutilisé depuis 96 ans a proportionnellement peu de jurisprudence définissant ses limites — les constatations requises, leur degré de précision et la portée du contrôle judiciaire. Le litige est une attente raisonnable, et son résultat n'est pas prévisible à partir du texte seul.

segments.src: - **Response.** Canada has its own retaliation authorities and a domestic political timetable of its own. The list above may not be the last list.
segments.tr: - **La réponse.** Le Canada a ses propres autorités de représailles et son propre calendrier politique intérieur. La liste ci-dessus peut ne pas être la dernière liste.

segments.src: ## What to watch over the next two weeks
segments.tr: ## À surveiller au cours des deux prochaines semaines

segments.src: Between now and August 19, the useful signals are administrative rather than rhetorical: the published proclamation and its annexes, US Customs and Border Protection guidance messages to the trade community, any exclusion or drawback process, and the tariff-line detail.
segments.tr: D'ici le 19 août, les signaux utiles sont administratifs plutôt que rhétoriques : la proclamation publiée et ses annexes, les messages d'orientation du Customs and Border Protection des États-Unis à la communauté commerciale, tout processus d'exclusion ou de remboursement, et le détail des lignes tarifaires.

segments.src: Statements from either capital will move sentiment; the annexes will move invoices.
segments.tr: Les déclarations des deux capitales influenceront le sentiment ; les annexes influenceront les factures.

segments.src: The longer-term signal is the annual review cycle.
segments.tr: Le signal à plus long terme est le cycle de revue annuelle.

segments.src: A single duty on five product categories is a discrete event.
segments.tr: Un droit unique sur cinq catégories de produits est un événement discret.

segments.src: A framework in which the continent's trade rulebook is reconfirmed twelve months at a time is a different operating environment — and it is the part that will still be true after this particular tariff is resolved, whichever way it goes.
segments.tr: Un cadre dans lequel le règlement commercial du continent est reconfirmé tous les douze mois est un environnement opérationnel différent — et c'est la partie qui restera vraie après que ce tarif particulier aura été résolu, quelle que soit l'issue.

segments.tr: Les bâtons de hockey feront l'objet de blagues.

pt.title: A Lei Tarifária de 1930 que Ninguém Usava — Até que os Tacos de Hóquei Canadenses Entraram na Lista

segments.src: For most of the last century, Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 was the kind of provision trade lawyers mentioned at conferences and then moved on from.
segments.tr: Durante a maior parte do século passado, a Seção 338 da Lei Tarifária de 1930 era o tipo de disposição que os advogados de comércio mencionavam em conferências e depois ignoravam.

segments.src: It is on the books.
segments.tr: Ela está nos livros.

segments.src: It has real teeth.
segments.tr: Ela tem dentes reais.

segments.src: And in roughly 96 years, no president had ever used it to actually put a duty on anything.
segments.tr: E em aproximadamente 96 anos, nenhum presidente jamais a utilizou para realmente aplicar uma tarifa sobre qualquer coisa.

segments.src: That changes on **August 19**, when a **50% duty** invoked under Section 338 is scheduled to take effect on a specific list of Canadian goods: passenger vehicles, dairy products, wine, cement — and hockey sticks.
segments.tr: Isso muda em **19 de agosto**, quando uma **tarifa de 50%** invocada sob a Seção 338 está programada para entrar em vigor sobre uma lista específica de produtos canadenses: veículos de passageiros, produtos lácteos, vinho, cimento — e tacos de hóquei.

segments.src: The product list is what gets the headlines.
segments.tr: A lista de produtos é o que gera as manchetes.

segments.src: The legal mechanism is what matters.
segments.tr: O mecanismo legal é o que importa.

segments.src: ## What Section 338 actually says
segments.tr: ## O que a Seção 338 realmente diz

segments.src: Section 338 is codified at 19 U.S.C.
segments.tr: A Seção 338 está codificada em 19 U.S.C.

segments.src: § 1338, part of the same 1930 statute better known by the names of its sponsors, Smoot and Hawley.
segments.tr: § 1338, parte do mesmo estatuto de 1930 melhor conhecido pelos nomes de seus patrocinadores, Smoot e Hawley.

segments.src: Its subject is not national security, not trade deficits, and not unfair subsidies.
segments.tr: Seu assunto não é a segurança nacional, nem déficits comerciais, nem subsídios desleais.

segments.src: It is *discrimination*.
segments.tr: É *discriminação*.

segments.src: In plain terms, the provision allows the president to respond when a foreign country is found to impose burdens or restrictions on US commerce that place American exporters at a disadvantage relative to other countries.
segments.tr: Em termos simples, a disposição permite que o presidente responda quando for constatado que um país estrangeiro impõe ônus ou restrições ao comércio dos EUA que coloquem os exportadores americanos em desvantagem em relação a outros países.

segments.src: The available responses are unusually blunt for US trade law:
segments.tr: As respostas disponíveis são excepcionalmente bruscas para a lei comercial dos EUA:

segments.src: - **New or additional duties of up to 50% ad valorem** on that country's products, and
segments.tr: - **Novas tarifas ou tarifas adicionais de até 50% ad valorem** sobre os produtos desse país, e

segments.src: - in the more extreme case, **exclusion of the goods from entry altogether**.
segments.tr: - no caso mais extremo, **exclusão total da entrada das mercadorias**.

segments.src: The statute also contemplates a fact-finding role for the US International Trade Commission in identifying such discriminatory practices and reporting them.
segments.tr: O estatuto também prevê um papel de apuração de fatos para a Comissão de Comércio Internacional dos EUA na identificação de tais práticas discriminatórias e no relato delas.

segments.src: But compared with the tools Washington has leaned on for the past decade, the procedural runway is short.
segments.tr: Mas, comparado com as ferramentas nas quais Washington se apoiou na última década, a pista processual é curta.

segments.src: That contrast is the reason this is a story at all.
segments.tr: Esse contraste é a razão pela qual isso é uma notícia.

segments.src: **Section 232** requires a Commerce Department national-security investigation.
segments.tr: **Seção 232** requer uma investigação de segurança nacional do Departamento de Comércio.

segments.src: **Section 301** requires a formal USTR proceeding, notice, comment, and a hearing.
segments.tr: **Seção 301** requer um processo formal do USTR, notificação, comentário e uma audiência.

segments.src: Emergency economic powers require a declared emergency — and have drawn sustained litigation over whether the tariff power was ever in that statute to begin with.
segments.tr: Poderes econômicos de emergência requerem uma emergência declarada — e atraíram litígios sustentados sobre se o poder tarifário estava sequer naquele estatuto para começar.

segments.src: Section 338 sits outside all of those frameworks, with its own findings requirement and its own ceiling.
segments.tr: A Seção 338 situa-se fora de todas essas estruturas, com seus próprios requisitos de constatação e seu próprio teto.

segments.src: For years, the standard explanation for why nobody used it was that it wasn't needed.
segments.tr: Por anos, a explicação padrão para o motivo de ninguém a usar era que ela não era necessária.

segments.src: The modern toolkit was broader, better-tested in court, and easier to defend.
segments.tr: O kit de ferramentas moderno era mais amplo, melhor testado em tribunal e mais fácil de defender.

segments.src: The revival of a 1930 authority suggests the calculation has shifted toward statutes that haven't been narrowed by decades of case law — precisely because they haven't been tested.
segments.tr: O renascimento de uma autoridade de 1930 sugere que o cálculo mudou para estatutos que não foram restringidos por décadas de jurisprudência — precisamente porque não foram testados.

segments.src: ## Why this round is different: the USMCA carve-out is gone
segments.tr: ## Por que esta rodada é diferente: a isenção do USMCA desapareceu

segments.src: Every significant US tariff action against Canada in recent years came with the same escape hatch.
segments.tr: Toda ação tarifária significativa dos EUA contra o Canadá nos últimos anos veio com a mesma saída de emergência.

segments.src: If a shipment qualified as originating under the United States–Mexico–Canada Agreement — if it met the rules of origin and the exporter or importer could certify it — the goods came in outside the new duty.
segments.tr: Se uma remessa se qualificasse como originária sob o Acordo Estados Unidos-México-Canadá (USMCA) — se atendesse às regras de origem e o exportador ou importador pudesse certificá-la — as mercadorias entravam fora da nova tarifa.

segments.src: That carve-out did enormous work.
segments.tr: Essa isenção fez um trabalho enorme.

segments.src: It is why a Canadian-assembled vehicle with a qualifying regional value content was treated differently from an identical-looking vehicle sourced elsewhere.
segments.tr: É por isso que um veículo montado no Canadá com um conteúdo de valor regional qualificado era tratado diferentemente de um veículo de aparência idêntica proveniente de outro lugar.

segments.src: It is why compliance departments across the continent spent 2025 and early 2026 rebuilding bills of materials rather than rerouting supply chains.
segments.tr: É por isso que os departamentos de conformidade em todo o continente passaram 2025 e o início de 2026 reconstruindo listas de materiais em vez de redirecionar cadeias de suprimentos.

segments.src: **The Section 338 action, as announced, contains no such exemption.** A good that satisfies every USMCA rule of origin — a car meeting the regional value content and labor value content thresholds, a cheese produced entirely in Quebec, a stick laid up in an Ontario plant — is covered on the same terms as a good that doesn't.
segments.tr: **A ação da Seção 338, conforme anunciada, não contém tal isenção.** Um produto que satisfaça todas as regras de origem do USMCA — um carro que atenda aos limites de conteúdo de valor regional e conteúdo de valor trabalhista, um queijo produzido inteiramente em Quebec, um taco fabricado em uma planta de Ontário — é coberto nos mesmos termos que um produto que não atenda.

segments.src: That is the substantive change.
segments.tr: Essa é a mudança substantiva.

segments.src: Not the rate.
segments.tr: Não a taxa.

segments.src: The rate is high, but rates move.
segments.tr: A taxa é alta, mas taxas mudam.

segments.src: What moved here is the *status* of a document.
segments.tr: O que mudou aqui foi o *status* de um documento.

segments.src: ## The certificate of origin stops being a shield
segments.tr: ## O certificado de origem deixa de ser um escudo

segments.src: Since NAFTA took effect in 1994, and continuing under USMCA from July 2020, North American trade has run on a shared assumption: prove where a good comes from, and the tariff schedule follows automatically.
segments.tr: Desde que o NAFTA entrou em vigor em 1994, e continuando sob o USMCA a partir de julho de 2020, o comércio norte-americano operou sob uma suposição compartilhada: prove onde um produto vem, e a tabela tarifária segue automaticamente.

segments.src: USMCA even simplified the mechanics, replacing NAFTA's standardized form with a certification of origin that an importer, exporter, or producer can issue based on a set of required data elements.
segments.tr: O USMCA até simplificou a mecânica, substituindo o formulário padronizado do NAFTA por uma certificação de origem que um importador, exportador ou produtor pode emitir com base em um conjunto de elementos de dados exigidos.

segments.src: That certification became the load-bearing beam of continental manufacturing.
segments.tr: Essa certificação tornou-se a viga de sustentação da manufatura continental.

segments.src: Auto programs were sourced around it.
segments.tr: Programas automotivos foram estruturados em torno dela.

segments.src: Food processors structured contracts around it.
segments.tr: Processadores de alimentos estruturaram contratos em torno dela.

segments.src: Customs brokers built practices around it.
segments.tr: Despachantes aduaneiros construíram práticas em torno dela.

segments.src: A duty that applies regardless of origin certification doesn't repeal any of that.
segments.tr: Uma tarifa que se aplica independentemente da certificação de origem não revoga nada disso.

segments.src: But it does demote it.
segments.tr: Mas ela a rebaixa.

segments.src: The paperwork still governs preferential *duty-free* treatment under the agreement.
segments.tr: A papelada ainda rege o tratamento preferencial *isento de impostos* sob o acordo.

segments.src: It no longer guarantees that a shipment escapes whatever else has been layered on top.
segments.tr: Ela não garante mais que uma remessa escape de qualquer outra coisa que tenha sido adicionada por cima.

segments.src: If you want one sentence for why trade counsel are re-reading old statutes this month, it is this: **origin compliance has stopped being a complete answer to the question "what will this cost at the border?"**
segments.tr: Se você quiser uma frase para explicar por que os consultores comerciais estão relendo estatutos antigos este mês, é esta: **a conformidade de origem deixou de ser uma resposta completa para a pergunta "quanto isso custará na fronteira?"**

segments.src: ## The joint-review backdrop
segments.tr: ## O cenário da revisão conjunta

segments.src: None of this is happening in a vacuum.
segments.tr: Nada disso está acontecendo no vácuo.

segments.src: USMCA was written with a clock in it.
segments.tr: O USMCA foi escrito com um cronômetro.

segments.src: The agreement entered into force on July 1, 2020, with a 16-year term and a **joint review at the six-year mark** — July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: O acordo entrou em vigor em 1º de julho de 2020, com um prazo de 16 anos e uma **revisão conjunta na marca de seis anos** — 1º de julho de 2026.

segments.src: If all three parties confirm they want to extend, the term rolls forward another 16 years.
segments.tr: Se todas as três partes confirmarem que desejam prorrogar, o prazo avança mais 16 anos.

segments.src: If they don't, the agreement doesn't collapse; it shifts into a cycle of **annual reviews** running toward a 2036 endpoint, with the parties expected to keep trying to resolve their differences in the meantime.
segments.tr: Se não, o acordo não colapsa; ele muda para um ciclo de **revisões anuais** que correm até um ponto final em 2036, com as partes esperando continuar tentando resolver suas diferenças nesse ínterim.

segments.src: Washington's decision not to renew the pact in its current form puts the agreement into exactly that annual-review posture.
segments.tr: A decisão de Washington de não renovar o pacto em sua forma atual coloca o acordo exatamente nessa postura de revisão anual.

segments.src: The treaty is still in force.
segments.tr: O tratado ainda está em vigor.

segments.src: Its obligations still exist.
segments.tr: Suas obrigações ainda existem.

segments.src: But its long horizon — the thing that made it worth designing a 10-year vehicle program around — is now provisional, reviewed one year at a time.
segments.tr: Mas seu longo horizonte — a coisa que tornou vantajoso projetar um programa de veículos de 10 anos em torno dele — agora é provisório, revisado um ano de cada vez.

segments.src: Layer the Section 338 duty on top of that, and the message businesses are reading is less about a single 50% number and more about **planning horizon**.
segments.tr: Adicione a tarifa da Seção 338 a isso, e a mensagem que as empresas estão lendo é menos sobre um único número de 50% e mais sobre o **horizonte de planejamento**.

segments.src: A tariff can be reversed next quarter.
segments.tr: Uma tarifa pode ser revertida no próximo trimestre.

segments.src: A twelve-month review cycle is a structural feature.
segments.tr: Um ciclo de revisão de doze meses é uma característica estrutural.

segments.src: ## Who feels it, and how unevenly
segments.tr: ## Quem sente e quão desigualmente

segments.src: The five categories on the list are not equivalent, and the volumes tell you something about intent.
segments.tr: As cinco categorias na lista não são equivalentes, e os volumes dizem algo sobre a intenção.

segments.src: **Vehicles** are the heavyweight.
segments.tr: **Veículos** são o peso pesado.

segments.src: Canadian assembly plants ship a large share of their output south, and the integrated parts networks around Ontario and Michigan mean components can cross the border several times before a finished car does.
segments.tr: As plantas de montagem canadenses enviam uma grande parte de sua produção para o sul, e as redes integradas de peças em torno de Ontário e Michigan significam que componentes podem cruzar a fronteira várias vezes antes de um carro finalizado fazê-lo.

segments.src: A duty applied without an origin exemption interacts badly with a supply chain that was deliberately built to be continental.
segments.tr: Uma tarifa aplicada sem isenção de origem interage mal com uma cadeia de suprimentos que foi deliberadamente construída para ser continental.

segments.src: **Dairy** is the outlier by volume.
segments.tr: **Laticínios** são a exceção por volume.

segments.src: The United States generally runs a *surplus* in dairy trade with Canada — US processors sell more north than Canadian processors sell south.
segments.tr: Os Estados Unidos geralmente têm um *superávit* no comércio de laticínios com o Canadá — processadores dos EUA vendem mais para o norte do que processadores canadenses vendem para o sul.

segments.src: A tariff on Canadian dairy therefore isn't primarily about the flow it taxes.
segments.tr: Uma tarifa sobre laticínios canadenses, portanto, não é primariamente sobre o fluxo que ela tributa.

segments.src: It reads as pressure on a long-running dispute over how Canada allocates its tariff-rate quotas under its supply-management system, an issue that has already been through formal dispute settlement.
segments.tr: Ela é lida como pressão sobre uma disputa de longa data sobre como o Canadá aloca suas cotas tarifárias sob seu sistema de gestão de oferta, uma questão que já passou por resolução de disputas formal.

segments.src: **Wine** is small in dollar terms — Niagara and Okanagan producers ship modest volumes — but highly visible on retail shelves, and it sits inside a broader argument about provincial liquor-board practices that US exporters have complained about for years.
segments.tr: **Vinho** é pequeno em termos de dólares — produtores de Niagara e Okanagan enviam volumes modestos — mas altamente visível nas prateleiras de varejo, e está inserido em um argumento mais amplo sobre as práticas dos conselhos provinciais de bebidas alcoólicas que os exportadores dos EUA reclamam há anos.

segments.src: **Cement** is the quiet one with the largest downstream footprint.
segments.tr: **Cimento** é o silencioso com a maior pegada a jusante.

segments.src: Canada is among the biggest sources of imported cement in the US, and it moves into Great Lakes, Northeast, and Pacific Northwest markets where the freight economics of alternative suppliers are poor.
segments.tr: O Canadá está entre as maiores fontes de cimento importado nos EUA, e ele se move para os mercados dos Grandes Lagos, Nordeste e Noroeste do Pacífico, onde a economia do frete de fornecedores alternativos é ruim.

segments.src: Construction input costs don't make headlines the way car prices do, but they reach further.
segments.tr: Os custos de insumos de construção não geram manchetes como os preços dos carros, mas alcançam mais longe.

segments.src: **Hockey sticks** are the item everyone will remember, and the one with the most instructive complication.
segments.tr: **Tacos de hóquei** são o item que todos lembrarão, e aquele com a complicação mais instrutiva.

segments.src: Several of the best-known brands are Canadian in identity and headquarters, while a great deal of composite stick manufacturing happens in Asia.
segments.tr: Várias das marcas mais conhecidas são canadenses em identidade e sede, enquanto grande parte da fabricação de tacos compostos acontece na Ásia.

segments.src: Whether a given stick is "Canadian" for customs purposes depends on where it was actually made and how the origin rules treat it — which is to say, the symbolic item on the list is also a small lesson in why origin analysis is harder than a logo.
segments.tr: Se um determinado taco é "canadense" para fins aduaneiros depende de onde ele foi realmente fabricado e de como as regras de origem o tratam — ou seja, o item simbólico na lista é também uma pequena lição de por que a análise de origem é mais difícil do que um logotipo.

segments.src: ## What is still genuinely unsettled
segments.tr: ## O que ainda está genuinamente incerto

segments.src: A few things are worth holding loosely until they're confirmed in the operative documents:
segments.tr: Algumas coisas valem a pena observar com cautela até que sejam confirmadas nos documentos operacionais:

segments.src: - **Stacking.** Whether the 50% applies on top of existing sector duties, or in place of them, changes the landed cost dramatically. Check the proclamation text and the customs guidance, not summaries.
segments.tr: - **Acúmulo.** Se os 50% se aplicam sobre as tarifas setoriais existentes, ou em substituição a elas, muda o custo final drasticamente. Verifique o texto da proclamação e a orientação aduaneira, não resumos.

segments.src: - **Scope by tariff line.** "Cars" and "dairy" are categories in a press summary; what binds is the list of HTS subheadings. Adjacent products often turn out to be in or out in ways the category label doesn't predict.
segments.tr: - **Escopo por linha tarifária.** "Carros" e "laticínios" são categorias em um resumo de imprensa; o que vincula é a lista de subposições HTS. Produtos adjacentes frequentemente acabam estando dentro ou fora de formas que o rótulo da categoria não prevê.

segments.src: - **In-transit treatment.** Actions like this usually specify how goods already on the water or on a rail car are handled. That detail decides who eats the cost on shipments already booked.
segments.tr: - **Tratamento de mercadorias em trânsito.** Ações como esta geralmente especificam como mercadorias já no mar ou em um vagão de trem são tratadas. Esse detalhe decide quem arca com o custo em remessas já reservadas.

segments.src: - **Legal challenge.** A statute unused for 96 years has correspondingly little case law defining its limits — the findings required, how specific they must be, and how far judicial review reaches. Litigation is a reasonable expectation, and its outcome is not predictable from the text alone.
segments.tr: - **Desafio legal.** Um estatuto não utilizado por 96 anos tem, correspondentemente, pouca jurisprudência definindo seus limites — as constatações exigidas, quão específicas elas devem ser, e até onde a revisão judicial alcança. O litígio é uma expectativa razoável, e seu resultado não é previsível apenas pelo texto.

segments.src: - **Response.** Canada has its own retaliation authorities and a domestic political timetable of its own. The list above may not be the last list.
segments.tr: - **Resposta.** O Canadá tem suas próprias autoridades de retaliação e um cronograma político interno próprio. A lista acima pode não ser a última lista.

segments.src: ## What to watch over the next two weeks
segments.tr: ## O que observar nas próximas duas semanas

segments.src: Between now and August 19, the useful signals are administrative rather than rhetorical: the published proclamation and its annexes, US Customs and Border Protection guidance messages to the trade community, any exclusion or drawback process, and the tariff-line detail.
segments.tr: Entre agora e 19 de agosto, os sinais úteis são administrativos, e não retóricos: a proclamação publicada e seus anexos, as mensagens de orientação do CBP (Customs and Border Protection) para a comunidade comercial, qualquer processo de exclusão ou restituição, e o detalhe da linha tarifária.

segments.src: Statements from either capital will move sentiment; the annexes will move invoices.
segments.tr: Declarações de qualquer uma das capitais moverão o sentimento; os anexos moverão as faturas.

segments.src: The longer-term signal is the annual review cycle.
segments.tr: O sinal de longo prazo é o ciclo de revisão anual.

segments.src: A single duty on five product categories is a discrete event.
segments.tr: Uma única tarifa sobre cinco categorias de produtos é um evento discreto.

segments.src: A framework in which the continent's trade rulebook is reconfirmed twelve months at a time is a different operating environment — and it is the part that will still be true after this particular tariff is resolved, whichever way it goes.
segments.tr: Uma estrutura na qual o livro de regras comerciais do continente é reconfirmado a cada doze meses é um ambiente operacional diferente — e é a parte que ainda será verdade após esta tarifa específica ser resolvida, seja qual for a maneira.

segments.src: The hockey sticks will get the jokes.
segments.tr: Os tacos de hóquei renderão as piadas.

segments.src: The certificate of origin is the story.
segments.tr: O certificado de origem é a história.

segments.src: *This article is general information about a public policy development, not legal, tax, customs, or investment advice.
segments.tr: *Este artigo fornece informações gerais sobre um desenvolvimento de política pública, não sendo aconselhamento legal, tributário, aduaneiro ou de investimento.

segments.src: Tariff actions change quickly and the operative details are set by the published proclamation and official customs guidance.
segments.tr: Ações tarifárias mudam rapidamente e os detalhes operacionais são definidos pela proclamação publicada e orientação aduaneira oficial.

segments.src: Importers and exporters should confirm current requirements with the Federal Register, US Customs and Border Protection, and qualified trade counsel before making decisions.*
segments.tr: Importadores e exportadores devem confirmar os requisitos atuais com o Federal Register, o CBP (Customs and Border Protection) e consultores comerciais qualificados antes de tomar decisões.*

in.title: Undang-Undang Tarif 1930 yang Tidak Pernah Digunakan — Hingga Tongkat Hoki Kanada Masuk Daftar

segments.src: For most of the last century, Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 was the kind of provision trade lawyers mentioned at conferences and then moved on from.
segments.tr: Selama sebagian besar abad terakhir, Pasal 338 dari Undang-Undang Tarif tahun 1930 adalah jenis ketentuan yang disebutkan oleh pengacara perdagangan di konferensi dan kemudian dilewati begitu saja.

segments.src: It is on the books.
segments.tr: Ketentuan itu ada dalam buku hukum.

segments.src: It has real teeth.
segments.tr: Ketentuan itu memiliki kekuatan nyata.

segments.src: And in roughly 96 years, no president had ever used it to actually put a duty on anything.
segments.tr: Dan dalam waktu sekitar 96 tahun, tidak ada presiden yang pernah menggunakannya untuk benar-benar mengenakan bea masuk pada apa pun.

segments.src: That changes on **August 19**, when a **50% duty** invoked under Section 338 is scheduled to take effect on a specific list of Canadian goods: passenger vehicles, dairy products, wine, cement — and hockey sticks.
segments.tr: Hal itu berubah pada **19 Agustus**, ketika **bea masuk 50%** yang dipicu oleh Pasal 338 dijadwalkan mulai berlaku untuk daftar barang Kanada tertentu: kendaraan penumpang, produk susu, anggur, semen — dan tongkat hoki.

segments.src: The product list is what gets the headlines.
segments.tr: Daftar produk itulah yang menjadi tajuk utama.

segments.src: The legal mechanism is what matters.
segments.tr: Mekanisme hukumnyalah yang penting.

segments.src: ## What Section 338 actually says
segments.tr: ## Apa yang sebenarnya dikatakan Pasal 338

segments.src: Section 338 is codified at 19 U.S.C.
segments.tr: Pasal 338 dikodifikasikan pada 19 U.S.C.

segments.src: § 1338, part of the same 1930 statute better known by the names of its sponsors, Smoot and Hawley.
segments.tr: § 1338, bagian dari undang-undang 1930 yang sama yang lebih dikenal dengan nama sponsornya, Smoot dan Hawley.

segments.src: Its subject is not national security, not trade deficits, and not unfair subsidies.
segments.tr: Subjeknya bukan keamanan nasional, bukan defisit perdagangan, dan bukan subsidi yang tidak adil.

segments.src: It is *discrimination*.
segments.tr: Subjeknya adalah *diskriminasi*.

segments.src: In plain terms, the provision allows the president to respond when a foreign country is found to impose burdens or restrictions on US commerce that place American exporters at a disadvantage relative to other countries.
segments.tr: Dalam istilah sederhana, ketentuan ini memungkinkan presiden untuk merespons ketika sebuah negara asing ditemukan mengenakan beban atau pembatasan pada perdagangan AS yang menempatkan eksportir Amerika pada posisi yang tidak menguntungkan dibandingkan dengan negara lain.

segments.src: The available responses are unusually blunt for US trade law:
segments.tr: Respons yang tersedia sangat blak-blakan untuk hukum perdagangan AS:

segments.src: - **New or additional duties of up to 50% ad valorem** on that country's products, and
segments.tr: - **Bea masuk baru atau tambahan hingga 50% ad valorem** pada produk negara tersebut, dan

segments.src: - in the more extreme case, **exclusion of the goods from entry altogether**.
segments.tr: - dalam kasus yang lebih ekstrem, **pengecualian barang dari masuk sama sekali**.

segments.src: The statute also contemplates a fact-finding role for the US International Trade Commission in identifying such discriminatory practices and reporting them.
segments.tr: Undang-undang tersebut juga mempertimbangkan peran pencarian fakta bagi Komisi Perdagangan Internasional AS dalam mengidentifikasi praktik diskriminatif tersebut dan melaporkannya.

segments.src: But compared with the tools Washington has leaned on for the past decade, the procedural runway is short.
segments.tr: Namun dibandingkan dengan alat yang diandalkan Washington selama dekade terakhir, landasan proseduralnya sangat singkat.

segments.src: That contrast is the reason this is a story at all.
segments.tr: Kontras itulah alasan mengapa ini menjadi sebuah cerita.

segments.src: **Section 232** requires a Commerce Department national-security investigation.
segments.tr: **Pasal 232** memerlukan investigasi keamanan nasional oleh Departemen Perdagangan.

segments.src: **Section 301** requires a formal USTR proceeding, notice, comment, and a hearing.
segments.tr: **Pasal 301** memerlukan proses formal USTR, pemberitahuan, komentar, dan sidang.
