segments.src: Emergency economic powers require a declared emergency — and have drawn sustained litigation over whether the tariff power was ever in that statute to begin with.
segments.tr: Kekuatan ekonomi darurat memerlukan keadaan darurat yang dinyatakan — dan telah menarik litigasi berkelanjutan mengenai apakah kekuatan tarif tersebut memang ada dalam undang-undang itu sejak awal.

segments.src: Section 338 sits outside all of those frameworks, with its own findings requirement and its own ceiling.
segments.tr: Pasal 338 berada di luar semua kerangka kerja tersebut, dengan persyaratan temuan dan batas atasnya sendiri.

segments.src: For years, the standard explanation for why nobody used it was that it wasn't needed.
segments.tr: Selama bertahun-tahun, penjelasan standar mengapa tidak ada yang menggunakannya adalah karena itu tidak diperlukan.

segments.src: The modern toolkit was broader, better-tested in court, and easier to defend.
segments.tr: Perangkat modern lebih luas, lebih teruji di pengadilan, dan lebih mudah dipertahankan.

segments.src: The revival of a 1930 authority suggests the calculation has shifted toward statutes that haven't been narrowed by decades of case law — precisely because they haven't been tested.
segments.tr: Kebangkitan otoritas tahun 1930 menunjukkan bahwa kalkulasi telah bergeser ke arah undang-undang yang belum dipersempit oleh yurisprudensi selama beberapa dekade — justru karena mereka belum teruji.

segments.src: ## Why this round is different: the USMCA carve-out is gone
segments.tr: ## Mengapa putaran ini berbeda: pengecualian USMCA telah hilang

segments.src: Every significant US tariff action against Canada in recent years came with the same escape hatch.
segments.tr: Setiap tindakan tarif AS yang signifikan terhadap Kanada dalam beberapa tahun terakhir disertai dengan pintu keluar yang sama.

segments.src: If a shipment qualified as originating under the United States–Mexico–Canada Agreement — if it met the rules of origin and the exporter or importer could certify it — the goods came in outside the new duty.
segments.tr: Jika pengiriman memenuhi syarat sebagai asal di bawah Perjanjian Amerika Serikat–Meksiko–Kanada (USMCA) — jika memenuhi aturan asal dan eksportir atau importir dapat mensertifikasikannya — barang tersebut masuk tanpa bea masuk baru.

segments.src: That carve-out did enormous work.
segments.tr: Pengecualian itu memberikan dampak yang sangat besar.

segments.src: It is why a Canadian-assembled vehicle with a qualifying regional value content was treated differently from an identical-looking vehicle sourced elsewhere.
segments.tr: Itulah mengapa kendaraan yang dirakit di Kanada dengan konten nilai regional yang memenuhi syarat diperlakukan berbeda dari kendaraan yang terlihat identik yang bersumber dari tempat lain.

segments.src: It is why compliance departments across the continent spent 2025 and early 2026 rebuilding bills of materials rather than rerouting supply chains.
segments.tr: Itulah mengapa departemen kepatuhan di seluruh benua menghabiskan tahun 2025 dan awal 2026 untuk membangun kembali daftar bahan (bill of materials) daripada mengalihkan rantai pasokan.

segments.src: **The Section 338 action, as announced, contains no such exemption.** A good that satisfies every USMCA rule of origin — a car meeting the regional value content and labor value content thresholds, a cheese produced entirely in Quebec, a stick laid up in an Ontario plant — is covered on the same terms as a good that doesn't.
segments.tr: **Tindakan Pasal 338, sebagaimana diumumkan, tidak mengandung pengecualian seperti itu.** Barang yang memenuhi setiap aturan asal USMCA — mobil yang memenuhi ambang batas konten nilai regional dan konten nilai tenaga kerja, keju yang diproduksi seluruhnya di Quebec, tongkat yang dibuat di pabrik Ontario — dicakup dengan syarat yang sama dengan barang yang tidak memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: That is the substantive change.
segments.tr: Itulah perubahan substantifnya.

segments.src: Not the rate.
segments.tr: Bukan tarifnya.

segments.src: The rate is high, but rates move.
segments.tr: Tarifnya tinggi, tetapi tarif bisa berubah.

segments.src: What moved here is the *status* of a document.
segments.tr: Yang berubah di sini adalah *status* dari sebuah dokumen.

segments.src: ## The certificate of origin stops being a shield
segments.tr: ## Sertifikat asal berhenti menjadi perisai

segments.src: Since NAFTA took effect in 1994, and continuing under USMCA from July 2020, North American trade has run on a shared assumption: prove where a good comes from, and the tariff schedule follows automatically.
segments.tr: Sejak NAFTA berlaku pada tahun 1994, dan berlanjut di bawah USMCA sejak Juli 2020, perdagangan Amerika Utara telah berjalan berdasarkan asumsi bersama: buktikan dari mana barang berasal, dan jadwal tarif akan mengikuti secara otomatis.

segments.src: USMCA even simplified the mechanics, replacing NAFTA's standardized form with a certification of origin that an importer, exporter, or producer can issue based on a set of required data elements.
segments.tr: USMCA bahkan menyederhanakan mekanismenya, mengganti formulir standar NAFTA dengan sertifikasi asal yang dapat diterbitkan oleh importir, eksportir, atau produsen berdasarkan serangkaian elemen data yang diperlukan.

segments.src: That certification became the load-bearing beam of continental manufacturing.
segments.tr: Sertifikasi itu menjadi pilar utama manufaktur benua.

segments.src: Auto programs were sourced around it.
segments.tr: Program otomotif bersumber di sekitarnya.

segments.src: Food processors structured contracts around it.
segments.tr: Pengolah makanan menyusun kontrak di sekitarnya.

segments.src: Customs brokers built practices around it.
segments.tr: Broker bea cukai membangun praktik di sekitarnya.

segments.src: A duty that applies regardless of origin certification doesn't repeal any of that.
segments.tr: Bea masuk yang berlaku terlepas dari sertifikasi asal tidak membatalkan semua itu.

segments.src: But it does demote it.
segments.tr: Namun hal itu menurunkannya.

segments.src: The paperwork still governs preferential *duty-free* treatment under the agreement.
segments.tr: Dokumen tersebut masih mengatur perlakuan *bebas bea* preferensial di bawah perjanjian.

segments.src: It no longer guarantees that a shipment escapes whatever else has been layered on top.
segments.tr: Namun dokumen itu tidak lagi menjamin bahwa pengiriman terhindar dari apa pun yang telah ditambahkan di atasnya.

segments.src: If you want one sentence for why trade counsel are re-reading old statutes this month, it is this: **origin compliance has stopped being a complete answer to the question "what will this cost at the border?"**
segments.tr: Jika Anda menginginkan satu kalimat untuk alasan mengapa penasihat perdagangan membaca ulang undang-undang lama bulan ini, kalimatnya adalah ini: **kepatuhan asal telah berhenti menjadi jawaban lengkap atas pertanyaan "berapa biaya ini di perbatasan?"**

segments.src: ## The joint-review backdrop
segments.tr: ## Latar belakang tinjauan bersama

segments.src: None of this is happening in a vacuum.
segments.tr: Tidak ada dari semua ini yang terjadi dalam ruang hampa.

segments.src: USMCA was written with a clock in it.
segments.tr: USMCA ditulis dengan batas waktu di dalamnya.

segments.src: The agreement entered into force on July 1, 2020, with a 16-year term and a **joint review at the six-year mark** — July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: Perjanjian tersebut mulai berlaku pada 1 Juli 2020, dengan jangka waktu 16 tahun dan **tinjauan bersama pada tanda enam tahun** — 1 Juli 2026.

segments.src: If all three parties confirm they want to extend, the term rolls forward another 16 years.
segments.tr: Jika ketiga pihak mengonfirmasi bahwa mereka ingin memperpanjang, jangka waktu tersebut berlanjut 16 tahun lagi.

segments.src: If they don't, the agreement doesn't collapse; it shifts into a cycle of **annual reviews** running toward a 2036 endpoint, with the parties expected to keep trying to resolve their differences in the meantime.
segments.tr: Jika tidak, perjanjian tersebut tidak runtuh; ia beralih ke siklus **tinjauan tahunan** yang berjalan menuju titik akhir 2036, dengan para pihak diharapkan untuk terus mencoba menyelesaikan perbedaan mereka sementara itu.

segments.src: Washington's decision not to renew the pact in its current form puts the agreement into exactly that annual-review posture.
segments.tr: Keputusan Washington untuk tidak memperbarui pakta tersebut dalam bentuknya yang sekarang menempatkan perjanjian tersebut tepat dalam posisi tinjauan tahunan itu.

segments.src: The treaty is still in force.
segments.tr: Perjanjian tersebut masih berlaku.

segments.src: Its obligations still exist.
segments.tr: Kewajibannya masih ada.

segments.src: But its long horizon — the thing that made it worth designing a 10-year vehicle program around — is now provisional, reviewed one year at a time.
segments.tr: Namun cakrawala panjangnya — hal yang membuatnya layak merancang program kendaraan 10 tahun di sekitarnya — kini bersifat sementara, ditinjau satu tahun sekali.

segments.src: Layer the Section 338 duty on top of that, and the message businesses are reading is less about a single 50% number and more about **planning horizon**.
segments.tr: Tambahkan bea masuk Pasal 338 di atas itu, dan pesan yang dibaca oleh bisnis adalah bukan tentang angka 50% tunggal, melainkan lebih tentang **cakrawala perencanaan**.

segments.src: A tariff can be reversed next quarter.
segments.tr: Tarif dapat dibatalkan kuartal depan.

segments.src: A twelve-month review cycle is a structural feature.
segments.tr: Siklus tinjauan dua belas bulan adalah fitur struktural.

segments.src: ## Who feels it, and how unevenly
segments.tr: ## Siapa yang merasakannya, dan betapa tidak meratanya

segments.src: The five categories on the list are not equivalent, and the volumes tell you something about intent.
segments.tr: Lima kategori dalam daftar tersebut tidak setara, dan volumenya memberi tahu Anda sesuatu tentang niatnya.

segments.src: **Vehicles** are the heavyweight.
segments.tr: **Kendaraan** adalah yang terberat.

segments.src: Canadian assembly plants ship a large share of their output south, and the integrated parts networks around Ontario and Michigan mean components can cross the border several times before a finished car does.
segments.tr: Pabrik perakitan Kanada mengirimkan sebagian besar output mereka ke selatan, dan jaringan suku cadang terintegrasi di sekitar Ontario dan Michigan berarti komponen dapat melintasi perbatasan beberapa kali sebelum mobil yang sudah jadi melakukannya.

segments.src: A duty applied without an origin exemption interacts badly with a supply chain that was deliberately built to be continental.
segments.tr: Bea masuk yang diterapkan tanpa pengecualian asal berinteraksi buruk dengan rantai pasokan yang sengaja dibangun untuk menjadi kontinental.

segments.src: **Dairy** is the outlier by volume.
segments.tr: **Produk Susu** adalah pencilan berdasarkan volume.

segments.src: The United States generally runs a *surplus* in dairy trade with Canada — US processors sell more north than Canadian processors sell south.
segments.tr: Amerika Serikat umumnya memiliki *surplus* dalam perdagangan produk susu dengan Kanada — pengolah AS menjual lebih banyak ke utara daripada pengolah Kanada menjual ke selatan.

segments.src: A tariff on Canadian dairy therefore isn't primarily about the flow it taxes.
segments.tr: Oleh karena itu, tarif pada produk susu Kanada bukan terutama tentang aliran yang dipajakinya.

segments.src: It reads as pressure on a long-running dispute over how Canada allocates its tariff-rate quotas under its supply-management system, an issue that has already been through formal dispute settlement.
segments.tr: Ini terlihat sebagai tekanan pada sengketa lama tentang bagaimana Kanada mengalokasikan kuota tarif-rate di bawah sistem manajemen pasokannya, masalah yang telah melalui penyelesaian sengketa formal.

segments.src: **Wine** is small in dollar terms — Niagara and Okanagan producers ship modest volumes — but highly visible on retail shelves, and it sits inside a broader argument about provincial liquor-board practices that US exporters have complained about for years.
segments.tr: **Anggur** kecil dalam nilai dolar — produsen Niagara dan Okanagan mengirimkan volume yang rendah — tetapi sangat terlihat di rak ritel, dan berada di dalam argumen yang lebih luas tentang praktik dewan minuman keras provinsi yang telah dikeluhkan oleh eksportir AS selama bertahun-tahun.

segments.src: **Cement** is the quiet one with the largest downstream footprint.
segments.tr: **Semen** adalah yang paling tenang dengan jejak hilir terbesar.

segments.src: Canada is among the biggest sources of imported cement in the US, and it moves into Great Lakes, Northeast, and Pacific Northwest markets where the freight economics of alternative suppliers are poor.
segments.tr: Kanada adalah salah satu sumber semen impor terbesar di AS, dan ia bergerak ke pasar Great Lakes, Timur Laut, dan Pasifik Barat Laut di mana ekonomi pengiriman dari pemasok alternatif buruk.

segments.src: Construction input costs don't make headlines the way car prices do, but they reach further.
segments.tr: Biaya input konstruksi tidak menjadi tajuk utama seperti harga mobil, tetapi jangkauannya lebih jauh.

segments.src: **Hockey sticks** are the item everyone will remember, and the one with the most instructive complication.
segments.tr: **Tongkat hoki** adalah item yang akan diingat semua orang, dan yang memiliki komplikasi paling instruktif.

segments.src: Several of the best-known brands are Canadian in identity and headquarters, while a great deal of composite stick manufacturing happens in Asia.
segments.tr: Beberapa merek paling terkenal adalah identitas dan kantor pusat Kanada, sementara banyak manufaktur tongkat komposit terjadi di Asia.

segments.src: Whether a given stick is "Canadian" for customs purposes depends on where it was actually made and how the origin rules treat it — which is to say, the symbolic item on the list is also a small lesson in why origin analysis is harder than a logo.
segments.tr: Apakah tongkat tertentu "Kanada" untuk tujuan bea cukai tergantung pada di mana ia benar-benar dibuat dan bagaimana aturan asal memperlakukannya — yang berarti, item simbolis dalam daftar tersebut juga merupakan pelajaran kecil tentang mengapa analisis asal lebih sulit daripada sekadar logo.

segments.src: ## What is still genuinely unsettled
segments.tr: ## Apa yang masih benar-benar belum pasti

segments.src: A few things are worth holding loosely until they're confirmed in the operative documents:
segments.tr: Beberapa hal layak untuk diperhatikan dengan longgar hingga dikonfirmasi dalam dokumen operatif:

segments.src: - **Stacking.** Whether the 50% applies on top of existing sector duties, or in place of them, changes the landed cost dramatically. Check the proclamation text and the customs guidance, not summaries.
segments.tr: - **Penumpukan.** Apakah 50% berlaku di atas bea masuk sektor yang ada, atau sebagai penggantinya, mengubah biaya pendaratan secara drastis. Periksa teks proklamasi dan panduan bea cukai, bukan ringkasan.

segments.src: - **Scope by tariff line.** "Cars" and "dairy" are categories in a press summary; what binds is the list of HTS subheadings. Adjacent products often turn out to be in or out in ways the category label doesn't predict.
segments.tr: - **Cakupan berdasarkan lini tarif.** "Mobil" dan "produk susu" adalah kategori dalam ringkasan pers; yang mengikat adalah daftar sub-heading HTS. Produk yang berdekatan sering kali ternyata masuk atau keluar dengan cara yang tidak diprediksi oleh label kategori.

segments.src: - **In-transit treatment.** Actions like this usually specify how goods already on the water or on a rail car are handled. That detail decides who eats the cost on shipments already booked.
segments.tr: - **Perlakuan transit.** Tindakan seperti ini biasanya menentukan bagaimana barang yang sudah berada di laut atau di gerbong kereta api ditangani. Detail itu menentukan siapa yang menanggung biaya pada pengiriman yang sudah dipesan.

segments.src: - **Legal challenge.** A statute unused for 96 years has correspondingly little case law defining its limits — the findings required, how specific they must be, and how far judicial review reaches. Litigation is a reasonable expectation, and its outcome is not predictable from the text alone.
segments.tr: - **Tantangan hukum.** Undang-undang yang tidak digunakan selama 96 tahun memiliki yurisprudensi yang sangat sedikit yang mendefinisikan batasannya — temuan yang diperlukan, seberapa spesifik temuan tersebut harus, dan seberapa jauh tinjauan yudisial menjangkau. Litigasi adalah ekspektasi yang wajar, dan hasilnya tidak dapat diprediksi dari teks saja.

segments.src: - **Response.** Canada has its own retaliation authorities and a domestic political timetable of its own. The list above may not be the last list.
segments.tr: - **Respons.** Kanada memiliki otoritas pembalasan sendiri dan jadwal politik domestik sendiri. Daftar di atas mungkin bukan daftar terakhir.

segments.src: ## What to watch over the next two weeks
segments.tr: ## Apa yang harus diperhatikan selama dua minggu ke depan

segments.src: Between now and August 19, the useful signals are administrative rather than rhetorical: the published proclamation and its annexes, US Customs and Border Protection guidance messages to the trade community, any exclusion or drawback process, and the tariff-line detail.
segments.tr: Antara sekarang dan 19 Agustus, sinyal yang berguna adalah administratif daripada retoris: proklamasi yang diterbitkan dan lampirannya, pesan panduan Customs and Border Protection AS kepada komunitas perdagangan, proses pengecualian atau pengembalian bea (drawback), dan detail lini tarif.

segments.src: Statements from either capital will move sentiment; the annexes will move invoices.
segments.tr: Pernyataan dari kedua ibu kota akan menggerakkan sentimen; lampiran akan menggerakkan faktur.

segments.src: The longer-term signal is the annual review cycle.
segments.tr: Sinyal jangka panjang adalah siklus tinjauan tahunan.

segments.src: A single duty on five product categories is a discrete event.
segments.tr: Bea masuk tunggal pada lima kategori produk adalah peristiwa diskrit.

segments.src: A framework in which the continent's trade rulebook is reconfirmed twelve months at a time is a different operating environment — and it is the part that will still be true after this particular tariff is resolved, whichever way it goes.
segments.tr: Kerangka kerja di mana buku aturan perdagangan benua dikonfirmasi ulang dua belas bulan sekali adalah lingkungan operasi yang berbeda — dan itulah bagian yang akan tetap benar setelah tarif khusus ini selesai, apa pun hasilnya.

segments.src: The hockey sticks will get the jokes.
segments.tr: Tongkat hoki akan menjadi bahan lelucon.

segments.src: The certificate of origin is the story.
segments.tr: Sertifikat asal adalah ceritanya.

segments.src: *This article is general information about a public policy development, not legal, tax, customs, or investment advice.
segments.tr: *Artikel ini adalah informasi umum tentang perkembangan kebijakan publik, bukan saran hukum, pajak, bea cukai, atau investasi.

segments.src: Tariff actions change quickly and the operative details are set by the published proclamation and official customs guidance.
segments.tr: Tindakan tarif berubah dengan cepat dan detail operatif ditetapkan oleh proklamasi yang diterbitkan dan panduan bea cukai resmi.

segments.src: Importers and exporters should confirm current requirements with the Federal Register, US Customs and Border Protection, and qualified trade counsel before making decisions.*
segments.tr: Importir dan eksportir harus mengonfirmasi persyaratan saat ini dengan Federal Register, US Customs and Border Protection, dan penasihat perdagangan yang berkualifikasi sebelum membuat keputusan.*

ja.title: 誰も使わなかった1930年関税法 — カナダ製ホッケースティックがリストに載るまで

segments.src: For most of the last century, Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 was the kind of provision trade lawyers mentioned at conferences and then moved on from.
segments.tr: 前世紀の大部分において、1930年関税法第338条は、貿易弁護士が会議で言及し、そのまま話題を変えるような規定でした。

segments.src: It is on the books.
segments.tr: それは法典に記載されています。

segments.src: It has real teeth.
segments.tr: それは実効性を持っています。

segments.src: And in roughly 96 years, no president had ever used it to actually put a duty on anything.
segments.tr: そして約96年間にわたり、どの大統領も実際に何かに課税するためにそれを使用したことはありませんでした。

segments.src: That changes on **August 19**, when a **50% duty** invoked under Section 338 is scheduled to take effect on a specific list of Canadian goods: passenger vehicles, dairy products, wine, cement — and hockey sticks.
segments.tr: それが**8月19日**に変わります。第338条に基づき発動される**50%の関税**が、カナダ製品の特定のリスト（乗用車、乳製品、ワイン、セメント、そしてホッケースティック）に適用される予定です。

segments.src: The product list is what gets the headlines.
segments.tr: 製品リストが注目を集めます。

segments.src: The legal mechanism is what matters.
segments.tr: しかし、重要なのは法的メカニズムです。

segments.src: ## What Section 338 actually says
segments.tr: ## 第338条の実際の内容

segments.src: Section 338 is codified at 19 U.S.C.
segments.tr: 第338条は19 U.S.C. § 1338に法典化されており、

segments.src: § 1338, part of the same 1930 statute better known by the names of its sponsors, Smoot and Hawley.
segments.tr: その提案者の名前であるスムートとホーリーの名でよりよく知られる1930年の同一法律の一部です。

segments.src: Its subject is not national security, not trade deficits, and not unfair subsidies.
segments.tr: その対象は国家安全保障でも、貿易赤字でも、不公正な補助金でもありません。

segments.src: It is *discrimination*.
segments.tr: それは*差別*です。

segments.src: In plain terms, the provision allows the president to respond when a foreign country is found to impose burdens or restrictions on US commerce that place American exporters at a disadvantage relative to other countries.
segments.tr: 平易な言葉で言えば、この規定は、外国が米国商務に負担や制限を課し、米国の輸出業者が他国と比較して不利な状況に置かれたと判断された場合に、大統領が対応することを可能にするものです。

segments.src: The available responses are unusually blunt for US trade law:
segments.tr: 米国貿易法において、利用可能な対応策は異例なほど単純明快です。

segments.src: - **New or additional duties of up to 50% ad valorem** on that country's products, and
segments.tr: - その国の製品に対する**最大50%の従価税（新設または追加）**、および

segments.src: - in the more extreme case, **exclusion of the goods from entry altogether**.
segments.tr: - より極端なケースでは、**商品の輸入を完全に排除すること**。

segments.src: The statute also contemplates a fact-finding role for the US International Trade Commission in identifying such discriminatory practices and reporting them.
segments.tr: この法律はまた、そのような差別的な慣行を特定し報告する役割を米国国際貿易委員会（ITC）に持たせています。

segments.src: But compared with the tools Washington has leaned on for the past decade, the procedural runway is short.
segments.tr: しかし、ワシントンが過去10年間に頼ってきたツールと比較すると、手続き上の準備期間は短いです。

segments.src: That contrast is the reason this is a story at all.
segments.tr: その対比こそが、これがニュースになる理由です。

segments.src: **Section 232** requires a Commerce Department national-security investigation.
segments.tr: **第232条**は、商務省による国家安全保障調査を必要とします。

segments.src: **Section 301** requires a formal USTR proceeding, notice, comment, and a hearing.
segments.tr: **第301条**は、USTR（米国貿易代表部）による正式な手続き、通知、コメント、および公聴会を必要とします。

segments.src: Emergency economic powers require a declared emergency — and have drawn sustained litigation over whether the tariff power was ever in that statute to begin with.
segments.tr: 緊急経済権限は、宣言された緊急事態を必要とし、関税権限がそもそもその法律に含まれていたかどうかについて、持続的な訴訟を引き起こしてきました。

segments.src: Section 338 sits outside all of those frameworks, with its own findings requirement and its own ceiling.
segments.tr: 第338条はこれらすべての枠組みの外にあり、独自の認定要件と上限を持っています。

segments.src: For years, the standard explanation for why nobody used it was that it wasn't needed.
segments.tr: 長年、誰もこれを使わなかった理由として一般的だった説明は、必要なかったということです。

segments.src: The modern toolkit was broader, better-tested in court, and easier to defend.
segments.tr: 現代のツールキットはより幅広く、裁判所でより十分に検証され、正当化しやすかったためです。

segments.src: The revival of a 1930 authority suggests the calculation has shifted toward statutes that haven't been narrowed by decades of case law — precisely because they haven't been tested.
segments.tr: 1930年の権限が復活したことは、数十年の判例法によって制限されていない法律へと計算がシフトしたことを示唆しています。まさに、検証されてこなかったからです。

segments.src: ## Why this round is different: the USMCA carve-out is gone
segments.tr: ## 今回が異なる理由：USMCAの除外規定がなくなった

segments.src: Every significant US tariff action against Canada in recent years came with the same escape hatch.
segments.tr: 近年、カナダに対する米国の重要な関税措置はすべて、同じ逃げ道を持っていました。

segments.src: If a shipment qualified as originating under the United States–Mexico–Canada Agreement — if it met the rules of origin and the exporter or importer could certify it — the goods came in outside the new duty.
segments.tr: もし出荷物が米国・メキシコ・カナダ協定（USMCA）に基づく原産地として認定されれば（原産地規則を満たし、輸出入業者がそれを証明できれば）、商品は新しい関税の対象外となりました。

segments.src: That carve-out did enormous work.
segments.tr: その除外規定は絶大な効果を発揮しました。

segments.src: It is why a Canadian-assembled vehicle with a qualifying regional value content was treated differently from an identical-looking vehicle sourced elsewhere.
segments.tr: だからこそ、適格な地域価値コンテンツを含むカナダ組立車両は、他所で調達された見た目が同じ車両とは異なる扱いを受けました。

segments.src: It is why compliance departments across the continent spent 2025 and early 2026 rebuilding bills of materials rather than rerouting supply chains.
segments.tr: だからこそ、大陸全土のコンプライアンス部門は、サプライチェーンを変更するのではなく、2025年と2026年初頭にかけて部品表（BOM）の再構築に時間を費やしたのです。

segments.src: **The Section 338 action, as announced, contains no such exemption.** A good that satisfies every USMCA rule of origin — a car meeting the regional value content and labor value content thresholds, a cheese produced entirely in Quebec, a stick laid up in an Ontario plant — is covered on the same terms as a good that doesn't.
segments.tr: **発表された第338条の措置には、そのような免除はありません。** USMCAのすべての原産地規則を満たす商品（地域価値コンテンツと労働価値コンテンツの閾値を満たす車、ケベック州で完全に生産されたチーズ、オンタリオ州の工場で製造されたスティック）であっても、満たさない商品と同じ条件で適用されます。

segments.src: That is the substantive change.
segments.tr: それが実質的な変更点です。

segments.src: Not the rate.
segments.tr: 税率ではありません。

segments.src: The rate is high, but rates move.
segments.tr: 税率は高いですが、税率は変動します。

segments.src: What moved here is the *status* of a document.
segments.tr: ここで変わったのは、書類の*ステータス*です。

segments.src: ## The certificate of origin stops being a shield
segments.tr: ## 原産地証明書が盾にならなくなった

segments.src: Since NAFTA took effect in 1994, and continuing under USMCA from July 2020, North American trade has run on a shared assumption: prove where a good comes from, and the tariff schedule follows automatically.
segments.tr: 1994年にNAFTAが発効し、2020年7月からUSMCAの下で継続されて以来、北米貿易は共通の前提で運用されてきました。つまり、商品の原産地を証明すれば、関税率表が自動的に適用されるということです。

segments.src: USMCA even simplified the mechanics, replacing NAFTA's standardized form with a certification of origin that an importer, exporter, or producer can issue based on a set of required data elements.
segments.tr: USMCAはさらにメカニズムを簡素化し、NAFTAの標準化されたフォームを、輸入業者、輸出業者、または生産者が一連の必須データ要素に基づいて発行できる原産地証明に置き換えました。

segments.src: That certification became the load-bearing beam of continental manufacturing.
segments.tr: その証明書は、大陸的な製造業の主要な支柱となりました。

segments.src: Auto programs were sourced around it.
segments.tr: 自動車プログラムはその周囲で調達されました。

segments.src: Food processors structured contracts around it.
segments.tr: 食品加工業者はその周囲で契約を構築しました。

segments.src: Customs brokers built practices around it.
segments.tr: 通関業者はその周囲で実務を構築しました。

segments.src: A duty that applies regardless of origin certification doesn't repeal any of that.
segments.tr: 原産地証明に関わらず適用される関税は、それらを撤廃するものではありません。

segments.src: But it does demote it.
segments.tr: しかし、その重要性を低下させます。

segments.src: The paperwork still governs preferential *duty-free* treatment under the agreement.
segments.tr: 書類手続きは依然として協定に基づく特恵*免税*待遇を規定します。

segments.src: It no longer guarantees that a shipment escapes whatever else has been layered on top.
segments.tr: しかし、それが積み上げられた他のあらゆる課税から出荷物を逃れさせることを保証しなくなりました。

segments.src: If you want one sentence for why trade counsel are re-reading old statutes this month, it is this: **origin compliance has stopped being a complete answer to the question "what will this cost at the border?"**
segments.tr: 今月、貿易法務担当者が古い法律を読み直している理由を一文で言うなら、こうなります。**「原産地コンプライアンスは、『国境でいくらかかるか？』という問いに対する完全な答えではなくなった」**ということです。

segments.src: ## The joint-review backdrop
segments.tr: ## 共同レビューの背景

segments.src: None of this is happening in a vacuum.
segments.tr: これらはすべて真空状態で起きているわけではありません。

segments.src: USMCA was written with a clock in it.
segments.tr: USMCAは期限付きで作成されました。

segments.src: The agreement entered into force on July 1, 2020, with a 16-year term and a **joint review at the six-year mark** — July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: 協定は2020年7月1日に発効し、期間は16年で、**6年目の共同レビュー**（2026年7月1日）が設定されています。

segments.src: If all three parties confirm they want to extend, the term rolls forward another 16 years.
segments.tr: 3つの当事者がすべて延長を希望することを確認すれば、期間はさらに16年延長されます。

segments.src: If they don't, the agreement doesn't collapse; it shifts into a cycle of **annual reviews** running toward a 2036 endpoint, with the parties expected to keep trying to resolve their differences in the meantime.
segments.tr: そうでなければ、協定が崩壊するわけではなく、2036年の終点に向けた**年次レビュー**のサイクルに移行し、その間、当事者は相違点を解決し続けることが期待されます。

segments.src: Washington's decision not to renew the pact in its current form puts the agreement into exactly that annual-review posture.
segments.tr: 現在の形態で協定を更新しないというワシントンの決定は、協定をまさにその年次レビューの姿勢に置くことになります。

segments.src: The treaty is still in force.
segments.tr: 条約は依然として有効です。

segments.src: Its obligations still exist.
segments.tr: その義務は依然として存在します。

segments.src: But its long horizon — the thing that made it worth designing a 10-year vehicle program around — is now provisional, reviewed one year at a time.
segments.tr: しかし、その長期的な展望（10年間の車両プログラムを設計する価値があった理由）は、今や暫定的なものとなり、1年ごとにレビューされることになります。

segments.src: Layer the Section 338 duty on top of that, and the message businesses are reading is less about a single 50% number and more about **planning horizon**.
segments.tr: そこに第338条の関税を重ね合わせると、企業が読み取っているメッセージは、単なる50%という数字ではなく、**計画期間（プランニング・ホライゾン）**についてです。

segments.src: A tariff can be reversed next quarter.
segments.tr: 関税は次の四半期に撤回される可能性があります。

segments.src: A twelve-month review cycle is a structural feature.
segments.tr: しかし、12ヶ月のレビューサイクルは構造的な特徴です。

segments.src: ## Who feels it, and how unevenly
segments.tr: ## 誰が影響を受け、どれほど不均衡か

segments.src: The five categories on the list are not equivalent, and the volumes tell you something about intent.
segments.tr: リストにある5つのカテゴリーは同等ではなく、その数量は意図について何かを物語っています。

segments.src: **Vehicles** are the heavyweight.
segments.tr: **車両**は重量級です。

segments.src: Canadian assembly plants ship a large share of their output south, and the integrated parts networks around Ontario and Michigan mean components can cross the border several times before a finished car does.
segments.tr: カナダの組立工場は生産量の多くを南へ出荷しており、オンタリオ州とミシガン州周辺の統合された部品ネットワークは、完成車が国境を越える前に部品が数回国境を越えることを意味します。

segments.src: A duty applied without an origin exemption interacts badly with a supply chain that was deliberately built to be continental.
segments.tr: 原産地免除なしに適用される関税は、意図的に大陸的に構築されたサプライチェーンと相性が悪いです。

segments.src: **Dairy** is the outlier by volume.
segments.tr: **乳製品**は数量面で例外的な存在です。

segments.src: The United States generally runs a *surplus* in dairy trade with Canada — US processors sell more north than Canadian processors sell south.
segments.tr: 米国は一般的にカナダとの乳製品貿易で*黒字*を出しており、米国の加工業者はカナダの加工業者よりも多く北へ販売しています。

segments.src: A tariff on Canadian dairy therefore isn't primarily about the flow it taxes.
segments.tr: したがって、カナダ産乳製品への関税は、主に課税対象となるフローに関するものではありません。

segments.src: It reads as pressure on a long-running dispute over how Canada allocates its tariff-rate quotas under its supply-management system, an issue that has already been through formal dispute settlement.
segments.tr: それは、カナダが供給管理システムの下で関税割当枠をどのように割り当てるかという、すでに正式な紛争解決手続きを経た長期的な争いに対する圧力として読み取れます。

segments.src: **Wine** is small in dollar terms — Niagara and Okanagan producers ship modest volumes — but highly visible on retail shelves, and it sits inside a broader argument about provincial liquor-board practices that US exporters have complained about for years.
segments.tr: **ワイン**は金額ベースでは小規模で、ナイアガラやオカナガンの生産者は控えめな量を配送していますが、小売店の棚では非常に目立ち、米国の輸出業者が長年不満を述べてきた州立酒類管理委員会の慣行に関するより広い議論の中に位置しています。

segments.src: **Cement** is the quiet one with the largest downstream footprint.
segments.tr: **セメント**は目立たないものの、下流への影響が最も大きいものです。

segments.src: Canada is among the biggest sources of imported cement in the US, and it moves into Great Lakes, Northeast, and Pacific Northwest markets where the freight economics of alternative suppliers are poor.
segments.tr: カナダは米国における輸入セメントの最大供給源の一つであり、代替サプライヤーの輸送コストが高いグレートレイクス、北東部、太平洋北西部市場に供給されています。

segments.src: Construction input costs don't make headlines the way car prices do, but they reach further.
segments.tr: 建設資材のコストは、車の価格のように見出しに乗りませんが、より広範囲に影響します。

segments.src: **Hockey sticks** are the item everyone will remember, and the one with the most instructive complication.
segments.tr: **ホッケースティック**は誰もが記憶に残るアイテムであり、最も示唆に富む複雑さを持っています。

segments.src: Several of the best-known brands are Canadian in identity and headquarters, while a great deal of composite stick manufacturing happens in Asia.
segments.tr: 有名なブランドのいくつかはアイデンティティと本社をカナダに置いていますが、複合材スティックの製造の多くはアジアで行われています。

segments.src: Whether a given stick is "Canadian" for customs purposes depends on where it was actually made and how the origin rules treat it — which is to say, the symbolic item on the list is also a small lesson in why origin analysis is harder than a logo.
segments.tr: あるスティックが通関目的で「カナダ産」であるかどうかは、実際にどこで作られたか、および原産地規則がそれをどう扱うかに依存します。つまり、リストにある象徴的なアイテムは、原産地分析がロゴよりも難しいという小さな教訓でもあります。

segments.src: ## What is still genuinely unsettled
segments.tr: ## まだ本当に未確定なこと

segments.src: A few things are worth holding loosely until they're confirmed in the operative documents:
segments.tr: 運用文書で確認されるまで、以下の点については柔軟に考えておく価値があります。

segments.src: - **Stacking.** Whether the 50% applies on top of existing sector duties, or in place of them, changes the landed cost dramatically. Check the proclamation text and the customs guidance, not summaries.
segments.tr: - **累積（スタッキング）。** 50%が既存のセクター関税に上乗せされるのか、あるいはそれらに代わるのかによって、着地コストは劇的に変わります。要約ではなく、布告文と通関ガイダンスを確認してください。

segments.src: - **Scope by tariff line.** "Cars" and "dairy" are categories in a press summary; what binds is the list of HTS subheadings. Adjacent products often turn out to be in or out in ways the category label doesn't predict.
segments.tr: - **関税番号による範囲。** 「車」や「乳製品」はプレスリリースの要約にあるカテゴリーであり、拘束力を持つのはHTSサブヘディングのリストです。隣接する製品は、カテゴリーラベルが予測しない方法で対象に含まれたり除外されたりすることがよくあります。

segments.src: - **In-transit treatment.** Actions like this usually specify how goods already on the water or on a rail car are handled. That detail decides who eats the cost on shipments already booked.
segments.tr: - **輸送中の扱い。** このような措置は通常、すでに海上や貨車にある商品の扱いを規定します。その詳細が、すでに予約済みの出荷分について誰がコストを負担するかを決定します。

segments.src: - **Legal challenge.** A statute unused for 96 years has correspondingly little case law defining its limits — the findings required, how specific they must be, and how far judicial review reaches. Litigation is a reasonable expectation, and its outcome is not predictable from the text alone.
segments.tr: - **法的挑戦。** 96年間使われなかった法律は、その限界を定義する判例法が correspondingly 少ないため、必要な認定事項、その具体性、および司法審査がどこまで及ぶかが不透明です。訴訟は十分に予想されることであり、その結果は本文だけでは予測できません。

segments.src: - **Response.** Canada has its own retaliation authorities and a domestic political timetable of its own. The list above may not be the last list.
segments.tr: - **対応。** カナダは独自の報復権限と国内政治的なスケジュールを持っています。上記のリストが最後のリストではない可能性があります。

segments.src: ## What to watch over the next two weeks
segments.tr: ## 今後2週間に注目すべきこと

segments.src: Between now and August 19, the useful signals are administrative rather than rhetorical: the published proclamation and its annexes, US Customs and Border Protection guidance messages to the trade community, any exclusion or drawback process, and the tariff-line detail.
segments.tr: 今から8月19日まで、有用なシグナルは修辞的なものではなく、行政的なものです。公開された布告とその附属書、米国税関・国境警備局（CBP）から貿易コミュニティへのガイダンスメッセージ、除外または払い戻しプロセス、および関税番号の詳細です。

segments.src: Statements from either capital will move sentiment; the annexes will move invoices.
segments.tr: 両国の首都からの声明は感情を動かしますが、附属書が請求書を動かします。

segments.src: The longer-term signal is the annual review cycle.
segments.tr: より長期的なシグナルは、年次レビューサイクルです。

segments.src: A single duty on five product categories is a discrete event.
segments.tr: 5つの製品カテゴリーに対する単一の関税は、個別のイベントです。

segments.src: A framework in which the continent's trade rulebook is reconfirmed twelve months at a time is a different operating environment — and it is the part that will still be true after this particular tariff is resolved, whichever way it goes.
segments.tr: 大陸の貿易ルールブックが12ヶ月ごとに再確認される枠組みは、異なる運用環境であり、この特定の関税がどのように解決されるにせよ、その後も真実であり続ける部分です。

segments.src: The hockey sticks will get the jokes.
segments.tr: ホッケースティックはジョークのネタになるでしょう。

segments.src: The certificate of origin is the story.
segments.tr: しかし、原産地証明書こそが本質的な物語です。

segments.src: *This article is general information about a public policy development, not legal, tax, customs, or investment advice.
segments.tr: *この記事は公共政策の展開に関する一般的な情報であり、法的、税務、通関、または投資に関するアドバイスではありません。

segments.src: Tariff actions change quickly and the operative details are set by the published proclamation and official customs guidance.
segments.tr: 関税措置は急速に変化し、運用上の詳細は公開された布告および公式の通関ガイダンスによって設定されます。

segments.src: Importers and exporters should confirm current requirements with the Federal Register, US Customs and Border Protection, and qualified trade counsel before making decisions.*
segments.tr: 輸入業者および輸出業者は、決定を下す前に、連邦官報（Federal Register）、米国税関・国境警備局（CBP）、および資格のある貿易法務担当者に現在の要件を確認してください。*

de.title: Das Zollgesetz von 1930, das niemand benutzt hatte — bis kanadische Hockeyschläger auf der Liste standen

segments.src: For most of the last century, Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 was the kind of provision trade lawyers mentioned at conferences and then moved on from.
segments.tr: Für den Großteil des letzten Jahrhunderts war Abschnitt 338 des Tariff Act von 1930 die Art von Bestimmung, die Handelsrechtler auf Konferenzen erwähnten und dann schnell wieder hinter sich ließen.

segments.src: It is on the books.
segments.tr: Sie steht in den Gesetzbüchern.

segments.src: It has real teeth.
segments.tr: Sie hat echte Zähne.

segments.src: And in roughly 96 years, no president had ever used it to actually put a duty on anything.
segments.tr: Und in etwa 96 Jahren hatte kein Präsident sie jemals benutzt, um tatsächlich einen Zoll auf irgendetwas zu erheben.

segments.src: That changes on **August 19**, when a **50% duty** invoked under Section 338 is scheduled to take effect on a specific list of Canadian goods: passenger vehicles, dairy products, wine, cement — and hockey sticks.
segments.tr: Das ändert sich am **19. August**, wenn ein unter Abschnitt 338 aufgerufener **Zoll von 50 %** für eine bestimmte Liste kanadischer Waren geplant ist: Personenkraftwagen, Milchprodukte, Wein, Zement — und Hockeyschläger.

segments.src: The product list is what gets the headlines.
segments.tr: Die Produktliste ist das, was die Schlagzeilen macht.

segments.src: The legal mechanism is what matters.
segments.tr: Der rechtliche Mechanismus ist das, was zählt.

segments.src: ## What Section 338 actually says
segments.tr: ## Was Abschnitt 338 tatsächlich besagt

segments.src: Section 338 is codified at 19 U.S.C.
segments.tr: Abschnitt 338 ist in 19 U.S.C. kodifiziert

segments.src: § 1338, part of the same 1930 statute better known by the names of its sponsors, Smoot and Hawley.
segments.tr: § 1338, Teil desselben Gesetzes von 1930, das besser unter den Namen seiner Sponsoren, Smoot und Hawley, bekannt ist.

segments.src: Its subject is not national security, not trade deficits, and not unfair subsidies.
segments.tr: Sein Gegenstand ist nicht die nationale Sicherheit, nicht Handelsdefizite und nicht unfaire Subventionen.

segments.src: It is *discrimination*.
segments.tr: Es geht um *Diskriminierung*.

segments.src: In plain terms, the provision allows the president to respond when a foreign country is found to impose burdens or restrictions on US commerce that place American exporters at a disadvantage relative to other countries.
segments.tr: In einfachen Worten erlaubt die Bestimmung dem Präsidenten zu reagieren, wenn festgestellt wird, dass ein fremdes Land Lasten oder Beschränkungen für den US-Handel auferlegt, die amerikanische Exporteure gegenüber anderen Ländern benachteiligen.

segments.src: The available responses are unusually blunt for US trade law:
segments.tr: Die verfügbaren Reaktionen sind für das US-Handelsrecht ungewöhnlich drastisch:

segments.src: - **New or additional duties of up to 50% ad valorem** on that country's products, and
segments.tr: - **Neue oder zusätzliche Zölle von bis zu 50 % ad valorem** auf die Produkte dieses Landes, und

segments.src: - in the more extreme case, **exclusion of the goods from entry altogether**.
segments.tr: - im extremeren Fall der **vollständige Ausschluss der Waren vom Import**.

segments.src: The statute also contemplates a fact-finding role for the US International Trade Commission in identifying such discriminatory practices and reporting them.
segments.tr: Das Gesetz sieht auch eine faktische Rolle für die US International Trade Commission vor, um solche diskriminierenden Praktiken zu identifizieren und zu melden.

segments.src: But compared with the tools Washington has leaned on for the past decade, the procedural runway is short.
segments.tr: Aber im Vergleich zu den Instrumenten, auf die sich Washington in den letzten zehn Jahren gestützt hat, ist der verfahrenstechnische Weg kurz.

segments.src: That contrast is the reason this is a story at all.
segments.tr: Dieser Kontrast ist der Grund, warum dies überhaupt eine Geschichte ist.

segments.src: **Section 232** requires a Commerce Department national-security investigation.
segments.tr: **Abschnitt 232** erfordert eine Untersuchung der nationalen Sicherheit durch das Handelsministerium.

segments.src: **Section 301** requires a formal USTR proceeding, notice, comment, and a hearing.
segments.tr: **Abschnitt 301** erfordert ein formelles USTR-Verfahren, eine Bekanntmachung, Kommentare und eine Anhörung.

segments.src: Emergency economic powers require a declared emergency — and have drawn sustained litigation over whether the tariff power was ever in that statute to begin with.
segments.tr: Notwirtschaftliche Befugnisse erfordern einen erklärten Notstand — und haben anhaltende Rechtsstreitigkeiten darüber ausgelöst, ob die Zollbefugnis überhaupt jemals in diesem Gesetz enthalten war.

segments.src: Section 338 sits outside all of those frameworks, with its own findings requirement and its own ceiling.
segments.tr: Abschnitt 338 steht außerhalb all dieser Rahmenbedingungen, mit eigenen Feststellungsanforderungen und einer eigenen Obergrenze.

segments.src: For years, the standard explanation for why nobody used it was that it wasn't needed.
segments.tr: Jahrelang war die Standarderklärung dafür, warum niemand ihn benutzte, dass er nicht benötigt wurde.

segments.src: The modern toolkit was broader, better-tested in court, and easier to defend.
segments.tr: Der moderne Werkzeugkasten war breiter, vor Gericht besser getestet und leichter zu verteidigen.

segments.src: The revival of a 1930 authority suggests the calculation has shifted toward statutes that haven't been narrowed by decades of case law — precisely because they haven't been tested.
segments.tr: Die Wiederbelebung einer Befugnis von 1930 deutet darauf hin, dass sich die Kalkulation hin zu Gesetzen verschoben hat, die nicht durch jahrzehntelange Rechtsprechung eingeschränkt wurden — eben weil sie nicht getestet wurden.

segments.src: ## Why this round is different: the USMCA carve-out is gone
segments.tr: ## Warum diese Runde anders ist: Die USMCA-Ausnahme ist weg

segments.src: Every significant US tariff action against Canada in recent years came with the same escape hatch.
segments.tr: Jede bedeutende US-Zollmaßnahme gegen Kanada in den letzten Jahren hatte die gleiche Hintertür.

segments.src: If a shipment qualified as originating under the United States–Mexico–Canada Agreement — if it met the rules of origin and the exporter or importer could certify it — the goods came in outside the new duty.
segments.tr: Wenn eine Sendung als Ursprungsware unter dem Abkommen zwischen den Vereinigten Staaten, Mexiko und Kanada (USMCA) galt — wenn sie die Ursprungsregeln erfüllte und der Exporteur oder Importeur dies zertifizieren konnte — kamen die Waren ohne den neuen Zoll hinein.

segments.src: That carve-out did enormous work.
segments.tr: Diese Ausnahme leistete enorme Arbeit.

segments.src: It is why a Canadian-assembled vehicle with a qualifying regional value content was treated differently from an identical-looking vehicle sourced elsewhere.
segments.tr: Deshalb wurde ein in Kanada montiertes Fahrzeug mit einem qualifizierenden regionalen Wertgehalt anders behandelt als ein identisch aussehendes Fahrzeug aus einer anderen Quelle.

segments.src: It is why compliance departments across the continent spent 2025 and early 2026 rebuilding bills of materials rather than rerouting supply chains.
segments.tr: Deshalb verbrachten Compliance-Abteilungen auf dem gesamten Kontinent das Jahr 2025 und den Beginn von 2026 damit, Stücklisten neu aufzubauen, anstatt Lieferketten umzuleiten.

segments.src: **The Section 338 action, as announced, contains no such exemption.** A good that satisfies every USMCA rule of origin — a car meeting the regional value content and labor value content thresholds, a cheese produced entirely in Quebec, a stick laid up in an Ontario plant — is covered on the same terms as a good that doesn't.
segments.tr: **Die Maßnahme nach Abschnitt 338 enthält, wie angekündigt, keine solche Ausnahme.** Eine Ware, die jede USMCA-Ursprungsregel erfüllt — ein Auto, das die Schwellenwerte für den regionalen Wertgehalt und den Arbeitswertgehalt erfüllt, ein Käse, der vollständig in Quebec produziert wurde, ein Schläger, der in einem Werk in Ontario gefertigt wurde — wird zu den gleichen Bedingungen behandelt wie eine Ware, die dies nicht tut.

segments.src: That is the substantive change.
segments.tr: Das ist die wesentliche Änderung.

segments.src: Not the rate.
segments.tr: Nicht der Satz.

segments.src: The rate is high, but rates move.
segments.tr: Der Satz ist hoch, aber Sätze ändern sich.

segments.src: What moved here is the *status* of a document.
segments.tr: Was sich hier geändert hat, ist der *Status* eines Dokuments.

segments.src: ## The certificate of origin stops being a shield
segments.tr: ## Das Ursprungszeugnis hört auf, ein Schutzschild zu sein

segments.src: Since NAFTA took effect in 1994, and continuing under USMCA from July 2020, North American trade has run on a shared assumption: prove where a good comes from, and the tariff schedule follows automatically.
segments.tr: Seit NAFTA 1994 in Kraft trat und unter USMCA ab Juli 2020 fortbesteht, basierte der nordamerikanische Handel auf einer gemeinsamen Annahme: Beweise, woher eine Ware kommt, und der Zolltarif folgt automatisch.

segments.src: USMCA even simplified the mechanics, replacing NAFTA's standardized form with a certification of origin that an importer, exporter, or producer can issue based on a set of required data elements.
segments.tr: USMCA vereinfachte sogar die Mechanik und ersetzte das standardisierte Formular von NAFTA durch eine Ursprungszertifizierung, die ein Importeur, Exporteur oder Produzent basierend auf einer Reihe erforderlicher Datenelemente ausstellen kann.

segments.src: That certification became the load-bearing beam of continental manufacturing.
segments.tr: Diese Zertifizierung wurde zum tragenden Balken der kontinentalen Fertigung.

segments.src: Auto programs were sourced around it.
segments.tr: Autoprogramme wurden darum herum konzipiert.

segments.src: Food processors structured contracts around it.
segments.tr: Lebensmittelverarbeiter strukturierten Verträge darum herum.

segments.src: Customs brokers built practices around it.
segments.tr: Zollmakler bauten ihre Praktiken darum herum auf.

segments.src: A duty that applies regardless of origin certification doesn't repeal any of that.
segments.tr: Ein Zoll, der unabhängig von der Ursprungszertifizierung gilt, hebt nichts davon auf.

segments.src: But it does demote it.
segments.tr: Aber er stuft es herab.

segments.src: The paperwork still governs preferential *duty-free* treatment under the agreement.
segments.tr: Die Unterlagen regeln immer noch die präferenzielle *zollfreie* Behandlung im Rahmen des Abkommens.

segments.src: It no longer guarantees that a shipment escapes whatever else has been layered on top.
segments.tr: Sie garantieren nicht mehr, dass eine Sendung allem entgeht, was darüber gelegt wurde.

segments.src: If you want one sentence for why trade counsel are re-reading old statutes this month, it is this: **origin compliance has stopped being a complete answer to the question "what will this cost at the border?"**
segments.tr: Wenn Sie einen Satz dafür wollen, warum Handelsberater diesen Monat alte Gesetze neu lesen, dann ist es dieser: **Die Einhaltung der Ursprungsregeln ist keine vollständige Antwort mehr auf die Frage "Was wird das an der Grenze kosten?"**

segments.src: ## The joint-review backdrop
segments.tr: ## Der Hintergrund der gemeinsamen Überprüfung

segments.src: None of this is happening in a vacuum.
segments.tr: Nichts davon geschieht im luftleeren Raum.

segments.src: USMCA was written with a clock in it.
segments.tr: USMCA wurde mit einer eingebauten Uhr geschrieben.

segments.src: The agreement entered into force on July 1, 2020, with a 16-year term and a **joint review at the six-year mark** — July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: Das Abkommen trat am 1. Juli 2020 in Kraft, mit einer Laufzeit von 16 Jahren und einer **gemeinsamen Überprüfung nach sechs Jahren** — am 1. Juli 2026.

segments.src: If all three parties confirm they want to extend, the term rolls forward another 16 years.
segments.tr: Wenn alle drei Parteien bestätigen, dass sie verlängern wollen, verlängert sich die Laufzeit um weitere 16 Jahre.

segments.src: If they don't, the agreement doesn't collapse; it shifts into a cycle of **annual reviews** running toward a 2036 endpoint, with the parties expected to keep trying to resolve their differences in the meantime.
segments.tr: Wenn nicht, bricht das Abkommen nicht zusammen; es geht in einen Zyklus von **jährlichen Überprüfungen** über, der bis zu einem Endpunkt im Jahr 2036 führt, wobei die Parteien in der Zwischenzeit versuchen sollen, ihre Differenzen beizulegen.

segments.src: Washington's decision not to renew the pact in its current form puts the agreement into exactly that annual-review posture.
segments.tr: Washingtons Entscheidung, den Pakt in seiner jetzigen Form nicht zu erneuern, versetzt das Abkommen genau in diese Haltung der jährlichen Überprüfung.

segments.src: The treaty is still in force.
segments.tr: Der Vertrag ist immer noch in Kraft.

segments.src: Its obligations still exist.
segments.tr: Seine Verpflichtungen bestehen weiterhin.

segments.src: But its long horizon — the thing that made it worth designing a 10-year vehicle program around — is now provisional, reviewed one year at a time.
segments.tr: Aber sein langer Horizont — das, was es lohnenswert machte, ein 10-jähriges Fahrzeugprogramm darum herum zu entwerfen — ist nun vorläufig und wird Jahr für Jahr überprüft.

segments.src: Layer the Section 338 duty on top of that, and the message businesses are reading is less about a single 50% number and more about **planning horizon**.
segments.tr: Legt man den Zoll nach Abschnitt 338 darüber, lesen Unternehmen die Botschaft weniger als eine einzelne 50 %-Zahl, sondern vielmehr als eine Frage des **Planungshorizonts**.

segments.src: A tariff can be reversed next quarter.
segments.tr: Ein Zoll kann im nächsten Quartal rückgängig gemacht werden.

segments.src: A twelve-month review cycle is a structural feature.
segments.tr: Ein zwölfmonatiger Überprüfungszyklus ist ein strukturelles Merkmal.

segments.src: ## Who feels it, and how unevenly
segments.tr: ## Wer es spürt und wie ungleichmäßig

segments.src: The five categories on the list are not equivalent, and the volumes tell you something about intent.
segments.tr: Die fünf Kategorien auf der Liste sind nicht gleichwertig, und die Volumina verraten etwas über die Absicht.

segments.src: **Vehicles** are the heavyweight.
segments.tr: **Fahrzeuge** sind das Schwergewicht.

segments.src: Canadian assembly plants ship a large share of their output south, and the integrated parts networks around Ontario and Michigan mean components can cross the border several times before a finished car does.
segments.tr: Kanadische Montagewerke versenden einen großen Teil ihrer Produktion in den Süden, und die integrierten Teile-Netzwerke rund um Ontario und Michigan bedeuten, dass Komponenten die Grenze mehrmals überqueren können, bevor ein fertiges Auto dies tut.

segments.src: A duty applied without an origin exemption interacts badly with a supply chain that was deliberately built to be continental.
segments.tr: Ein Zoll, der ohne Ursprungsausnahme angewendet wird, interagiert schlecht mit einer Lieferkette, die bewusst kontinental aufgebaut wurde.

segments.src: **Dairy** is the outlier by volume.
segments.tr: **Milchprodukte** sind der Ausreißer beim Volumen.

segments.src: The United States generally runs a *surplus* in dairy trade with Canada — US processors sell more north than Canadian processors sell south.
segments.tr: Die Vereinigten Staaten haben im Milchhandel mit Kanada im Allgemeinen einen *Überschuss* — US-Verarbeiter verkaufen mehr in den Norden als kanadische Verarbeiter in den Süden.

segments.src: A tariff on Canadian dairy therefore isn't primarily about the flow it taxes.
segments.tr: Ein Zoll auf kanadische Milchprodukte betrifft daher in erster Linie nicht den Fluss, den er besteuert.

segments.src: It reads as pressure on a long-running dispute over how Canada allocates its tariff-rate quotas under its supply-management system, an issue that has already been through formal dispute settlement.
segments.tr: Er wird als Druckmittel in einem langjährigen Streit darüber wahrgenommen, wie Kanada seine Zolltarifkontingente im Rahmen seines Angebotsmanagementsystems zuweist, ein Thema, das bereits ein formelles Streitbeilegungsverfahren durchlaufen hat.

segments.src: **Wine** is small in dollar terms — Niagara and Okanagan producers ship modest volumes — but highly visible on retail shelves, and it sits inside a broader argument about provincial liquor-board practices that US exporters have complained about for years.
segments.tr: **Wein** ist in Geldwerten gering — Produzenten aus Niagara und Okanagan versenden bescheidene Mengen — aber sehr sichtbar in den Einzelhandelsregalen, und er ist Teil eines breiteren Arguments über die Praktiken der provinziellen Alkoholbehörden, über die sich US-Exporteure seit Jahren beschweren.

segments.src: **Cement** is the quiet one with the largest downstream footprint.
segments.tr: **Zement** ist der stille Faktor mit dem größten Downstream-Fußabdruck.

segments.src: Canada is among the biggest sources of imported cement in the US, and it moves into Great Lakes, Northeast, and Pacific Northwest markets where the freight economics of alternative suppliers are poor.
segments.tr: Kanada gehört zu den größten Quellen für importierten Zement in den USA, und er gelangt in die Märkte der Großen Seen, des Nordostens und des pazifischen Nordwestens, wo die Frachtökonomie alternativer Lieferanten schlecht ist.

segments.src: Construction input costs don't make headlines the way car prices do, but they reach further.
segments.tr: Baukosten landen nicht so in den Schlagzeilen wie Autopreise, aber sie wirken weiter.

segments.src: **Hockey sticks** are the item everyone will remember, and the one with the most instructive complication.
segments.tr: **Hockeyschläger** sind der Artikel, an den sich jeder erinnern wird, und der mit der aufschlussreichsten Komplikation.

segments.src: Several of the best-known brands are Canadian in identity and headquarters, while a great deal of composite stick manufacturing happens in Asia.
segments.tr: Mehrere der bekanntesten Marken sind in ihrer Identität und ihrem Hauptsitz kanadisch, während ein Großteil der Herstellung von Verbundschlägern in Asien erfolgt.

segments.src: Whether a given stick is "Canadian" for customs purposes depends on where it was actually made and how the origin rules treat it — which is to say, the symbolic item on the list is also a small lesson in why origin analysis is harder than a logo.
segments.tr: Ob ein bestimmter Schläger für Zollzwecke "kanadisch" ist, hängt davon ab, wo er tatsächlich hergestellt wurde und wie die Ursprungsregeln ihn behandeln — das heißt, der symbolische Artikel auf der Liste ist auch eine kleine Lektion darin, warum die Ursprungsanalyse schwieriger ist als ein Logo.

segments.src: ## What is still genuinely unsettled
segments.tr: ## Was immer noch wirklich ungeklärt ist

segments.src: A few things are worth holding loosely until they're confirmed in the operative documents:
segments.tr: Einige Dinge sollten vorsichtig betrachtet werden, bis sie in den operativen Dokumenten bestätigt werden:

segments.src: - **Stacking.** Whether the 50% applies on top of existing sector duties, or in place of them, changes the landed cost dramatically. Check the proclamation text and the customs guidance, not summaries.
segments.tr: - **Stapelung.** Ob die 50 % zusätzlich zu bestehenden Sektorzöllen anfallen oder diese ersetzen, ändert die Landkosten dramatisch. Prüfen Sie den Proklamationstext und die Zollrichtlinien, nicht die Zusammenfassungen.

segments.src: - **Scope by tariff line.** "Cars" and "dairy" are categories in a press summary; what binds is the list of HTS subheadings. Adjacent products often turn out to be in or out in ways the category label doesn't predict.
segments.tr: - **Umfang nach Zolltarifnummer.** "Autos" und "Milchprodukte" sind Kategorien in einer Pressezusammenfassung; verbindlich ist die Liste der HTS-Unterpositionen. Benachbarte Produkte erweisen sich oft als ein- oder ausgeschlossen in einer Weise, die das Kategorieetikett nicht vorhersagt.

segments.src: - **In-transit treatment.** Actions like this usually specify how goods already on the water or on a rail car are handled. That detail decides who eats the cost on shipments already booked.
segments.tr: - **Behandlung von Waren im Transit.** Maßnahmen wie diese legen normalerweise fest, wie Waren, die sich bereits auf dem Wasser oder in einem Eisenbahnwagen befinden, behandelt werden. Dieses Detail entscheidet, wer die Kosten für bereits gebuchte Sendungen trägt.

segments.src: - **Legal challenge.** A statute unused for 96 years has correspondingly little case law defining its limits — the findings required, how specific they must be, and how far judicial review reaches. Litigation is a reasonable expectation, and its outcome is not predictable from the text alone.
segments.tr: - **Rechtliche Anfechtung.** Ein Gesetz, das 96 Jahre lang nicht benutzt wurde, hat entsprechend wenig Rechtsprechung, die seine Grenzen definiert — die erforderlichen Feststellungen, wie spezifisch sie sein müssen und wie weit die gerichtliche Überprüfung reicht. Rechtsstreitigkeiten sind eine vernünftige Erwartung, und ihr Ausgang ist nicht allein aus dem Text vorhersehbar.

segments.src: - **Response.** Canada has its own retaliation authorities and a domestic political timetable of its own. The list above may not be the last list.
segments.tr: - **Reaktion.** Kanada hat seine eigenen Vergeltungsbefugnisse und einen eigenen innenpolitischen Zeitplan. Die obige Liste ist möglicherweise nicht die letzte Liste.

segments.src: ## What to watch over the next two weeks
segments.tr: ## Worauf man in den nächsten zwei Wochen achten sollte

segments.src: Between now and August 19, the useful signals are administrative rather than rhetorical: the published proclamation and its annexes, US Customs and Border Protection guidance messages to the trade community, any exclusion or drawback process, and the tariff-line detail.
segments.tr: Zwischen jetzt und dem 19. August sind die nützlichen Signale administrativer Natur und nicht rhetorisch: die veröffentlichte Proklamation und ihre Anhänge, die Leitfäden der US Customs and Border Protection an die Handelsgemeinschaft, etwaige Ausschluss- oder Rückerstattungsverfahren und die Details der Zolltarifnummern.

segments.src: Statements from either capital will move sentiment; the annexes will move invoices.
segments.tr: Erklärungen aus beiden Hauptstädten werden die Stimmung beeinflussen; die Anhänge werden die Rechnungen beeinflussen.

segments.src: The longer-term signal is the annual review cycle.
segments.tr: Das längerfristige Signal ist der jährliche Überprüfungszyklus.

segments.src: A single duty on five product categories is a discrete event.
segments.tr: Ein einzelner Zoll auf fünf Produktkategorien ist ein diskretes Ereignis.

segments.src: A framework in which the continent's trade rulebook is reconfirmed twelve months at a time is a different operating environment — and it is the part that will still be true after this particular tariff is resolved, whichever way it goes.
segments.tr: Ein Rahmen, in dem das Handelsregelwerk des Kontinents alle zwölf Monate neu bestätigt wird, ist ein anderes Betriebsumfeld — und das ist der Teil, der auch nach der Lösung dieses speziellen Zolls noch wahr sein wird, egal in welche Richtung es geht.

segments.src: The hockey sticks will get the jokes.
segments.tr: Die Hockeyschläger werden die Witze liefern.

segments.src: The certificate of origin is the story.
segments.tr: Das Ursprungszeugnis ist die eigentliche Geschichte.

segments.src: *This article is general information about a public policy development, not legal, tax, customs, or investment advice.
segments.tr: *Dieser Artikel enthält allgemeine Informationen über eine öffentlich-politische Entwicklung, keine rechtlichen, steuerlichen, zollrechtlichen oder Anlageberatungen.

segments.src: Tariff actions change quickly and the operative details are set by the published proclamation and official customs guidance.
segments.tr: Zollmaßnahmen ändern sich schnell und die operativen Details werden durch die veröffentlichte Proklamation und offizielle Zollrichtlinien festgelegt.

segments.src: Importers and exporters should confirm current requirements with the Federal Register, US Customs and Border Protection, and qualified trade counsel before making decisions.*
segments.tr: Importeure und Exporteure sollten die aktuellen Anforderungen im Federal Register, bei der US Customs and Border Protection und bei qualifizierten Handelsberatern prüfen, bevor sie Entscheidungen treffen.*

vi.title: Luật Thuế quan 1930 mà không ai sử dụng — cho đến khi gậy khúc côn cầu Canada lọt vào danh sách

segments.src: For most of the last century, Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 was the kind of provision trade lawyers mentioned at conferences and then moved on from.
segments.tr: Trong phần lớn thế kỷ trước, Mục 338 của Đạo luật Thuế quan năm 1930 là loại điều khoản mà các luật sư thương mại thường nhắc đến tại các hội nghị rồi bỏ qua.

segments.src: It is on the books.
segments.tr: Nó nằm trong sách luật.

segments.src: It has real teeth.
segments.tr: Nó có hiệu lực thực tế.

segments.src: And in roughly 96 years, no president had ever used it to actually put a duty on anything.
segments.tr: Và trong khoảng 96 năm, chưa có tổng thống nào thực sự sử dụng nó để áp thuế lên bất cứ thứ gì.

segments.src: That changes on **August 19**, when a **50% duty** invoked under Section 338 is scheduled to take effect on a specific list of Canadian goods: passenger vehicles, dairy products, wine, cement — and hockey sticks.
segments.tr: Điều đó thay đổi vào ngày **19 tháng 8**, khi một mức **thuế 50%** được áp dụng theo Mục 338 dự kiến có hiệu lực đối với một danh sách cụ thể các hàng hóa Canada: xe ô tô, sản phẩm sữa, rượu vang, xi măng — và gậy khúc côn cầu.

segments.src: The product list is what gets the headlines.
segments.tr: Danh sách sản phẩm là điều gây chú ý trên các mặt báo.

segments.src: The legal mechanism is what matters.
segments.tr: Nhưng cơ chế pháp lý mới là điều quan trọng.

segments.src: ## What Section 338 actually says
segments.tr: ## Mục 338 thực sự nói gì

segments.src: Section 338 is codified at 19 U.S.C.
segments.tr: Mục 338 được mã hóa tại 19 U.S.C.

segments.src: § 1338, part of the same 1930 statute better known by the names of its sponsors, Smoot and Hawley.
segments.tr: § 1338, một phần của cùng một đạo luật năm 1930 được biết đến nhiều hơn qua tên của những người bảo trợ, Smoot và Hawley.

segments.src: Its subject is not national security, not trade deficits, and not unfair subsidies.
segments.tr: Đối tượng của nó không phải là an ninh quốc gia, không phải thâm hụt thương mại và không phải trợ cấp không công bằng.

segments.src: It is *discrimination*.
segments.tr: Đó là *sự phân biệt đối xử*.

segments.src: In plain terms, the provision allows the president to respond when a foreign country is found to impose burdens or restrictions on US commerce that place American exporters at a disadvantage relative to other countries.
segments.tr: Nói một cách đơn giản, điều khoản này cho phép tổng thống phản ứng khi một quốc gia nước ngoài bị phát hiện áp đặt các gánh nặng hoặc hạn chế đối với thương mại Hoa Kỳ khiến các nhà xuất khẩu Hoa Kỳ bị bất lợi so với các quốc gia khác.

segments.src: The available responses are unusually blunt for US trade law:
segments.tr: Các phản ứng có sẵn thường rất gay gắt đối với luật thương mại Hoa Kỳ:

segments.src: - **New or additional duties of up to 50% ad valorem** on that country's products, and
segments.tr: - **Thuế mới hoặc bổ sung lên đến 50% giá trị (ad valorem)** đối với các sản phẩm của quốc gia đó, và

segments.src: - in the more extreme case, **exclusion of the goods from entry altogether**.
segments.tr: - trong trường hợp cực đoan hơn, **loại bỏ hoàn toàn việc nhập khẩu hàng hóa**.

segments.src: The statute also contemplates a fact-finding role for the US International Trade Commission in identifying such discriminatory practices and reporting them.
segments.tr: Đạo luật cũng dự kiến vai trò tìm kiếm sự thật của Ủy ban Thương mại Quốc tế Hoa Kỳ trong việc xác định các hành vi phân biệt đối xử đó và báo cáo chúng.

segments.src: But compared with the tools Washington has leaned on for the past decade, the procedural runway is short.
segments.tr: Nhưng so với các công cụ mà Washington đã dựa vào trong thập kỷ qua, quy trình thực hiện là rất ngắn.

segments.src: That contrast is the reason this is a story at all.
segments.tr: Sự tương phản đó là lý do tại sao đây lại là một câu chuyện đáng chú ý.

segments.src: **Section 232** requires a Commerce Department national-security investigation.
segments.tr: **Mục 232** yêu cầu một cuộc điều tra an ninh quốc gia của Bộ Thương mại.

segments.src: **Section 301** requires a formal USTR proceeding, notice, comment, and a hearing.
segments.tr: **Mục 301** yêu cầu một quy trình chính thức của USTR, thông báo, lấy ý kiến và điều trần.

segments.src: Emergency economic powers require a declared emergency — and have drawn sustained litigation over whether the tariff power was ever in that statute to begin with.
segments.tr: Các quyền hạn kinh tế khẩn cấp yêu cầu một tình trạng khẩn cấp được tuyên bố — và đã gây ra các vụ kiện tụng kéo dài về việc liệu quyền hạn áp thuế có từng nằm trong đạo luật đó ngay từ đầu hay không.

segments.src: Section 338 sits outside all of those frameworks, with its own findings requirement and its own ceiling.
segments.tr: Mục 338 nằm ngoài tất cả các khung pháp lý đó, với các yêu cầu tìm kiếm sự thật và mức trần riêng.

segments.src: For years, the standard explanation for why nobody used it was that it wasn't needed.
segments.tr: Trong nhiều năm, lời giải thích tiêu chuẩn cho việc tại sao không ai sử dụng nó là vì nó không cần thiết.

segments.src: The modern toolkit was broader, better-tested in court, and easier to defend.
segments.tr: Bộ công cụ hiện đại rộng hơn, được thử nghiệm tốt hơn tại tòa án và dễ bảo vệ hơn.

segments.src: The revival of a 1930 authority suggests the calculation has shifted toward statutes that haven't been narrowed by decades of case law — precisely because they haven't been tested.
segments.tr: Sự hồi sinh của một quyền hạn từ năm 1930 cho thấy tính toán đã chuyển sang các đạo luật không bị thu hẹp bởi hàng thập kỷ án lệ — chính vì chúng chưa từng được thử nghiệm.

segments.src: ## Why this round is different: the USMCA carve-out is gone
segments.tr: ## Tại sao lần này lại khác: ngoại lệ USMCA đã biến mất

segments.src: Every significant US tariff action against Canada in recent years came with the same escape hatch.
segments.tr: Mọi hành động áp thuế đáng kể của Hoa Kỳ đối với Canada trong những năm gần đây đều đi kèm với cùng một lối thoát.

segments.src: If a shipment qualified as originating under the United States–Mexico–Canada Agreement — if it met the rules of origin and the exporter or importer could certify it — the goods came in outside the new duty.
segments.tr: Nếu một lô hàng đủ điều kiện là có xuất xứ theo Hiệp định Hoa Kỳ–Mexico–Canada (USMCA) — nếu nó đáp ứng các quy tắc xuất xứ và nhà xuất khẩu hoặc nhà nhập khẩu có thể chứng nhận điều đó — hàng hóa sẽ được nhập khẩu mà không phải chịu mức thuế mới.

segments.src: That carve-out did enormous work.
segments.tr: Ngoại lệ đó đã đóng vai trò cực kỳ quan trọng.

segments.src: It is why a Canadian-assembled vehicle with a qualifying regional value content was treated differently from an identical-looking vehicle sourced elsewhere.
segments.tr: Đó là lý do tại sao một chiếc xe được lắp ráp tại Canada với nội dung giá trị khu vực đạt yêu cầu được đối xử khác với một chiếc xe trông giống hệt nhưng có nguồn gốc từ nơi khác.

segments.src: It is why compliance departments across the continent spent 2025 and early 2026 rebuilding bills of materials rather than rerouting supply chains.
segments.tr: Đó là lý do tại sao các bộ phận tuân thủ trên khắp lục địa đã dành năm 2025 và đầu năm 2026 để xây dựng lại danh mục vật tư thay vì thay đổi chuỗi cung ứng.

segments.src: **The Section 338 action, as announced, contains no such exemption.** A good that satisfies every USMCA rule of origin — a car meeting the regional value content and labor value content thresholds, a cheese produced entirely in Quebec, a stick laid up in an Ontario plant — is covered on the same terms as a good that doesn't.
segments.tr: **Hành động theo Mục 338, như đã thông báo, không chứa ngoại lệ như vậy.** Một mặt hàng đáp ứng mọi quy tắc xuất xứ của USMCA — một chiếc xe đáp ứng ngưỡng giá trị khu vực và nội dung giá trị lao động, một loại phô mai được sản xuất hoàn toàn ở Quebec, một chiếc gậy được chế tạo tại một nhà máy ở Ontario — cũng bị áp thuế theo cùng các điều khoản như một mặt hàng không đáp ứng.

segments.src: That is the substantive change.
segments.tr: Đó là thay đổi về mặt nội dung.

segments.src: Not the rate.
segments.tr: Không phải về mức thuế.

segments.src: The rate is high, but rates move.
segments.tr: Mức thuế cao, nhưng mức thuế có thể thay đổi.

segments.src: What moved here is the *status* of a document.
segments.tr: Điều thay đổi ở đây là *tư cách* của một văn bản.

segments.src: ## The certificate of origin stops being a shield
segments.tr: ## Giấy chứng nhận xuất xứ không còn là tấm khiên

segments.src: Since NAFTA took effect in 1994, and continuing under USMCA from July 2020, North American trade has run on a shared assumption: prove where a good comes from, and the tariff schedule follows automatically.
segments.tr: Kể từ khi NAFTA có hiệu lực vào năm 1994, và tiếp tục theo USMCA từ tháng 7 năm 2020, thương mại Bắc Mỹ đã vận hành dựa trên một giả định chung: chứng minh được hàng hóa đến từ đâu, và biểu thuế sẽ tự động được áp dụng theo đó.

segments.src: USMCA even simplified the mechanics, replacing NAFTA's standardized form with a certification of origin that an importer, exporter, or producer can issue based on a set of required data elements.
segments.tr: USMCA thậm chí còn đơn giản hóa các cơ chế, thay thế mẫu chuẩn của NAFTA bằng một chứng nhận xuất xứ mà nhà nhập khẩu, nhà xuất khẩu hoặc nhà sản xuất có thể cấp dựa trên một bộ các yếu tố dữ liệu bắt buộc.

segments.src: That certification became the load-bearing beam of continental manufacturing.
segments.tr: Chứng nhận đó đã trở thành dầm chịu lực của sản xuất lục địa.

segments.src: Auto programs were sourced around it.
segments.tr: Các chương trình ô tô được xây dựng xoay quanh nó.

segments.src: Food processors structured contracts around it.
segments.tr: Các nhà chế biến thực phẩm cấu trúc hợp đồng xoay quanh nó.

segments.src: Customs brokers built practices around it.
segments.tr: Các đại lý hải quan xây dựng quy trình xoay quanh nó.

segments.src: A duty that applies regardless of origin certification doesn't repeal any of that.
segments.tr: Một mức thuế áp dụng bất kể chứng nhận xuất xứ không hủy bỏ bất kỳ điều gì trong số đó.

segments.src: But it does demote it.
segments.tr: Nhưng nó làm giảm giá trị của nó.

segments.src: The paperwork still governs preferential *duty-free* treatment under the agreement.
segments.tr: Giấy tờ vẫn điều phối việc đối xử *miễn thuế* ưu đãi theo hiệp định.

segments.src: It no longer guarantees that a shipment escapes whatever else has been layered on top.
segments.tr: Nhưng nó không còn đảm bảo rằng một lô hàng sẽ thoát khỏi bất kỳ điều gì khác được áp đặt lên trên.

segments.src: If you want one sentence for why trade counsel are re-reading old statutes this month, it is this: **origin compliance has stopped being a complete answer to the question "what will this cost at the border?"**
segments.tr: Nếu bạn muốn một câu để giải thích tại sao các cố vấn thương mại đang đọc lại các đạo luật cũ trong tháng này, thì đó là: **việc tuân thủ xuất xứ đã không còn là câu trả lời đầy đủ cho câu hỏi "chi phí tại biên giới sẽ là bao nhiêu?"**

segments.src: ## The joint-review backdrop
segments.tr: ## Bối cảnh rà soát chung

segments.src: None of this is happening in a vacuum.
segments.tr: Không có điều gì trong số này xảy ra trong một khoảng không.

segments.src: USMCA was written with a clock in it.
segments.tr: USMCA được viết với một chiếc đồng hồ đếm ngược.

segments.src: The agreement entered into force on July 1, 2020, with a 16-year term and a **joint review at the six-year mark** — July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: Hiệp định có hiệu lực vào ngày 1 tháng 7 năm 2020, với thời hạn 16 năm và một cuộc **rà soát chung vào mốc sáu năm** — ngày 1 tháng 7 năm 2026.

segments.src: If all three parties confirm they want to extend, the term rolls forward another 16 years.
segments.tr: Nếu cả ba bên xác nhận họ muốn gia hạn, thời hạn sẽ được kéo dài thêm 16 năm nữa.

segments.src: If they don't, the agreement doesn't collapse; it shifts into a cycle of **annual reviews** running toward a 2036 endpoint, with the parties expected to keep trying to resolve their differences in the meantime.
segments.tr: Nếu không, hiệp định không sụp đổ; nó chuyển sang một chu kỳ **rà soát hàng năm** kéo dài đến mốc kết thúc năm 2036, với các bên được kỳ vọng sẽ tiếp tục cố gắng giải quyết những khác biệt của họ trong thời gian đó.

segments.src: Washington's decision not to renew the pact in its current form puts the agreement into exactly that annual-review posture.
segments.tr: Quyết định của Washington về việc không gia hạn hiệp ước theo hình thức hiện tại sẽ đưa hiệp định vào đúng tư thế rà soát hàng năm đó.

segments.src: The treaty is still in force.
segments.tr: Hiệp ước vẫn có hiệu lực.

segments.src: Its obligations still exist.
segments.tr: Các nghĩa vụ của nó vẫn tồn tại.

segments.src: But its long horizon — the thing that made it worth designing a 10-year vehicle program around — is now provisional, reviewed one year at a time.
segments.tr: Nhưng tầm nhìn dài hạn của nó — điều khiến nó đáng để thiết kế một chương trình xe cộ 10 năm xoay quanh — giờ đây là tạm thời, được rà soát từng năm một.

segments.src: Layer the Section 338 duty on top of that, and the message businesses are reading is less about a single 50% number and more about **planning horizon**.
segments.tr: Khi áp mức thuế Mục 338 lên trên điều đó, thông điệp mà các doanh nghiệp đang đọc được không còn là về một con số 50% đơn thuần, mà là về **tầm nhìn lập kế hoạch**.

segments.src: A tariff can be reversed next quarter.
segments.tr: Một mức thuế có thể được đảo ngược vào quý sau.

segments.src: A twelve-month review cycle is a structural feature.
segments.tr: Một chu kỳ rà soát mười hai tháng là một đặc điểm cấu trúc.

segments.src: ## Who feels it, and how unevenly
segments.tr: ## Ai chịu ảnh hưởng, và ảnh hưởng không đồng đều như thế nào

segments.src: The five categories on the list are not equivalent, and the volumes tell you something about intent.
segments.tr: Năm danh mục trong danh sách không tương đương nhau, và khối lượng cho bạn biết điều gì đó về ý định.

segments.src: **Vehicles** are the heavyweight.
segments.tr: **Xe cộ** là hạng nặng.

segments.src: Canadian assembly plants ship a large share of their output south, and the integrated parts networks around Ontario and Michigan mean components can cross the border several times before a finished car does.
segments.tr: Các nhà máy lắp ráp của Canada vận chuyển một phần lớn sản lượng của họ xuống phía nam, và mạng lưới linh kiện tích hợp xung quanh Ontario và Michigan có nghĩa là các thành phần có thể băng qua biên giới nhiều lần trước khi một chiếc xe hoàn chỉnh được xuất xưởng.

segments.src: A duty applied without an origin exemption interacts badly with a supply chain that was deliberately built to be continental.
segments.tr: Một mức thuế áp dụng mà không có ngoại lệ xuất xứ sẽ tương tác tệ với một chuỗi cung ứng được cố tình xây dựng để mang tính lục địa.

segments.src: **Dairy** is the outlier by volume.
segments.tr: **Sản phẩm sữa** là trường hợp ngoại lệ về khối lượng.

segments.src: The United States generally runs a *surplus* in dairy trade with Canada — US processors sell more north than Canadian processors sell south.
segments.tr: Hoa Kỳ thường có *thặng dư* trong thương mại sữa với Canada — các nhà chế biến Hoa Kỳ bán lên phía bắc nhiều hơn các nhà chế biến Canada bán xuống phía nam.

segments.src: A tariff on Canadian dairy therefore isn't primarily about the flow it taxes.
segments.tr: Do đó, một mức thuế đối với sữa Canada không chủ yếu nói về dòng chảy mà nó đánh thuế.

segments.src: It reads as pressure on a long-running dispute over how Canada allocates its tariff-rate quotas under its supply-management system, an issue that has already been through formal dispute settlement.
segments.tr: Nó được xem như là áp lực đối với một cuộc tranh chấp kéo dài về cách Canada phân bổ hạn ngạch thuế quan đối với sữa theo hệ thống quản lý cung ứng của mình, một vấn đề đã từng qua giải quyết tranh chấp chính thức.
